	PROCEDURE cargarvector
		Local nIndice, vDatos[1,2], cClave
		Local cComprobante,lVez,i,cId_Sucursal,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_Sistema,nIndex
		Local nCantRenglonesFinal
		
		nCantRenglonesFinal = 0
		nIndice = 1
		
		if thisform.Mat_Descarga[1,1] = ""
			nIndice = 0
		else
			nIndice = alen(thisform.Mat_Descarga,1)
		endif
		
		cComprobante = ""
		
		cComprobante =  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sucursal") +;
						thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sistema")  +;
						thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba") +;
				 		str(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		
		nIndice = nIndice + 1
		Dimension thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,24]
		
		if thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar (cComprobante)
			if thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Buscar (cComprobante, .f., "CLAVE")
			
				do while !thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.EsEof() and thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.EsClaveIgual()
				   nCantRenglonesFinal = nCantRenglonesFinal + 1
				   
				   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,1]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		    	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,2]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema")
				   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,3]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		    	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,4]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,5]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		    	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,6]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Detalle")
				
				   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,7]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,8]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Precio_base_uni")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,9]  = thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Visualizacion")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,10] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("TotalVisu")
			  	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,11] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Bonificacion")
			  	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,12] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("PrecioVisuSinBonificar")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,13] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("despacho")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,14] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("origen")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,15] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Numero")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,16] = 0 &&thisform.oViewDescargaMultiple.Leer("NroRegistro")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,17] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("PrecioLista")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,18] = thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Renglon") &&thisform.oViewDescargaMultiple.Leer("NumeroRenglon")
		
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,19]= Ctod(" /  /  ")
		  	       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,20]= 0
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,21]= 0
		
				   ** ALONSO, 07/06/2005 - TEMA DE NUEVO ELEMENTO A LA MATRIZ, QUE ES EL 22, SE CHEQUEA PARA TASAS DE IVA Y SE AGREGA ESTE ELEMENTO TAMBIEN.
				   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,22]= thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Renglon")
				   ***************************************************************************************
				   
				   ** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGAN LOS NUEVOS ELEMENTOS ******************************
		       	   thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,23]= thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Porc_Iva")
			       thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,24]= thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva")
		    	   ***************************************************************************************
		    	   
				   thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
				   nIndice = nIndice + 1
				   Dimension thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,24]
				enddo
			endif
		endif
		
		nIndice = nIndice - 1
		Dimension thisform.Mat_Descarga[nIndice,24]
		
		return nCantRenglonesFinal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE confeccionarcomprobante
		LParameters lShow
		
		Local cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc,cId_Cliente
		Local cId_Comproba,cId_Deposito,lPoderEditar,lHabilitoScrollBars
		
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		Local loculta_leyenda
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		
		
		IF THISFORM.oChkTodos.Value
			cId_SucursalDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			cId_SistemaDesc			= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			cId_ComprobaDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
			nNro_ReferenciaDesc 	= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			cId_Cliente				= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		else
			if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
				cId_SucursalDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
				cId_SistemaDesc			= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Sistema")
				cId_ComprobaDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
				nNro_ReferenciaDesc 	= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
				cId_Cliente				= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Cliente")
			else
				cId_SucursalDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
				cId_SistemaDesc			= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sistema")
				cId_ComprobaDesc		= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
				nNro_ReferenciaDesc 	= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
				cId_Cliente				= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Cliente")
			endif		
		endif
		
		
		** EN CASO DE ESTAR SELECCIONADO EL TILDE DE TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES, OBTENGO EL COMPROBANTE DE LA RELACION DE LA TABLA "DECARGAAUTOMATICA"
		if thisform.oChkTodos.Value
			if thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar (cId_Cliente)
				cId_IvaCliente = thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Iva")
				cClave = cId_SistemaDesc + cId_ComprobaDesc + cId_IvaCliente
				if thisform.oTblDescargaAutomatica.Buscar (cClave, .f., "COM_BASIVA")
					cId_comproba = thisform.oTblDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Comproba")
				endif
			endif
		else
			cId_Comproba			= ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value
		endif	
		
		cId_Deposito			= Iif(ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Enabled,ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value,Space(3) )
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		lPoderEditar			= !(Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("solocmppendientes") Or Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Val_descarga"))
		
		
		*@0521/3@
		If lPoderEditar
		   lPoderEditar = Thisform.ControlarArticulosTalleColor(cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc)
		Endif
		*@0521/3@
		
		
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		If !Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("oculta_Leyenda_descarga_ind")
		 
		   loculta_leyenda = .f.
		 
		else
		   
		   loculta_leyenda = .t.
		endif
		
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		
		
		If Type("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante") <> "O"	
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante","tg_altacomprobante")
		Endif
		
		lHabilitoScrollBars = .T.
		
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		*****Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.SetearConfIndividual(cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc,cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_Deposito,.t.,.f.,lPoderEditar)
		Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.SetearConfIndividual(cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc,cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_Deposito,.t.,.f.,lPoderEditar,loculta_leyenda,lHabilitoScrollBars)
		**** Diego 18-11-2008
		
		
		if lShow
			Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Show()
		endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE confeccionarcomprobantecliente
		LParameters lShow
		
		Local cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc,cId_Cliente
		Local cId_Comproba,cId_Deposito,lPoderEditar, vAuxiliar,lHabilitoScrollBars
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		=Acopy (thisform.Mat_Descarga, vAuxiliar)
		
		cId_Cliente				= Thisform.Id_Cliente
		cId_Comproba			= ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value
		cId_Deposito			= Iif(ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Enabled,ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value,Space(3) )
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		lPoderEditar = !(Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("solocmppendientes") Or Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Val_descarga"))
		
		*If lPoderEditar
		*  lPoderEditar = Thisform.ControlarArticulosTalleColor(cId_SucursalDesc,cId_SistemaDesc,cId_ComprobaDesc,nNro_ReferenciaDesc)
		*Endif
		
		lHabilitoScrollBars = .T.
		
		If Type("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante") <> "O"	
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante","tg_altacomprobante")
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.SetearConfIndividualCliente(@vAuxiliar,cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_Deposito,.t.,.f.,lPoderEditar,lHabilitoScrollBars)
		
		if lShow
			Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Show()
		endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlararticulostallecolor
		*@0521/3@
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		Local lTalleColor, lLoteable
		
		lTalleColor = .f.
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		lLoteable = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Lotea")
		
		If !lLoteable
			Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		
			Do While Not Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.EsEof() And ;
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sucursal") 	= cId_Sucursal And;
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema")  	= cId_Sistema And;
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba") 	= cId_Comproba And;
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Nro_Referencia") = nNro_Referencia  
		
				If Not Empty(Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.Leer("Numero"))
					lTalleColor = .t.
					Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.IrUltimo()
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		ENDIF
		
		Return !lTalleColor
		*@0521/3@
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE datoscomprobante
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value = ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_deposito")
		ThisForm.oChkAf_Stock.Value  = ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Stock") <> 0
		Thisform.Tipo_Com	  		 = ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Tipo_Com")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias)
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimiretiquetas
		Local nRegistro,vEtiquetas,nCantEtiquetas,cAux,vGrabar, lEtiqueta, cId_ClienteViejo
		
		Dimension vEtiquetas[1]
		Dimension vGrabar[1,2]
		Afield(vEtiquetas,thisform.oTblAux_Etiquetas.Alias)
		
		if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value   && trabajo con TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES PENDIENTES
		
				=fMensAceptar ("Para Impirmir etiquetas no tiene que estar tildado TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES, " +;
								CHR (13) + "y el Orden Seleccionado tiene que ser por CLIENTE")
		*!*		Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		*!*		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.EsEof()
		
		*!*			lEtiqueta = .f.
		*!*			cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		*!*			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.EsEof() and cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		*!*				If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Imprime")
		*!*					lEtiqueta = .t.
		*!*				Endif
		*!*				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
		*!*			enddo
		
		*!*			If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_ClienteViejo) and lEtiqueta
		*!*				for i=1 to alen(vEtiquetas,1)
		*!*					cAux="thisform.oTblClientes.leer('"+vEtiquetas[i,1]+"')"
		*!*					=fGrabar(@vGrabar	,vEtiquetas[i,1]	,&cAux)
		*!*				Endfor
		*!*				Thisform.oTblAux_Etiquetas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		EndDo
		*!*		thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		else
			if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
				=fMensAceptar ("Para Impirmir etiquetas no tiene que estar tildado TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES, " +;
								CHR (13) + "y el Orden Seleccionado tiene que ser por CLIENTE")
		*!*			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
		*!*			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof()
		
		*!*				lEtiqueta = .f.
		*!*				cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		*!*				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof() and cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		*!*					If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Imprime")
		*!*						lEtiqueta = .t.
		*!*					Endif
		*!*					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrSiguiente()
		*!*				enddo
		
		*!*				If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_ClienteViejo) and lEtiqueta
		*!*					for i=1 to alen(vEtiquetas,1)
		*!*						cAux="thisform.oTblClientes.leer('"+vEtiquetas[i,1]+"')"
		*!*						=fGrabar(@vGrabar	,vEtiquetas[i,1]	,&cAux)
		*!*					Endfor
		*!*					Thisform.oTblAux_Etiquetas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
		*!*				Endif
		*!*			EndDo
		*!*			thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
			else
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
					lEtiqueta = .f.
					cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Cliente")
					Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof() and cId_ClienteViejo = thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Cliente")
						If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Imprime")
							lEtiqueta = .t.
						Endif
						thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
					enddo
		
					If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_ClienteViejo) and lEtiqueta
						for i=1 to alen(vEtiquetas,1)
							cAux="thisform.oTblClientes.leer('"+vEtiquetas[i,1]+"')"
							=fGrabar(@vGrabar	,vEtiquetas[i,1]	,&cAux)
						Endfor
						Thisform.oTblAux_Etiquetas.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabar,.t.)
					Endif
				EndDo
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				LABEL FORM "etiquetas.lbx" NAME oETIQUETA TO PRINTER PROMPT
			endif	
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value   && trabajo con TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES PENDIENTES
			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.EsEof()
				If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Imprime")
					Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
					If nCopias=0
						nCopias = 1
					Endif
					Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),;
									  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Sistema"),;
									  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Id_Comproba"),;
									  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
				Endif
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
			thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		else
			if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof()
					If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Imprime")
						Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
						nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
						If nCopias=0
							nCopias = 1
						Endif
						Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )
					Endif
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrSiguiente()
				EndDo
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
			else
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
					If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Imprime")
						Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
						nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
						If nCopias=0
							nCopias = 1
						Endif
						Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Sistema"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),;
										  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )
					Endif
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
				EndDo
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
			endif	
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		Local vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_timer1.Interval = 300000
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"           							,"Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu"									,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_docuBis"           							,"Tg_Tabla","Vnt_DocuBis"									,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblDescarga"           							,"Tg_Tabla","Descarga"									,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblDescargaAutomatica" 							,"Tg_Tabla","DescargaAutomatica"						,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Detalle"   								    ,"Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Detalle"								,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"       							    ,"Tg_Tabla","Clientes"									,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecera"          							,"Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Cabecera"								,"Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica","Tg_ViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblparametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		IF Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("descargaindividualbluecar")
			Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas"					,"Tg_ViewComprobantesPendientesVentasBluecar")
			Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente"			,"Tg_ViewComprobantesPendientesVentasClienteBluecar")
		Else
			Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas"					,"Tg_ViewComprobantesPendientesVentas")
			Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente"			,"Tg_ViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente")
		Endif
			
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Etiquetas","Tg_Tabla","Aux_Etiquetas")
		
		Thisform.OldComprobante=""
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod(" /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value = 0 
		
		*thisform.oCmbComprobantes.SetearTodos()
		*thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value = "TD"
		
		ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Filtrar("cobranza=.f. and oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',id_Comproba,'A',oApp.CodSistema('Ventas')) And oApp.BuscarDescarga(oApp.CodSistema('Ventas')+Id_Comproba,.f.,'Clave')")
		ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.Tipo_Com = ""
		Thisform.DatosComprobante(Thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value)
		
		thisform.oChkTodos.Value = .f.  && me indica si selecciono TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES O SOLAMENTE LOS QUE DESCARGAN DEL COMPROBANTE SELECCIONADO EN EL COMBO
		
		thisform.tg_CmbCamiones1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCamiones1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .f.  && en esta propiedad lo que indico es que en caso de hacer LA IMPRESION MASIVA, NO SE HAGA EL METODO REFRESCAR APLICACION
		
		ThisForm.oSpnTiempo.Value=5
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.CurrentControl = "TG_CHECKBOX1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.Sparse         = .f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly       = .f.
		
		If Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("DesHabilitaAfStock")
			ThisForm.oChkAf_Stock.Enabled = .f.
		Endif
		
		** EN CASO DE NO TENER EL PARAMETRO DE IMPRESION DE LOS COMPROBANTES DESCARGADOS AUTOMATICAMENTE, 
		** O LA POSIBILIDAD DE DESCARGAR COMPROBANTES POR CLIENTE, NO APARECE EL BOTON.
		If Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("Imprime_Descarga_Automatica")
			ThisForm.oCmdDescargaAutomatica.Visible = .t.
			thisform.oChkTodos.Value = .T.
		else
			if !Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("Imprime_Descarga_Automatica") and !Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("SumarizaFacturacionPorCliente")
				ThisForm.oCmdDescargaAutomatica.Visible = .f.  && BOTON ME QUEDA NO VISIBLE, PORQUE NO TIENE LA POSIBILIDAD DE LOS PARAMETROS
			endif	
		Endif
		*********************************************************************************************************************.
		
		thisform.oChkSumarizaComproba.Value = Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("SumarizaFacturacionPorCliente")
		if Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("SumarizaFacturacionPorCliente") and !thisform.oChkTodos.Value
			thisform.Tg_optOrden.Value = 2
			thisform.Tg_optOrden.Enabled = .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.oCmdImprimir.Enabled    = .t.
		thisform.oCmdImprimirEtiquetas.Enabled = .t.
		thisform.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled = .t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrardatosoperacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		IF !THISFORM.DescargaAutomatica  && en caso de NO SER DESCARGA AUTOMATICA HAGO EL REFRESCAR, SINO NO LO HAGO PORQUE VUELVE AL PRIMER REGISTRO E INTENTA IMPRIMIR
			Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local vComprobantes, cId_Camion, lCtaCorriente
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCamiones1.Value = "TD"
			cId_Camion = ""
		Else
			cId_Camion = ThisForm.Tg_cmbCamiones1.Value
		Endif
		
		lCtaCorriente = .F.
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value,'A',oApp.CodSistema('Ventas'))
		
			 
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource     = ""
		
			Dimension vComprobantes[1]
			vComprobantes[1]=" "
		
			thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
			IF Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("descargaindividualbluecar")
				***	En caso de haber seleccionado TODOS los comprobantes, trabajo con la relación establecida en Vnt_Docu, por cada CATEGORIA DE IVA DE CLIENTE
				if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion)
				else
					** SE TRABAJA COMO ANTES, CON EL COMPROBANTE QUE SE SELECCIONO PARA LA DESCARGA
					if thisForm.oTblVnt_docuBis.buscar(thisForm.oCmbComprobantes.value, .F., "Clave")
						lCtaCorriente = thisForm.oTblVnt_docuBis.leer("DescargaCtaCorriente")
					endIf
		
					Thisform.oTblDescarga.Buscar(oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")+Thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value,.f.,"Clave")
					do while !thisForm.oTblDescarga.esEoF() AND thisForm.oTblDescarga.esClaveIgual()				
					 
						If Type("vComprobantes") = "L"
							Dimension vComprobantes[1]
						Else
							Dimension vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes) +1 ]
						Endif
						vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes)] = Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Com_Bas")	
						Thisform.oTblDescarga.IrSiguiente()
					endDo
		
					If Type("vComprobantes") <> "L"
						** ME FIJO QUE VISTA LLAMAR DE ACUERDO AL ORDEN SELECCIONADO
						if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
							Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion, lCtaCorriente)
						else
							Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion, lCtaCorriente)
						endif	
					Endif
				endif		
			Else
				***	En caso de haber seleccionado TODOS los comprobantes, trabajo con la relación establecida en Vnt_Docu, por cada CATEGORIA DE IVA DE CLIENTE
				if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion)
				else
					** SE TRABAJA COMO ANTES, CON EL COMPROBANTE QUE SE SELECCIONO PARA LA DESCARGA
					Thisform.oTblDescarga.Buscar(oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")+Thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value,.f.,"Clave")
					Do While Not Thisform.oTblDescarga.EsEof() And;
						 Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Sistema") = oApp.CodSistema("Ventas") And ;
						 thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Comproba") = Thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value
					 
						If Type("vComprobantes") = "L"
							Dimension vComprobantes[1]
						Else
							Dimension vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes) +1 ]
						Endif
						vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes)] = Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Com_Bas")	
						Thisform.oTblDescarga.IrSiguiente()
					EndDo
		
					If Type("vComprobantes") <> "L"
						** ME FIJO QUE VISTA LLAMAR DE ACUERDO AL ORDEN SELECCIONADO
						if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
							Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion)
						else
							Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_ReferenciaDesde.Value,Thisform.Tipo_Com, cId_Camion)
						endif	
					Endif
				endif	
			ENDIF
			
			Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
			thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()	
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("No posee permiso para confeccionar ese tipo de comprobante!")
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value   && trabajo con TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES PENDIENTES
			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias
		
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Id_Sistema"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Fecha"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Id_Cliente"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".nombre"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Total"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Nro_Externo"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Alias + ".Imprime"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		else
			if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1    
			
			    * edgardo pase version tasas ivas
			    * damedco  && por si lee de esta vista no tenia en cuenta los no autorizados
		    	 Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
		
		        Do while !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof()
		           if !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Autorizado")
		              Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Borrar()
		           endif   
		           Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrSiguiente()
		        Enddo
		        *damedco
		
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
		
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias
		
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Id_Sistema"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Fecha"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Id_Cliente"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".nombre"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Total"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Nro_Externo"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Alias + ".Imprime"
			else
			
			    * edgardo pase version tasas ivas
			    * damedco  && por si lee de esta vista no tenia en cuenta los no autorizados
		    	 Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
		
		        Do while !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
		           if !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Autorizado")
		              Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Borrar()
		           endif   
		           Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
		        Enddo
		        *damedco
			
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
		
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Id_Sistema"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Fecha"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Id_Cliente"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".nombre"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Total"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Nro_Externo"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Alias + ".Imprime"
			endif
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
			
		endif
		Thisform.LockScreen =.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		if ThisForm.oChkTodos.Value   && trabajo con TODOS LOS COMPROBANTES PENDIENTES
			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.EsEof()
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
				thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
			EnDDo
		else
			if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof()
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrSiguiente()
				EnDDo
			else
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
					thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
				EnDDo
			endif	
		endif
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearreloj
		ThisForm.Tg_timer1.Interval = ((ThisForm.oSpnTiempo.Value*60) * 1000)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
		Local lContinua
		
		lContinua = .t.
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value) And ThisForm.oChkAf_Stock.Value
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el deposito!")
			ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.SetFocus()
			lContinua = .f.
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Empty(ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el tipo de comprobante!")
			ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.SetFocus()
			lContinua = .f.
		Endif
		
		Return lContinua
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkAf_Stock.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Enabled = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkAf_Stock.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Enabled = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ochksumarizacomproba.InteractiveChange
		if !thisform.oChkTodos.Value
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 2
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Enabled = !This.Value
		endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ochksumarizacomproba.ProgrammaticChange
		if !thisform.oChkTodos.Value
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 2
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Enabled = !This.Value
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkTodos.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Enabled = !This.Value
		
		thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
		
		if thisform.oChkSumarizaComproba.Value and !this.Value
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 2
		endif
		
		thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Enabled = !This.Value
		
		Thisform.DatosComprobante(Thisform.oCmbComprobantes.Value)
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkTodos.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Enabled = !This.Value
		
		thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
		
		if thisform.oChkSumarizaComproba.Value and !this.Value
			thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Value = 2
		endif
		
		thisform.Tg_OptOrden.Enabled = !This.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbComprobantes.InteractiveChange
		If Thisform.OldComprobante <> This.Value
			Thisform.DatosComprobante(This.Value)
			Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			Thisform.OldComprobante = This.Value
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbComprobantes.LostFocus
		Thisform.DatosComprobante(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDescargaAutomatica.Click
		Local lShow, lGeneraComproba, nCantRenglones, vVectorDescarga, nInd
		
		Dimension vVectorDescarga [1]
		nInd = 0
		lShow = .f.
		thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .t.
		
		if thisform.oChkTodos.Value
			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.EsEof()
		
				if Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.Leer("Imprime")
					Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobante(lShow)
					Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Grabar()
					Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Imprimir()
					Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante=""
				endif
				
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
			Enddo
		
			thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .F.
			THISFORM.RefrescarConsulta()  && HAGO EL ULTIMO REFRESCARCONSULTA PARA QUE ME LIMPIE LA GRILLA
			Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasDescargaAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		else
			if !thisform.oChkSumarizaComproba.Value  && TRABAJO CON LA DESCARGA POR CADA COMPROBANTE
			
				if thisform.tg_OptOrden.Value = 1
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
					Do While !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.EsEof()
		
						If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.Leer("Imprime")
							Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobante(lShow)
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Grabar()
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Imprimir()
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante=""
						endif
						
						Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrSiguiente()
					Enddo
		
					thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .F.
					THISFORM.RefrescarConsulta()  && HAGO EL ULTIMO REFRESCARCONSULTA PARA QUE ME LIMPIE LA GRILLA
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentas.IrPrimero()
				else
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
					Do While !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
		
						If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Imprime")
							Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobante(lShow)
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Grabar()
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Imprimir()
							Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante=""
						endif
						
						Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
					Enddo
		
					thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .F.
					THISFORM.RefrescarConsulta()  && HAGO EL ULTIMO REFRESCARCONSULTA PARA QUE ME LIMPIE LA GRILLA
					Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				endif	
			
			ELSE  && TRABAJO CON LA DESCARGA AGRUPANDO LOS COMPROBANTES POR CADA CLIENTE
			
				thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value)
				nRenglonMaximo = thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Reng_Max")
				
		
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				Do While !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof()
					nCant           = 0
					nRenglon        = 0
					nCantRenglones  = 0
					lGeneraComproba = .f.
		
					Dimension vVectorDescarga[1]
					vVectorDescarga = ""
					Dimension thisform.Mat_Descarga[1,24]
					thisform.Mat_Descarga[1,1] = ""
					
					thisform.Id_Cliente = Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Cliente")
					Do While !Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.EsEof() and;
						      Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Id_Cliente") = thisform.Id_cliente and;
						      nRenglon < nRenglonMaximo
						
						If  thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Imprime")
							lGeneraComproba = .t.
							nCant = nCant + 1
							nCantRenglones = thisform.CargarVector()
							nRenglon = nRenglon + nCantRenglones
							
							** COMPLETO EL VECTOR CON LOS NUMEROS DE DESCARGA
							if type("vVectorDescarga") = "L" OR vVectorDescarga = ""
								nInd = 0
							else
								nInd = alen(vVectorDescarga,1)
							endif
		
							nInd = nInd + 1
							Dimension vVectorDescarga[nInd]
							vVectorDescarga[nInd] = ""
							vVectorDescarga[nInd] = RIGHT(ALLTRIM(thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.Leer("Nro_Externo")),5)
							******************** FIN DE ARMADO DEL VECTOR **************************
						endif	
						Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrSiguiente()
					enddo
					
					if lGeneraComproba
						Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobanteCliente(.t.)  && muestro la factura que se genera para ver que queda
						Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Grabar(@vVectorDescarga)
						Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Imprimir()
						Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante = ""
					endif	
				enddo	
					
				thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .F.
				THISFORM.RefrescarConsulta()  && HAGO EL ULTIMO REFRESCARCONSULTA PARA QUE ME LIMPIE LA GRILLA
				Thisform.oViewComprobantesPendientesVentasCliente.IrPrimero()
				
			endif	
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdImprimir.Click
		Thisform.ImprimirLotes()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdImprimirEtiquetas.Click
		do while !thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.EsTablaVacia()
			thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.IrPrimero()
			thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.borrar()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.ImprimirEtiquetas()
		
		do while !thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.EsTablaVacia()
			thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.IrPrimero()
			thisform.otblaux_etiquetas.borrar()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdRefrescar.Click
		If Thisform.ValidarDatos()
			Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			Thisform.SetearReloj()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		Thisform.Seleccionar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oSpnTiempo.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		If nKeyCode = 13
			Thisform.SetearReloj()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oSpnTiempo.LostFocus
		Thisform.SetearReloj()
			
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Local lShow
		
		lShow = .t.
		thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .f.
		
		Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobante(lShow)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optorden.InteractiveChange
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_timer1.Timer
		If Not Empty(ThisForm.oCmbComprobantes.Value) AND !THISFORM.DescargaAutomatica  && en caso de NO SER DESCARGA AUTOMATICA HAGO EL REFRESCAR.
			Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarcolores
		Local nColores, cShape
		nColores = 0
		
		For nColores = 1 to 10
			cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
			&cShape..visible = .F.
		EndFor
		
		nColores = 0
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.esEof()
		
			If nColores < 11
				nColores = nColores + 1
				cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
				&cShape..backColor = thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.leer("color")
				&cShape..visible = .T.
			EndIf
			
			thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatos
		lParameters id_listaPrecios, id_deposito, cCodArticulo
		LOCAL cFiltro 
		
		&&Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		thisform.id_listaPrecios = id_listaPrecios
		thisform.id_deposito = id_deposito
		** Mariano 13/06 nueva propiedad**
		thisform.id_articuloHeredado = cCodArticulo
		** Mariano 13/06 nueva propiedad**
		
		thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value 	 = id_listaPrecios
		thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.enabled 	 = .F.
		thisform.oCmbDepositos.enabled 		 = .F.
		thisform.oCmbDepositos.value 		 = id_deposito
		 
		** Mariano 13/06 **
		thisform.oTbxCodigo.Value 	= allTrim(thisForm.id_articuloHeredado)
		
		ThisForm.tg_commandbutton2.Visible = .T.
		thisForm.tg_commandbutton1.Visible = .T.
		thisForm.ControlBox = .F.
		thisForm.MinButton = .F.
		thisForm.Closable = .F.
		
		IF !EMPTY(thisform.oTbxCodigo.Value)
			&&Thisform.Refrescarconsulta()
			Thisform.Filtrarbusqueda()
			thisform.oGrdBusqueda.SetFocus
		
		Endif
		** Mariano 13/06 **
	ENDPROC

		thisform.oGrdDepositos.refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartalles
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption = ""
		
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.esEof()
			if empty(thisform.oLblTalles.caption)
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			else
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = thisform.oLblTalles.caption + " - " + alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darvector
		LPARAMETERS vArticulos
		
		Local i
		**	SERGIO 22/08/22 #1533
		Local lValor, lBorraSeleccionados, vGrabacion
		
		If oApp.DarParametroGeneral("BORRA_SELECCIONADOS","L",@lValor) && Parametro Encontrado
			lBorraSeleccionados = lValor
		Else
			lBorraSeleccionados = lValor
		Endif
		
		If lBorraSeleccionados
			Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		Endif
		**	SERGIO 22/08/22 #1533
		
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.IrPrimero()
		i = 1
		Do while !thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.EsEof()
			IF thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Leer("Seleccionado")
				DIMENSION vArticulos(i, 1)
				vArticulos[i,1] = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		
		**		SERGIO 22/08/22 #1533
				If lBorraSeleccionados
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"seleccionado",.F.)
					Thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.F.,.T.)
				Endif
		**		SERGIO 22/08/22 #1533
		
		
		
				i = i + 1
			ENDIF 
			thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArticulosPrecioStock", "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewDepositosArticulo", 	"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockDepositos")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewListasPreciosArticulo","tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockListasPrecios")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTallesArticulo",		"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockTalles")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewColoresArticulo",		"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockColores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros", "tg_tabla", "parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImagenesArt",  "tg_tabla", "Imagenes_Articulos", "CLAVE")
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource= ""
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource= ""
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption = ""
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbRubros.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbRubros.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.id_listaPrecios = ""
		thisform.id_deposito = ""
		** Chiara 23/10/18
		thisform.enter = .T.
		** Chiara 23/10/18
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.resaltarRenglon()
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.ResaltarRenglon
		Thisform.oGrdBusqueda.ResaltarRenglon
		
		thisform.tg_shape1.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape2.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape3.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape4.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape5.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape6.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape7.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape8.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape9.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape10.visible = .F.
		
		
		
		
		** Mariano 14/06 **
		thisForm.oCmbDepositos.irPrimero()
		thisForm.oCmbListasPrecios.irPrimero()
		thisForm.ControlBox = .T.
		thisForm.Closable = .T.
		thisForm.MinButton = .T.
		** Mariano 14/06 **
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource=""
		
		if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C"
			thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value
		endif
		
		if empty(thisform.id_deposito) or type("thisform.id_deposito") <> "C"
			thisform.id_deposito = thisform.oCmbDepositos.value
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Refrescar(;
			thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"), thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito,;

		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera

			CASE nKeyCode = -2 && F3
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos","tg_formSeleccionProductosAlternativos")
				thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.setear(thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito, this.value, .F.)
				thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.show()

					This.Value = thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.artSeleccionado
					This.Valid()
					thisForm.tg_commandbutton2.Click()
				endif
		
			CASE nKeyCode = 13 && ENTER
				thisform.cancelado = .F.
				** Chiara 23/10/18
				thisform.enter = .t.
				** Chiara 23/10/18
				thisform.id_articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
				thisform.hide()
		ENDCASE
		
	ENDPROC

		cId_lista = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.leer("id_lista")
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmAuxiliar")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAuxiliar","tg_AbmPreciosTalle", cId_articulo, cId_lista, .F.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmAuxiliar.setup(cId_articulo, cId_lista, .F.)			
		Endif

	ENDPROC

		endIf
		thisForm.oFormImagenArticulos.setear(thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		LOCAL nRegAnt
		
		thisform.cancelado = .F.
		** Chiara 23/10/18
		
		IF TYPE("thisform.id_articulo") <> "C"
			thisform.id_articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
		ELSE
			thisform.id_articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
		ENDIF
		
		nRegAnt=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Recno()
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.IrPrimero()
		DO WHILE !thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.EsEof()
			
			IF thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Leer("Seleccionado")
				Thisform.Enter = .F.		
			ENDIF 
		
			thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.IrSiguiente()
		ENDDO 
		
		If nRegAnt>0
			thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.IrRegistro(nRegAnt)
		ENDIF
		
		** Chiara 23/10/18
		thisform.hide()
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarcolores
		Local nColores, cShape
		nColores = 0
		
		For nColores = 1 to 10
			cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
			&cShape..visible = .F.
		EndFor
		
		nColores = 0
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.esEof()
		
			If nColores < 11
				nColores = nColores + 1
				cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
				&cShape..backColor = thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.leer("color")
				&cShape..visible = .T.
			EndIf
			
			thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatos
		lParameters id_listaPrecios, id_deposito, id_articulo
		
		thisform.id_listaPrecios = id_listaPrecios
		thisform.id_deposito = id_deposito
		thisform.id_articuloHeredado = ALLTRIM(id_articulo)
		
		thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value = id_listaPrecios
		thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.enabled = .F.
		thisform.oCmbDepositos.value = id_deposito
		thisform.oCmbDepositos.enabled = .F.
		
		thisform.refrescarConsulta()
		
		** Mariano 13/06 **
		
		thisform.oTbxCodigo.Value = ALLTRIM(thisForm.id_articuloHeredado)
		IF !EMPTY(thisform.oTbxCodigo.Value)
			thisForm.filtroCodigo = thisform.oTbxCodigo.Value
			thisForm.filtrarbusqueda()
		endIf
		thisForm.tg_commandbutton2.Visible = .T.
		thisForm.ControlBox = .F.
		thisForm.MinButton = .F.
	ENDPROC

				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			else
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = thisform.oLblTalles.caption + " - " + alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrarbusqueda
		** Mariano 13/06 **
		local filtroDescInvertido, nPosicionSimboloClave, cFiltro
		
		if type("thisform.filtroDesc") <> "L" AND AT("*",thisform.filtroDesc) <> 0
			nPosicionSimboloClave = AT("*",thisform.filtroDesc)
			IF len(allTrim(thisform.filtroDesc)) <> nPosicionSimboloClave
				filtroDescInvertido = subStr(thisform.filtroDesc,nPosicionSimboloClave+1)
				filtroDescInvertido = allTrim(filtroDescInvertido)+"*"+SUBSTR(thisform.filtroDesc,1,nPosicionSimboloClave-1)
			endIf
		endIf
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.desFiltrar()
		** Versión original **
		*!*	thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.filtrar(;
		*!*		"like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroCodigo") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroCodigo)))+"*',UPPER(id_articulo)) " + ;
		*!*		"and like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroDesc") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroDesc)))+"*',UPPER(nombre)) " + ;
		*!*		"and like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroBarras") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroBarras)))+"*',UPPER(codigo_barras))")
		*!*	thisform.oGrdBusqueda.refresh()
		** Versión original **
		
		if thisform.ochbBusquedaCombinada.Value
			cFiltro = "(like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroCodigo") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroCodigo)))+"*',UPPER(id_articulo)) " + ;
					  "or like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroDesc") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroDesc)))+"*',UPPER(id_articulo))) "
		else
			cFiltro = "like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroCodigo") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroCodigo)))+"*',UPPER(id_articulo)) " 
		endIf
		
		if type("filtroDescInvertido") <> "L"
			cFiltro = cFiltro + "or (like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroDesc") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroDesc)))+"*',UPPER(nombre)) " + ;
				"or like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("filtroDescInvertido") = "L", "", UPPER(filtroDescInvertido)))+"*',UPPER(nombre))) "
		else
			cFiltro = cFiltro + "or like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroDesc") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroDesc)))+"*',UPPER(nombre)) "
		endIf
		cFiltro = cFiltro+ "or like('*"+ALLTRIM(iif(TYPE("thisform.filtroBarras") = "L", "", UPPER(thisform.filtroBarras)))+"*',UPPER(codigo_barras))"
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.filtrar(cFiltro)
		thisForm.oGrdBusqueda.Refresh()
		** Mariano 13/06 **
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArticulosPrecioStock", "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewDepositosArticulo", 	"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockDepositos")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewListasPreciosArticulo","tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockListasPrecios")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTallesArticulo",		"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockTalles")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewColoresArticulo",		"tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockColores")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros", "tg_tabla", "parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos",  "tg_tabla", "articulos", "CLAVE")
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource= ""
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource= ""
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption = ""
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbRubros.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbRubros.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.id_listaPrecios = ""
		thisform.id_deposito = ""
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.resaltarRenglon()
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.resaltarRenglon()
		
		thisform.tg_shape1.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape2.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape3.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape4.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape5.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape6.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape7.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape8.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape9.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape10.visible = .F.
		
		** Mariano 14/06 **
		thisForm.oCmbDepositos.irPrimero()
		thisForm.oCmbListasPrecios.irPrimero()
		thisForm.refrescarConsulta()
		thisForm.ControlBox = .T.
		thisForm.MinButton = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource=""
		
		if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C"
			thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value
		endif
		
		if empty(thisform.id_deposito) or type("thisform.id_deposito") <> "C"
			thisform.id_deposito = thisform.oCmbDepositos.value
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Refrescar(;
			thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"), thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito,;
			thisform.oCmbMarcas.value, thisform.oCmbRubros.value, thisform.oCmbSubrubros.value)
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias
		thisform.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".id_articulo"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".precio"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".stock"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".codigo_barras"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".marca"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".iva"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".imp_int"
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdBusqueda.Column1.Text1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		local lEncontrado
		
		if nKeyCode = -2 && F3
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos","tg_formSeleccionProductosAlternativos")
			thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.setear(thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito, this.value, .F.)
			thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.show()
			if !thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.Cancelado
				This.Value = thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.artSeleccionado
				This.Valid()
				thisForm.tg_commandbutton2.Click()
			endif
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		Local cId_Articulo
		cId_Articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		If !Empty(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoTalle")) And !Empty(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoColor"))
					
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor","TG_ConsStockGralStockTalleColor")				
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor.Consultar(thisform.oCmbDepositos.Value,thisform.oCmbMarcas.Value,thisform.oCmbRubros.Value,thisform.oCmbSubRubros.Value,cId_Articulo,.f.,.f.,.t.)
		
			thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor.Show()
			
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdListasPrecios.Column3.oCmdListaTalleColor.Click
		LParameters cid_lista
		local cId_articulo, cId_lista
		
		cId_articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
		cId_lista = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.leer("id_lista")
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmAuxiliar")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAuxiliar","tg_AbmPreciosTalle", cId_articulo, cId_lista, .F.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmAuxiliar.setup(cId_articulo, cId_lista, .F.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmAuxiliar.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oImagen.DblClick
		if type("thisForm.oFormImagenArticulos")<>"O"
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormImagenArticulos","tg_formImagenArticulos")
		endIf
		thisForm.oFormImagenArticulos.setear(thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisForm.oFormimagenarticulos.show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxBarras.InteractiveChange
		thisform.filtroBarras = this.value
		thisform.filtrarBusqueda()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxCodigo.InteractiveChange
		thisform.filtroCodigo = this.value
		thisform.filtrarBusqueda()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxDesc.InteractiveChange
		if thisForm.ochbBusquedaCombinada.Value
			thisForm.oTbxCodigo.Value = this.Value
			thisForm.filtrocodigo = this.Value
		endIf
		thisform.filtroDesc = this.value
		thisform.filtrarBusqueda()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.cancelado = .T.
		thisform.hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		thisform.cancelado = .F.
		thisform.id_articulo = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo")
		thisform.hide()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarcolores
		Local nColores, cShape
		nColores = 0
		
		For nColores = 1 to 10
			cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
			&cShape..visible = .F.
		EndFor
		
		nColores = 0
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.esEof()
		
			If nColores < 11
				nColores = nColores + 1
				cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
				&cShape..backColor = thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.leer("color")
				&cShape..visible = .T.
			EndIf
			
			thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatosarticulo
		thisform.cargarImagen()
		thisform.cargarDepositos()
		thisform.cargarListasPrecios()
		thisform.cargarTalles()
		thisform.cargarColores()
		thisform.cargarDetalle()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardepositos
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"), thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"))
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias+".deposito"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias+".saldo"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column3.currentControl = "oCmdDepositosTalleColor"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column3.sparse = .F.
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardetalle
		thisform.oCmbMarcaArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_marca")
		thisform.oCmbRubroArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_rubro")
		thisform.oCmbSubRubroArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_subrubro")
		thisform.oTbxAlicuotaIVA.Value 		= thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("iva")
		thisform.oTbxUnidadMedida.value 	= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("uni_medida")
		thisform.oTbxCoefUnidadMedida.value = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("coef_uni_med2")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarimagen
		IF thisForm.oTblImagenes_articulos.buscar(thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"), .F., "Clave")
			thisform.oImagen.picture = thisForm.oTblImagenes_articulos.leer("ruta")
		endIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarlistasprecios
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource=""
		
		** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"),thisform.lpermiterefrescarlistaprecios )
		*thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource=thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".lista"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".precio"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".iva_incluido"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".int_incluido"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column6.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".nomMoneda"
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.currentControl = "tg_checkbox1"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.currentControl = "tg_checkbox1"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column3.currentControl = "oCmdListaTalleColor"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column3.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartalles
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption = ""
		
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.esEof()
			if empty(thisform.oLblTalles.caption)
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			else
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = thisform.oLblTalles.caption + " - " + alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrarbusqueda
		*** mATIAS l. 16/01/2023 #1567
		
		*!*	** Mariano 13/06 **
		*!*	local filtroDescInvertido, nPosicionSimboloClave, cFiltro
		
		*!*	cBuscar = ALLTRIM(UPPER(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value))
		
		*!*	Thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.desFiltrar()
		
		*!*	cFiltro =  "like('*" + cBuscar + "*',UPPER(detalle))"
		
		*!*	thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.filtrar(cFiltro)
		
		*!*	thisForm.oGrdBusqueda.Refresh()
		*!*	** Mariano 13/06 **
		
		
		
		
		LOCAL vBusqueda,cCampos,cCamposInvertido, cCodigo ,cBusqueda 
		
		cCodigo = Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value
		cBusqueda = ""
		cCampos = ""
		cCamposInvertido = ""
		
		 
		IF EMPTY(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value)
			cStringBuscar = ".T. = .T."
		ELSE
			If substr(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value,len(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value),1) <> "*"
				cCodigo = ALLTRIM(UPPER(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value))
			ENDIF
			cCodigo = STRTRAN(ALLTRIM(UPPER(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value))," ","*")
		ENDIF
		
		IF EMPTY(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value)
			cStringBuscarInvertido = ".T. = .T."
		ELSE
			If substr(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value,len(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value),1) <> "*"
				cCodigo = ALLTRIM(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value) + "*"
			ENDIF
			
			cCodigo = STRTRAN(cCodigo," ","*")
		
			nOcurrencias = 1
			nPosIncial = 1
			nPosFinal  = 1
		
			Do While nPosFinal < len(cCodigo)
		
				nPosFinal = at("*",cCodigo,nOcurrencias)
				nCarcBsq = nPosFinal - nPosIncial
				cDato = SubStr(cCodigo,nPosIncial,nCarcBsq)
		
				nPosIncial = nPosFinal + 1
				
				Dimension vBusqueda[nOcurrencias]
				vBusqueda[nOcurrencias] = cDato
				nOcurrencias = nOcurrencias + 1
			EndDo
		
			nDecrecimiento = 0
			cFiltro = ""
			cBusqueda = ""
			For nIncremento = 1 To Alen(vBusqueda)
				IF nIncremento = 1
					cBusqueda = Alltrim(vBusqueda[Alen(vBusqueda)-nDecrecimiento])
				ELSE 
					cBusqueda = cBusqueda + "*" + Alltrim(vBusqueda[Alen(vBusqueda)-nDecrecimiento])
				ENDIF 
				nDecrecimiento = nIncremento
			ENDFOR	
		ENDIF
		
		
		cCampos = "Id_articulo" + [ + " " +] + "Detalle" 
		cCamposInvertido = "Detalle"  + [ + " " +] + "id_articulo"
		
		
		cStringBuscar = [like("*] + cCodigo + [*",] + cCampos +[) or LIKE("*] + cCodigo + [*",] + cCamposInvertido + [)]
		cStringBuscarInvertido = [like("*] + Alltrim(UPPER(cBusqueda)) + [*",]+ cCampos +[) or LIKE("*] + Alltrim(UPPER(cBusqueda)) + [*",] + cCamposInvertido + [)]
		
		
		cFiltro = cStringBuscar + " Or " + cStringBuscarInvertido 
		
		thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Desfiltrar()
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		
		
		thisForm.oGrdBusqueda.Refresh()
		
		*** mATIAS l. 16/01/2023 #1567
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.LockScreen	= .T.	
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = ""
		
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		*!*	if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C" 
		*!*		thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value
		*!*	endif
		
		
		if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C" OR thisform.lPermiterefrescarlistaprecios
			thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value

		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		
		if empty(thisform.id_deposito) or type("thisform.id_deposito") <> "C"

		endif
		
		*** Matias L. 16/01/2022 #1567
		Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value = ""

		*!*												 thisform.oCmbMarcas.value, thisform.oCmbRubros.value, thisform.oCmbSubrubros.value)

													 thisform.oCmbMarcas.value, thisform.oCmbRubros.value, thisform.oCmbSubrubros.value,thisform.lPermiterefrescarlistaprecios)

	PROCEDURE cargarcolores
		Local nColores, cShape
		nColores = 0
		
		For nColores = 1 to 10
			cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
			&cShape..visible = .F.
		EndFor
		
		nColores = 0
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.esEof()
		
			If nColores < 11
				nColores = nColores + 1
				cShape = "thisform.tg_shape" + ALLTRIM(STR(nColores))
				&cShape..backColor = thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.leer("color")
				&cShape..visible = .T.
			EndIf
			
			thisform.oViewColoresArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatosarticulo
		thisform.cargarImagen()
		thisform.cargarDepositos()
		thisform.cargarListasPrecios()
		thisform.cargarTalles()
		thisform.cargarColores()
		thisform.cargarDetalle()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardepositos
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"), thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"))
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias+".deposito"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewDepositosArticulo.Alias+".saldo"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column3.currentControl = "oCmdDepositosTalleColor"
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.Column3.sparse = .F.
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardetalle
		thisform.oCmbMarcaArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_marca")
		thisform.oCmbRubroArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_rubro")
		thisform.oCmbSubRubroArt.value 		= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_subrubro")
		thisform.oTbxAlicuotaIVA.Value 		= thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("iva")
		thisform.oTbxUnidadMedida.value 	= thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("uni_medida")
		thisform.oTbxCoefUnidadMedida.value = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("coef_uni_med2")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarimagen
		IF thisForm.oTblImagenes_articulos.buscar(thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"), .F., "Clave")
			thisform.oImagen.picture = thisForm.oTblImagenes_articulos.leer("ruta")
		endIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarlistasprecios
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource=""
		
		** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"),thisform.lpermiterefrescarlistaprecios )
		*thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource=thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".lista"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".precio"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".iva_incluido"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".int_incluido"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column6.ControlSource = thisform.oViewListasPreciosArticulo.Alias+".nomMoneda"
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.currentControl = "tg_checkbox1"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column4.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.currentControl = "tg_checkbox1"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column5.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column3.currentControl = "oCmdListaTalleColor"
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.Column3.sparse = .F.
		
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargartalles
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption = ""
		
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.refrescar(thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.leer("id_articulo"))
		thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.esEof()
			if empty(thisform.oLblTalles.caption)
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			else
				thisform.oLblTalles.caption = thisform.oLblTalles.caption + " - " + alltrim(thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.leer("talle"))
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewTallesArticulo.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrarbusqueda
		** Mariano 13/06 **
		local filtroDescInvertido, nPosicionSimboloClave, cFiltro
		
		cBuscar = ALLTRIM(UPPER(Thisform.otbxCodigo.Value))
		
		Thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.desFiltrar()
		
		cFiltro =  "like('*" + cBuscar + "*',UPPER(detalle))"
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.filtrar(cFiltro)
		
		thisForm.oGrdBusqueda.Refresh()
		** Mariano 13/06 **
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArticulosPrecioStock"	, "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewTallesArticulo"		, "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockTalles")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewColoresArticulo"		, "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockColores")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewDepositosArticulo"		, "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockDepositos")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewListasPreciosArticulo"	, "tg_viewConsultaArtPrecioStockListasPrecios")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"			, "tg_tabla", "parametros")
		&&thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			, "tg_tabla", "articulos"			, "CLAVE")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblImagenes_Articulos"	, "tg_tabla", "Imagenes_articulos"	, "Clave")
		
		thisform.oLblTalles.caption 			= ""
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource 		= ""
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.RecordSource		= ""
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.RecordSource	= ""
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbRubros.SetearTodos()
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.oCmbMarcas.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbRubros.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.oCmbSubRubros.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.id_deposito 	 = ""
		thisform.id_listaPrecios = ""
		
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		LOCAL lPermiteRefrescarListaPrecios
		oApp.DarParametroGeneral("PERMITECAMBIOLISTA  ","L",@lPermiteRefrescarListaPrecios)
		thisform.lPermiterefrescarlistaprecios = lPermiteRefrescarListaPrecios
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		
		thisform.oGrdDepositos.resaltarRenglon()
		thisform.oGrdListasPrecios.resaltarRenglon()
		
		thisform.tg_shape1.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape2.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape3.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape4.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape5.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape6.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape7.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape8.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape9.visible = .F.
		thisform.tg_shape10.visible = .F.
		
		** Mariano 14/06 **
		thisForm.oCmbDepositos.irPrimero()
		thisForm.oCmbListasPrecios.irPrimero()
		thisForm.refrescarConsulta()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.LockScreen	= .T.	
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = ""
		
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		*!*	if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C" 
		*!*		thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value
		*!*	endif
		
		
		if empty(thisform.id_listaPrecios) or type("thisform.id_listaPrecios") <> "C" OR thisform.lPermiterefrescarlistaprecios
			thisform.id_listaPrecios = thisform.oCmbListasPrecios.value
		endif
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		
		if empty(thisform.id_deposito) or type("thisform.id_deposito") <> "C"
			thisform.id_deposito = thisform.oCmbDepositos.value
		endif
		
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		*!*	thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Refrescar(thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"), thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito,;
		*!*												 thisform.oCmbMarcas.value, thisform.oCmbRubros.value, thisform.oCmbSubrubros.value)
		thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Refrescar(thisform.oTblParametros.leer("id_sucursal"), thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito,;
													 thisform.oCmbMarcas.value, thisform.oCmbRubros.value, thisform.oCmbSubrubros.value,thisform.lPermiterefrescarlistaprecios)
		*** Matias L. 13/07/2022
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias
		thisform.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisform.LockScreen = .F.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.RecordSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias
		
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".id_articulo"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column3.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".precio"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column4.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".stock"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column5.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".codigo_barras"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column6.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".marca"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column7.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".iva"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.Column8.ControlSource = thisform.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.Alias+".imp_int"
		thisform.oGrdBusqueda.refresh()
		thisForm.oViewArticulosPrecioStock.irPrimero()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdBusqueda.Column1.Text1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		local lEncontrado
		
		if nKeyCode = -2 && F3
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos","tg_formSeleccionProductosAlternativos")
			thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.setear(thisform.id_listaPrecios, thisform.id_deposito, this.value, .F.)
			thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.show()
			if !thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.Cancelado
				This.Value = thisform.oFrmSelecccionarArticulosAlternativos.artSeleccionado
				This.Valid()
				thisForm.tg_commandbutton2.Click()
			endif
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdBusqueda.Column2.Text1.Click

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdBusqueda.Column3.Text1.Click
