	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNroREferencia,lEditando
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.t.
		thisform.EditandoConsulta=lEditando
		
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		
		If !thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta
			Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNroREferencia,10))
			thisform.Cliente=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" +thisform.Cliente + "'")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value = thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodSucursal")
			thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva"))
			thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
			thisform.Id_Iva=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva")	
		*!*	Thisform.tg_CommandButton4.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.oVencimiento.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
			ThisForm.oListaPrecios.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_Lista")
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Vendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision")
			ThisForm.oCuit.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cuit")
			ThisForm.DNIFiscal = Round(val(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("DNIFiscal")),0)
			ThisForm.oDNI.Value= ThisForm.DNIFiscal
				
			** SE AGREGAN NUEVOS CAMPOS EN VNT_CABECERA ************
			ThisForm.oContacto1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Contacto1")
			ThisForm.oFax.Value			=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fax")
			ThisForm.oFaxST.Value		=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("FaxST")
			ThisForm.oTelefono1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Telefono1")
			ThisForm.oContactoST.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("ContactoST")
			ThisForm.oTelefonoST.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("TelefonoST")
			********************************************************
			
			ThisForm.oDireccion.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Direccion")
			ThisForm.oLocalidad.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Localidad")
			ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodPos")
			ThisForm.oZonas.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Zona")
		
			** LUCAS 24/06/2010
			ThisForm.oCAE.Value=""
			ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
			ThisForm.CAE=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE")
			ThisForm.fechavenc_cae=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("fechavenc_cae")		
			ThisForm.oCAE.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE")
			ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("fechavenc_cae")
			** LUCAS 24/06/2010	
		
			** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
			thisForm.oCOT.value = ""
			thisForm.oCOT.value = thisForm.oVnt_cabecera.leer("nro_COT")	
			** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
			
			ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Camion")
			
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Expreso")
			ThisForm.oProvincia.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Provincia")
			thisform.oCobrador.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cobrador")
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision_Cobrador")
			ThisForm.Vencimiento=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Vencimiento")
			ThisForm.oVencimiento.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Vencimiento")
			
			*** Matias L. 15/12/2022 #1558	
			IF EMPTY(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE"))
				IF thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("NCPorAnulacionFactura")
					thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.option1.Value = 1
					thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.option2.Value = 0	
					*** Matias L. 12/01/2023 #1558
					thisform.ncporrechazo = .T.
					*** Matias L. 12/01/2023 #1558	
							
				ELSE
					thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.option2.Value = 1
					thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.option1.Value = 0
					
					*** Matias L. 12/01/2023 #1558
					thisform.ncporrechazo = .F.
					*** Matias L. 12/01/2023 #1558	
				ENDIF
				*** Matias L. 06/05/2024 #1754
				thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"NCANULACIONFC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
				*thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"MODIFICACION",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
				*** Matias L. 06/05/2024 #1754
		
			ELSE
				thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = .f.
			endif
			*** Matias L. 15/12/2022 #1558
			
			*** Chiara 21/08/2020	
			IF thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNroREferencia,10),.F.,"Clave")
				thisForm.oMail.Value = thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Leer("Mail")
				thisForm.Mail = thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Leer("Mail")
			ELSE 
				thisForm.oMail.Value = ""
				thisForm.Mail = ""
			ENDIF 
			*** Chiara 21/08/2020
			
			
			
		Endif
		
		
		Thisform.tg_CommandButton3.Enabled=.f.
		Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar2.Enabled=lEditando
		
		*** Matias L. 21/12/2022 #1558
		If !lEditando
			Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar1.Caption="\<Cerrar"
		ELSE
			IF EMPTY(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE"))
				*** Matias L. 06/05/2024 #1754
				thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = lEditando AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"NCANULACIONFC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		*		thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = lEditando AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"MODIFICACION",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
				*** Matias L. 06/05/2024 #1754
			endif
		Endif	
		
		*!*	If !lEditando
		*!*		Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar1.Caption="\<Cerrar"
		*!*	Endif	
		
		*** Matias L. 21/12/2022 #1558
		
		
		ThisForm.oListaPrecios.Enabled=.f.
		*!*	If  thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Vendedor")=0 and thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		If  thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
			*ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando	 and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			*ThisForm.oComision.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando  and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Else	
			*ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando	 and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))	and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Enabled=.f.
		Endif		
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva"))
		ThisForm.oCuit.Enabled=lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CUIT",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable") <> "05"
		ThisForm.oDNI.Enabled=lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CUIT",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable") = "05"
		
		** FALTA AGREGAR EL TEMA DE LOS PERMISOS DE USUARIO
		thisform.oContacto1.Enabled	 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CONTACTO1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefono1.Enabled	 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"TELEFONO1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oContactoST.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CONTACTOST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"TELEFONOST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFax.Enabled		 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"FAX"			,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFaxST.Enabled		 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"FAXST"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		****************************************************
		
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		thisForm.oMail.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"MAILCLIENTE"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled=lEditando
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled=lEditando
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.enabled = lEditando
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		ThisForm.oDireccion.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oLocalidad.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		ThisForm.oVencimiento.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comproba,"VENC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oZonas.Enabled=lEditando 			AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"ZONA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CAMION",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oExpreso.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"EXPRESO",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Enabled=lEditando
		
		
		If  thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Cobrador")=0 and thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
			thisform.oCobrador.Enabled= thisform.Cobranza and lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COBRADOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled= thisform.Cobranza and lEditando AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMICOB",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Else
			thisform.oCobrador.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		** SERGIO 14/11/2024 #1865	&& Se inhabilita la modificación del DNI y CUIT para los casos de comprobantes electrónicos
		** Además se detectó que se puede modificar los datos del CAE, lo cual se consultó con Diego y Angela y también se inhabilitó.
		** No se encontró código que haga referencia a que alguna vez estuvo inhabilitado.
		Thisform.oDNI.Enabled = Iif(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("FE_WS"), .F., .T.)
		Thisform.oCUIT.Enabled = Iif(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("FE_WS"), .F., .T.)
		
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled = Iif(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("FE_WS"), .F., .T.)
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled = Iif(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("FE_WS"), .F., .T.)
		** SERGIO 14/11/2024 #1865
		
		
		thisform.GuardarValores
		thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta=.t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearnuevo
		lParameters cId_Comprobante,cIdCliente,lListaPreciosHabilitado
		
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.f.
		
		thisform.Cliente=cIdCliente
		Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado=lListaPreciosHabilitado
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comprobante)
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		thisform.Remunerativo=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Remunerativo")
		Thisform.list_com_pen=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("list_com_pen")
		
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Iva)
		thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
		*Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		*Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"LISTAPRECIO",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		Else
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COBRADOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza  And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMICOB",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oCuit.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")<>"05"
		thisform.oDNI.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))  And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")="05"
		
		******* FALTAN AGREGAR EL TEMA DE LOS PERMISOS DE ESTOS NUEVOS CAMPOS *********
		thisform.oContacto1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Contacto1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefono1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Telefono1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oContactoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"ContactoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"TelefonoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFax.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Fax"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFaxST.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"FaxST"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		***********************************************************************************************************
		
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		thisForm.oMail.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"MAILCLIENTE",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled=.t.
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.enabled = .T.
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		ThisForm.oDireccion.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oLocalidad.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		** 22/11/22 Sergio, si pide esta ventana al modificar debe estar deshabilitado ya que pudo tomar percepciones
		
		ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And (Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado or !thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Perc"))
		** 22/11/22 Sergio ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oExpreso.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Expreso",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oZonas.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Zona",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Camion",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oVencimiento.Enabled=Thisform.List_Com_Pen AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comprobante,"VENC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" + thisform.Cliente + "'")
		If Empty(Thisform.CodSucursal)
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.IrPrimero()
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value=Thisform.CodSucursal	
		Endif
		
		&& MATIAS L 06/05/2024 #1754
		**** Matias L. 15/12/2022 #1558
		thisform.tg_opgNCRechazo.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"NCANULACIONFC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		**** Matias L. 15/12/2022 #1558
		&& MATIAS L 06/05/2024 #1754
		
		
		thisform.REfresh
		thisform.GuardarValores
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local lcFile,loShell
		
		If !ThisForm.ModoConsulta
			If Type("thisform.ofrmenviomail") <> T_OBJECT
				ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmEnvioMail","TG_FormMailAdjunto","",ThisForm.cliente,.T.,"","V")
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.Show()
			Thisform.oEmailItem=Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.oEmailItem
		Else
			lcFile = 	ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sucursal") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba") +;
						Str(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("nro_referencia"),10)+".msg"
			loShell = CREATEOBJECT("Shell.Application")
			loShell.ShellExecute(lcFile)
			RELEASE loShell
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dardatossucursal
		lParameters cCodSucursal
		
		If thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Buscar(Thisform.Cliente+cCodSucursal,.f.,"Clave")
			ThisForm.oDireccion.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("domicilio")
			ThisForm.oLocalidad.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("localidad")
			ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Value=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("codpostal")
			ThisForm.oProvincia.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("id_provincia")
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value	    =	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("id_expreso")
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNroREferencia,lEditando
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.t.
		thisform.EditandoConsulta=lEditando
		
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		If !thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta
			Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNroREferencia,10))
			thisform.Cliente=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" +thisform.Cliente + "'")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value = thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodSucursal")
			thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva"))
			thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
			thisform.Id_Iva=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva")	
		*!*	Thisform.tg_CommandButton4.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.oVencimiento.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
			ThisForm.oListaPrecios.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_Lista")
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Vendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision")
			ThisForm.oCuit.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cuit")
			ThisForm.DNIFiscal = Round(val(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("DNIFiscal")),0)
			ThisForm.oDNI.Value= ThisForm.DNIFiscal
				
			** SE AGREGAN NUEVOS CAMPOS EN VNT_CABECERA ************
			ThisForm.oContacto1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Contacto1")
			ThisForm.oFax.Value			=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fax")
			ThisForm.oFaxST.Value		=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("FaxST")
			ThisForm.oTelefono1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Telefono1")
			ThisForm.oContactoST.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("ContactoST")
			ThisForm.oTelefonoST.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("TelefonoST")
			********************************************************
			
			ThisForm.oDireccion.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Direccion")
			ThisForm.oLocalidad.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Localidad")
			ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodPos")
			ThisForm.oZonas.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Zona")
		
			** LUCAS 24/06/2010
			ThisForm.oCAE.Value=""
			ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
			ThisForm.CAE=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE")
			ThisForm.fechavenc_cae=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("fechavenc_cae")		
			ThisForm.oCAE.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CAE")
			ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("fechavenc_cae")
			** LUCAS 24/06/2010	
		
			** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
			thisForm.oCOT.value = ""
			thisForm.oCOT.value = thisForm.oVnt_cabecera.leer("nro_COT")	
			** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
			
			ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Camion")
			
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Expreso")
			ThisForm.oProvincia.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Provincia")
			thisform.oCobrador.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cobrador")
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision_Cobrador")
			ThisForm.Vencimiento=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Vencimiento")
			ThisForm.oVencimiento.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Vencimiento")
			
			*** Chiara 21/08/2020	
			IF thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNroREferencia,10),.F.,"Clave")
				thisForm.oMail.Value = thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Leer("Mail")
				thisForm.Mail = thisForm.oTblGtv_Ventas.Leer("Mail")
			ELSE 
				thisForm.oMail.Value = ""
				thisForm.Mail = ""
			ENDIF 
			*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		Endif
		
		
		Thisform.tg_CommandButton3.Enabled=.f.
		Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar2.Enabled=lEditando
		
		If !lEditando
			Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar1.Caption="\<Cerrar"
		Endif	
		ThisForm.oListaPrecios.Enabled=.f.
		*!*	If  thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Vendedor")=0 and thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		If  thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
			*ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando	 and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			*ThisForm.oComision.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando  and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Else	
			*ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled=!thisform.Cobranza and lEditando	 and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))	and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Enabled= lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Enabled=.f.
		Endif		
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva"))
		ThisForm.oCuit.Enabled=lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CUIT",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable") <> "05"
		ThisForm.oDNI.Enabled=lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CUIT",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable") = "05"
		
		** FALTA AGREGAR EL TEMA DE LOS PERMISOS DE USUARIO
		thisform.oContacto1.Enabled	 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CONTACTO1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefono1.Enabled	 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"TELEFONO1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oContactoST.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CONTACTOST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"TELEFONOST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFax.Enabled		 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"FAX"			,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFaxST.Enabled		 = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"FAXST"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		****************************************************
		
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		thisForm.oMail.Enabled = lEditando AND oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"MAILCLIENTE"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled=lEditando
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled=lEditando
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.enabled = lEditando
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		ThisForm.oDireccion.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oLocalidad.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		ThisForm.oVencimiento.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comproba,"VENC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oZonas.Enabled=lEditando 			AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"ZONA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Enabled=lEditando 	AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"CAMION",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oExpreso.Enabled=lEditando 		AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"EXPRESO",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Enabled=lEditando
		
		If  thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Cobrador")=0 and thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
			thisform.oCobrador.Enabled= thisform.Cobranza and lEditando and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COBRADOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled= thisform.Cobranza and lEditando AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"COMICOB",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Else
			thisform.oCobrador.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		thisform.GuardarValores
		thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta=.t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearnuevo

		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comprobante)
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		thisform.Remunerativo=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Remunerativo")
		Thisform.list_com_pen=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("list_com_pen")
		
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Iva)
		thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
		*Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		*Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"LISTAPRECIO",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		Else
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COBRADOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza  And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMICOB",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oCuit.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")<>"05"
		thisform.oDNI.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))  And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")="05"
		
		******* FALTAN AGREGAR EL TEMA DE LOS PERMISOS DE ESTOS NUEVOS CAMPOS *********
		thisform.oContacto1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Contacto1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefono1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Telefono1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oContactoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"ContactoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"TelefonoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFax.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Fax"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFaxST.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"FaxST"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		***********************************************************************************************************
		
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		thisForm.oMail.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"MAILCLIENTE",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled=.t.
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.enabled = .T.
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		ThisForm.oDireccion.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oLocalidad.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		** 22/11/22 Sergio, si pide esta ventana al modificar debe estar deshabilitado ya que pudo tomar percepciones
		
		ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And (Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado or !thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Perc"))
		
		** 22/11/22 Sergio ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oExpreso.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Expreso",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oZonas.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Zona",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Camion",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oVencimiento.Enabled=Thisform.List_Com_Pen AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comprobante,"VENC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" + thisform.Cliente + "'")
		If Empty(Thisform.CodSucursal)
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.IrPrimero()
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value=Thisform.CodSucursal	
		Endif
		
		thisform.REfresh
		thisform.GuardarValores
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearpredeterminado
		thisform.oClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Cliente)
		thisform.oListaPrecios.Value = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Lista")
		thisform.oVendedor.Value     = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Vendedor")
		thisform.Tipo_Iva            = Thisform.oClientes.Leer("Id_iva")
		thisform.oCuit.Value         = thisform.oClientes.leer("Cuit")
		thisform.oDNI.Value          = thisform.oClientes.leer("AfipNroDocumento")
		
		** SE AGREGAN CAMPOS PARA TELECTRONICA
		thisform.oContacto1.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Contacto1")
		thisform.oTelefono1.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Telefono1")
		thisform.oContactoST.Value   = thisform.oClientes.leer("ContactoST")
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Value   = thisform.oClientes.leer("TelefonoST")
		thisform.oFax.Value          = thisform.oClientes.leer("Fax")
		thisform.oFaxST.Value        = thisform.oClientes.leer("FaxST")
		**************************************
		
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		thisForm.oMail.Value 		 = thisform.oClientes.leer("Internet")
		*** Chiara 21/08/2020
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value)
			thisform.oDireccion.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Direccion")
			thisform.oLocalidad.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Localidad")
			thisform.oCodigoPostal.Value = thisform.oClientes.leer("CodPos")
			thisform.oprovincia.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Provincia")
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value      = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Expreso")
		Else
			Thisform.DarDatosSucursal(ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value)
		Endif
		
		ThisForm.oZonas.Value   = thisform.oClientes.leer("id_zona")
		
		Thisform.oTblZonasCamiones.Buscar(thisform.oClientes.leer("id_zona"),.f.,"Id_Zona")
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Value = Thisform.oTblZonasCamiones.Leer("Id_Camion")
		If Empty(ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Value)
			ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.IrPrimero()
		Endif
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Value = ""
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value = cTod("  /  /")
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.value = ""
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		thisform.oVencimiento.Value = ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(Thisform.Id_iva)
		thisform.oTipoIva.Value     = thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
		
		thisform.oVendedores.Buscar(Thisform.oClientes.Leer("id_vendedor"),.f.,"Clave")
		thisform.oComision.Value = thisform.oVendedores.leer("Comision")
		
		thisform.oCobradores.Buscar(Thisform.oClientes.Leer("id_Cobrador"),.f.,"Clave")
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Value = thisform.oCobradores.leer("Comision")
		
		thisform.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbsuc_clientes.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.DarDatosSucursal(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbsuc_clientes.ProgrammaticChange
		Thisform.DarDatosSucursal(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCobrador.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oCobradores.Buscar(this.Value)
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Value=thisform.oCobradores.leer("Comision")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oVendedor.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oComision.Value=thisform.oVendedores.leer("Comision")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar2.Click
		thisform.GuardarValores
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta or thisform.EditandoConsulta
			thisform.ReestablecerValores
		Endif	
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local lcFile,loShell
		
		If !ThisForm.ModoConsulta
			If Type("thisform.ofrmenviomail") <> T_OBJECT
				ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmEnvioMail","TG_FormMailAdjunto","",ThisForm.cliente,.T.,"","V")
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.Show()
			Thisform.oEmailItem=Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.oEmailItem
		Else
			lcFile = 	ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sucursal") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba") +;
						Str(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("nro_referencia"),10)+".msg"
			loShell = CREATEOBJECT("Shell.Application")
			loShell.ShellExecute(lcFile)
			RELEASE loShell
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		thisform.SetearPredeterminado
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		thisform.MostrarCuentaCorriente
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE dardatossucursal
		lParameters cCodSucursal
		
		If thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Buscar(Thisform.Cliente+cCodSucursal,.f.,"Clave")
			ThisForm.oDireccion.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("domicilio")
			ThisForm.oLocalidad.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("localidad")
			ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Value=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("codpostal")
			ThisForm.oProvincia.Value	=	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("id_provincia")
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value	    =	thisform.oSuc_Clientes.Leer("id_expreso")
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		tg_form::init
		thisform.Cliente=""
		Local cFiltro
		
		thisform.AddObject("oListasPrecios","tg_tabla","listaPrecios","Nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oClientes","tg_tabla","clientes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oSuc_Clientes","tg_tabla","Suc_Clientes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oProvincias","tg_tabla","provincias","Nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oIvas","tg_tabla","Ivas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVendedores","tg_tabla","vendedores","Nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCobradores","tg_tabla","Cobradores","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnd_CliVend","tg_tabla","Vnd_CliVend","Clave")
		
		** LUCAS
		thisform.AddObject("oParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		** LUCAS
		
		**@0720/1@ Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblZonasCamiones","Tg_Tabla","ZonasCamiones","id_zona")
		**@0720/1@ Martin
		ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton4.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("CON","TG_CtaCorrienteClientes")
		thisform.oListaPrecios.BoundColumn=2
		thisform.oListaPrecios.RowSourceType=6
		thisform.oListaPrecios.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.oListasPrecios.Alias)+".Nombre,id_lista"
		thisform.oListaPrecios.Style=2
		thisform.oListaPrecios.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta=.f.
		
		
		thisform.oVendedor.BoundColumn=2
		thisform.oVendedor.RowSourceType=6
		thisform.oVendedor.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.oVendedores.Alias)+".Nombre,id_vendedor"
		thisform.oVendedor.Style=2
		thisform.oVendedor.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		** Filtro solo las retenciones que son GPJ
		cFiltro = "!(Inactivo)" 
		thisform.oVendedores.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		thisform.oVendedor.Requery
		thisform.oVendedor.ListIndex=1
		
		thisform.oprovincia.BoundColumn=2
		thisform.oprovincia.RowSourceType=6
		thisform.oprovincia.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.oProvincias.Alias)+".Nombre,id_Provincia"
		thisform.oprovincia.Style=2
		thisform.oprovincia.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Value = ""
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Value = cTod("  /  /")
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		thisform.oVencimiento.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.value = ""
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcuentacorriente
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCtaCorrienteCliente","TG_CtaCorrienteClientes",thisform.Cliente)
		thisform.oFrmCtaCorrienteCliente.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNroREferencia,lEditando
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.t.
		thisform.EditandoConsulta=lEditando
		
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		If !thisform.YaCargoDatosConsulta
			Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNroREferencia,10))
			thisform.Cliente=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" +thisform.Cliente + "'")
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value = thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodSucursal")
			thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva"))
			thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
			thisform.Id_Iva=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva")	
		*!*	Thisform.tg_CommandButton4.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.oVencimiento.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
			ThisForm.oListaPrecios.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_Lista")
			ThisForm.oVendedor.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Vendedor")
			ThisForm.oComision.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision")
			ThisForm.oCuit.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cuit")
			ThisForm.DNIFiscal = Round(val(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("DNIFiscal")),0)
			ThisForm.oDNI.Value= ThisForm.DNIFiscal
				
			** SE AGREGAN NUEVOS CAMPOS EN VNT_CABECERA ************
			ThisForm.oContacto1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Contacto1")
			ThisForm.oFax.Value			=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fax")
			ThisForm.oFaxST.Value		=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("FaxST")
			ThisForm.oTelefono1.Value	=	thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Telefono1")

	PROCEDURE setearnuevo
		lParameters cId_Comprobante,cIdCliente,lListaPreciosHabilitado
		
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.f.
		
		thisform.Cliente=cIdCliente
		Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado=lListaPreciosHabilitado
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comprobante)
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		thisform.Remunerativo=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Remunerativo")
		Thisform.list_com_pen=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("list_com_pen")
		
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Iva)
		thisform.oTipoIva.Value=thisform.oIvas.leer("Nombre")
		*Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		*Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		Thisform.oVendedor.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"VENDEDOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) and !Thisform.oParametros.Leer("RestringeDescVendedor")
		Thisform.oComision.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMIVEND",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"LISTAPRECIO",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.Thisform.ListaPreciosHabilitado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		Else
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COBRADOR",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Enabled=thisform.Cobranza  And oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"COMICOB",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oCuit.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")<>"05"
		thisform.oDNI.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Cuit",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))  And thisform.oIvas.Leer("CodigoAfipTipoResponsable")="05"
		
		******* FALTAN AGREGAR EL TEMA DE LOS PERMISOS DE ESTOS NUEVOS CAMPOS *********
		thisform.oContacto1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Contacto1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefono1.Enabled	 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Telefono1"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oContactoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"ContactoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oTelefonoST.Enabled = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"TelefonoST"	,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFax.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Fax"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		thisform.oFaxST.Enabled		 = oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"FaxST"		,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		***********************************************************************************************************
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.ofechavenc_cae.Enabled=.t.
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		thisForm.oCOT.enabled = .T.
		** Mariano 13/11/2017 **
		
		ThisForm.oDireccion.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oLocalidad.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oProvincia.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCodigoPostal.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"UBICA",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oExpreso.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Expreso",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oZonas.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Zona",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbCamiones.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comprobante,"Camion",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		
		thisform.oVencimiento.Enabled=Thisform.List_Com_Pen AND  oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comprobante,"VENC",oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"))
		ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" + thisform.Cliente + "'")
		If Empty(Thisform.CodSucursal)
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.IrPrimero()
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value=Thisform.CodSucursal	
		Endif
		
		thisform.REfresh
		thisform.GuardarValores
	ENDPROC

			thisform.oLocalidad.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Localidad")
			thisform.oCodigoPostal.Value = thisform.oClientes.leer("CodPos")
			thisform.oprovincia.Value    = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Provincia")
			ThisForm.oExpreso.Value      = thisform.oClientes.leer("Id_Expreso")
		Else
			Thisform.DarDatosSucursal(ThisForm.oCmbsuc_clientes.Value)
		Endif
		
		ThisForm.oZonas.Value   = thisform.oClientes.leer("id_zona")
		
		Thisform.oTblZonasCamiones.Buscar(thisform.oClientes.leer("id_zona"),.f.,"Id_Zona")

		Endif
		
		** LUCAS 24/06/2010
		ThisForm.oCAE.Value = ""

		** LUCAS 24/06/2010

		thisform.oVencimiento.Value = ctod("  /  /  ")

		thisform.oCobradores.Buscar(Thisform.oClientes.Leer("id_Cobrador"),.f.,"Clave")
		thisform.oComisionCobrador.Value = thisform.oCobradores.leer("Comision")
		
		thisform.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local lcFile,loShell
		
		If !ThisForm.ModoConsulta
			If Type("thisform.ofrmenviomail") <> T_OBJECT
				ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmEnvioMail","TG_FormMailAdjunto","",ThisForm.cliente,.T.,"","V")
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.Show()
			Thisform.oEmailItem=Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.oEmailItem
		Else
			lcFile = 	ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sucursal") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema") +;
						ThisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba") +;
						Str(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("nro_referencia"),10)+".msg"
			loShell = CREATEOBJECT("Shell.Application")
			loShell.ShellExecute(lcFile)
			RELEASE loShell
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcomprobantesbase
		Local mmpp,nItemSeleccionado,mmmppp,lCargoAlgo
		mmpp=1
		lCargoAlgo=.f.
		nItemSeleccionado=1
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Clear
		For mmmppp=1 to 3
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]).and.!thisform.Cobranza
				if thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Buscar(thisform.Id_Cliente+"N"+thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp])
				
					Do while !thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.EsEof() .and. thisform.Id_Cliente=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_CLiente").and.thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("id_Comproba").and.!thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")
		
						if !thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Anulado")		
							Dimension thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]
					
							With thisform.oVnt_CabeceraAdescargar
							
								if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("nro_Referencia")	
								if thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_Sucursal")	
								if thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_sistema")	
								if thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
			
									nItemSeleccionado=mmpp
									
								Endif	
								Endif
								Endif
								Endif
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1]=.Leer("Id_Comproba")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2]=.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]=Dtoc(.Leer("Fecha"))
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4]=.Leer("TotalDeuda")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,5]=.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]=.Leer("Id_Sistema")
								
						
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.additem(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1],thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount+1,1)
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,2)=Str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2],7) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,3)=alltrim(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,4)=str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4],11,2)
								lCargoAlgo=.t.				
						
							EndWith		
							mmpp=mmpp+1
						Endif	
						thisform.oVnt_CabeceraADescargar.IrSiguiente
		
					Enddo
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor	
		If lCargoAlgo and thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount>0
			thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex=nItemSeleccionado
			if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
				thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
			Endif
		Endif	
		
		ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
		
		Thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount<>0.and.ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarcomprobante
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oComprobanteConsulta","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase,thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase,thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase,thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase)
		thisform.oComprobanteConsulta.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarhabildescarga
		lParameters lHabilitado
		
		
		if ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount=0.or.Empty(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[1]+thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[2]+thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[3]).or.thisform.Cobranza
			lHabilitado=.f.	
			thisform.tg_Label12.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			thisform.tg_Label12.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_Label11.Enabled=lHabilitado
		thisform.tg_Label2.Enabled=lHabilitado
		
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Enabled=lHabilitado
		ThisForm.oDetalleComprobante.Enabled=lHabilitado
		if lHabilitado
			thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
		Else
			thisform.oComprobanteBaseADescargar.Value=""
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=0
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=""
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=""
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=""
			
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darcopias
		Return ThisForm.oCopias.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarcotizacion
		Local i
		
		if type("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta","TG_CotizacionesConsulta", thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Else
			thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.LlenarGrilla(thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Endif
		
		thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oDepositos","tg_tabla","Depositos","Nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_CabeceraADescargar","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","PendDesc")
		
		thisform.odeposito.BoundColumn=2
		thisform.odeposito.RowSourceType=6
		thisform.odeposito.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.odepositos.Alias)+".Nombre,id_deposito"
		thisform.odeposito.Style=2
		thisform.odeposito.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrararticulospendientes
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobante")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarestadoactualcomprobante
		if type("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante","TG_EstadoActualComprobante")
		Else
			thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Refrescar
		Endif
		thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Consultar(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_sistema"))
		thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubasiento
		if type("thisform.oSubAsiento")<>"O"
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oSubAsiento","TG_ConsultaAsientos",thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		Endif
		Thisform.oSubAsiento.SetearConsulta(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		Thisform.oSubAsiento.Show()
		ThisForm.oCmdSubAsiento.Enabled=oApp.HabilitarSubAsiento(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Clear
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta
			thisform.CargarComprobantesBase
		Endif	
		if type("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Refrescar
		Endif
		If thisform.ModoConsulta
			If thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")
				Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="\<Aceptar"
				Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Enabled=.f.
			Else
				Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Enabled=.t.
				Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="Pendiente..."
			Endif	
			
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobantebase
		If thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex<>0
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,1)+Space(6)+thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,2)
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=Val(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,2))
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,5]
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,6]
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,1]
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nReferencia,nCopias
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdEstadoComprobante.Enabled=.t.
		
		If Type("nCopias") ="L"
		  nCopias=1
		Endif
		
		thisform.ClaveCotizacion = cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10)
		thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10))
		
		thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
		
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		thisform.tg_label4.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label5.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label6.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label7.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label8.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.Or.thisform.Cobranza
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Visualizacion"))
		thisform.oMonedaVisualizacion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda"))
		thisform.oMonedaDeuda.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
				
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))
		thisform.oMonedaImpresion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_ListaPrecios"))
		thisform.oMonedaListaPrecios.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Stock")<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.t.
		Else
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.f.
		Endif   
		
		If thisform.Cobranza
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=""
		Else	
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Deposito")
		Endif	
			
		thisform.oStock.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.oCopias.Value= nCopias
		
		If thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")
			Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="Pendiente..."
		Endif	
		Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar2.Caption="\<Cerrar"
		
		thisform.Tg_label12.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(.f.)
		if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Bas")<>0
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_com_Bas")+" "+str(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_bas"),10)
		Else
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=""
		Endif
		ThisForm.oCmdSubAsiento.Enabled=oApp.HabilitarSubAsiento(thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		
		thisform.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seteargeneral
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaDeuda)
		thisform.oMonedaDeuda.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
			
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaVisualizacion)
		thisform.oMonedaVisualizacion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
			
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaImpresion)
		thisform.oMonedaImpresion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaListaPrecios)
		thisform.oMonedaListaPrecios.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		if thisform.Af_Stock<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.t.
		Else
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.f.
		Endif   
		If !thisform.Cobranza
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=thisform.Id_Deposito
		Else	
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=""
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearmodificacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearnuevo
		lParameters cId_Comprobante,cId_cliente
		
		Dimension thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[3]
		
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.f.
		thisform.Id_Cliente=cId_cliente
		thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comprobante)
		
		thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[1]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas1")
		thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[2]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas2")
		thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[3]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas3")
		
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		ThisForm.oCmdEstadoComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		
		thisform.SetearGeneral
		
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=thisform.oStock.Value.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.oStock.Enabled=thisform.oVnt_docu.Leer("Af_Stock")<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.CargarComprobantesBase
		
		
		thisform.tg_label4.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label5.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label6.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label7.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label8.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.Or.thisform.Cobranza
		ThisForm.oCmdSubAsiento.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.REfresh
		
		thisform.GuardarValores
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCotizacion.Click
		thisform.GenerarCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEstadoComprobante.Click
		thisForm.MostrarEstadoActualComprobante
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSubAsiento.Click
		Thisform.MostrarSubAsiento()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.DblClick
		thisform.ConsultarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.InteractiveChange
		thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oDescargaComprobante.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oDetalleComprobante.Click
		thisform.ConsultarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oStock.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=this.Value
		thisform.tg_Label3.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label9.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label10.Enabled=this.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oStock.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=this.Value
		thisform.tg_Label3.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label9.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label10.Enabled=this.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta
			if thisform.oStock.Value
				thisform.Af_Stock=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Stock")
			ELse
				thisform.Af_Stock=0	
			Endif
			thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase=thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase
			thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase
			
			thisform.GuardarValores
			
			thisform.Hide
		Else
			thisform.MostrarArticulosPendientes	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase
		
			thisform.ReestablecerValores
		Endif	
		
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabartamanioform
		** Mati Sas 18/10/16 **
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.ExisteCampo("ResizerDesActivado") And !oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("ResizerDesActivado")
			LOCAL vGrabacion, oTblTamanioForms
			DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
			oTblTamanioForms = createobject("Tg_tabla", "tamanioForms", "LEYENDAS")
		
			IF oTblTamanioForms.buscar(UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.Name)) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(oApp.codUsuario())) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_comproba_leyenda)) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_sistema_leyenda)), .F., "LEYENDAS")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "width", thisform.Width)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "height", thisform.Height)
				oTblTamanioForms.modificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			ELSE 
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "form", UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.Name)))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "width", thisform.Width)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "height", thisform.Height)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba", UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_comproba_leyenda)))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema", UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_sistema_leyenda)))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "usuario", UPPER(ALLTRIM(oApp.codUsuario())))
				oTblTamanioForms.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
			ENDIF
		
			Release oTblTamanioForms
		Endif
		** Mati Sas 18/10/16 **
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_sistema
		dodefault()
		thisform.addObject("oComp_Leyendas","tg_tabla","Comp_Leyendas","Clave")
		
		thisform.addObject("oTblGen_Cabecera","tg_tabla",oApp.ArchCabSistema(cId_Sistema),"Clave")
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE restaurartamanioform
		** Mati Sas 18/10/16 **
		IF oApp.oTblParametros.ExisteCampo("ResizerDesActivado") And !oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("ResizerDesActivado")
			LOCAL cForm, oTblTamanioForms
		
			oTblTamanioForms = createobject("Tg_tabla", "tamanioForms", "LEYENDAS")
		
			IF UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.Name)) <> UPPER(ALLTRIM("tg_fechausuario"))
		
				cForm = alltrim(thisform.name)
				if thisform.Instancias>1
					cForm=SUBSTR(alltrim(thisform.name),1,LEN(alltrim(thisform.name))-1)
				ENDIF
		
				thisform.mwResize1.SaveFormSize()
				IF oTblTamanioForms.buscar(UPPER(ALLTRIM(cForm)) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(oApp.codUsuario())) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_comproba_leyenda)) + UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.id_sistema_leyenda)), .F., "LEYENDAS")
					thisform.Width = oTblTamanioForms.leer("width")
					thisform.height = oTblTamanioForms.leer("height")
				ENDIF 
			ENDIF 
		
			Release oTblTamanioForms
		Endif
		** Mati Sas 18/10/16 **
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearedicion
		lParameters lEdicion
		Local mmpp,lEnabledOldCancela
		
		lEnabledOldCancela=ThisForm.Tg_btncancelar.enabled
		thisform.Setall("Enabled",.t.)
		ThisForm.Tg_btncancelar.enabled=lEnabledOldCancela
		
		
		For mmpp =1 to thisform.ControlCount
			If  Upper(thisform.Controls(mmpp).Class)="TG_COMBOBOX" or  Upper(thisform.Controls(mmpp).Class)="TG_CHECKBOX " or  Upper(thisform.Controls(mmpp).Class)="TG_TEXTBOX"
			
				if thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Buscar(thisform.id_comproba_leyenda+thisform.id_sistema_leyenda+UPPER(ALLTRIM(thisform.Controls(mmpp).Name)), .f., "CLAVENOM")
					thisform.Controls(mmpp).Enabled = lEdicion and !thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Solo_Lectura")
				else
					thisform.Controls(mmpp).Enabled = lEdicion
				endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setup
		lParameters cId_comproba,cId_Cliente,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,nTotal,lEditando,cClaveComprobanteBase,lHabilitaCancela,cClaveComprobanteAut, cFechaUltVenta, cNro_Comprobante, vNumeros
		
		Local mmpp,mvaraux,nMaxAnchoTexto,cArch_cb,cTag_cb,cAlias,cAliasAux,nMaxAnchoDato,nMargenIzquierdo
		Local nMargenSuperior,nSeparacionRenglones,nMargenInferior,mObjeto_aux,cArch_def,cTag_Def
		Local cClave_Def,cObjeto_Def,cNombreControl,nFila,nElemento,cCampo,cPrimerControl	
		
		** Mariano 05/06/2017 **
		if type("vNumeros") <> "L"
			Local cNumerosComprobantes1, cNumerosComprobantes2
			cNumerosComprobantes1 = ""
			cNumerosComprobantes2 = ""
		
			if alen(vNumeros,1)>5
				for i = 1 to 5
					cNumerosComprobantes1 = cNumerosComprobantes1 + alltrim(vNumeros[i])
					if i <> 5
						cNumerosComprobantes1 = cNumerosComprobantes1 + "/"
					endIf
				endFor
				for i = 6 to alen(vNumeros,1)
					cNumerosComprobantes2 = cNumerosComprobantes2 + alltrim(vNumeros[i]) 
					if i <> alen(vNumeros,1)
						cNumerosComprobantes2 = cNumerosComprobantes2 + "/"
					endIf
				endFor
			else
				for i = 1 to alen(vNumeros,1)
					cNumerosComprobantes1 = cNumerosComprobantes1 + alltrim(vNumeros[i])
					if i <> alen(vNumeros,1)
						cNumerosComprobantes1 = cNumerosComprobantes1 + "/"
					endIf
				endFor
			endIf
		endIf
		** Mariano 05/06/2017 **
		
		thisform.ModoConsulta=(type("nReferencia")=T_NUMERIC)
		if Thisform.ModoConsulta
			Thisform.oTblGen_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+Cid_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10))
		Endif
		
		If Type("nTotal")=T_LOGICAL
			ntotal=0
		Endif
		
		If Type("cNro_Comprobante")=T_LOGICAL
			cNro_Comprobante = SPACE(13)
		Endif
		
		If Type("cFechaUltVenta")=T_LOGICAL
			cFechaUltVenta = SPACE(10)
		Endif
		
		
		thisform.id_comproba_leyenda = cId_comproba
		thisform.id_sistema_leyenda = cId_sistema
		* LUCAS 28.02.2008
		thisform.totalcomprobante = nTotal
		* LUCAS 28.02.2008
		cNombreControl=""
		mObjeto_aux=""
		cArch_def=""
		cTag_Def=""
		cClave_Def=""
		cObjeto_Def="" 
		nMargenIzquierdo=20
		nMargenSuperior=20
		nMargenInferior=25
		nSeparacionRenglones=25
		nMaxAnchoTexto=0
		nMaxAnchoDato=0
				
		thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Buscar(cId_Comproba+cId_Sistema)
		mmpp=1
		Do While !thisform.oComp_Leyendas.EsEof().and.thisform.oComp_Leyendas.EsClaveIgual()
			thisform.AddObject("Texto"+alltrim(str(mmpp)),"tg_label")
			mVarAux="thisform."+"Texto"+alltrim(str(mmpp))
			&mVaraux..Top=nMargenSuperior+(mmpp-1)*nSeparacionRenglones
			&mVarAux..Left=nMargenIzquierdo
			&mVarAux..AutoSize=.t.	
			&mVarAux..Caption=Alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Titulo"))
			&mVarAux..Visible=.t.
			nMaxAnchoTexto=Max(nMaxAnchoTexto,&mVarAux..Width)
			
			Dimension thisform.vValidaciones[mmpp,2]
			thisform.vValidaciones[mmpp,1]=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Validacion"))
			thisform.vValidaciones[mmpp,2]=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("txt_validacion"))
			
			thisform.oComp_Leyendas.IrSiguiente()
			mmpp=mmpp+1
			
		Enddo	
		
		 
		thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Buscar(cId_Comproba+cId_Sistema)
		mmpp=1
		Do While !thisform.oComp_Leyendas.EsEof().and.thisform.oComp_Leyendas.EsClaveIgual()
			cNombreControl=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Nombre"))	
			Do case
				Case thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Clase_Dato")="TE".Or.(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Clase_Dato")="CB".and.Thisform.ModoConsulta)
		
					thisform.AddObject(cNombreControl,"tg_TextBox")
					mVarAux="thisform."+cNombreControl
		
					&mVarAux..InputMask=Alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Picture"))
					&mVarAux..Alignment=thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Alineacion")
					
					&mVarAux..Width=Max(Len(Alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Picture")))*8,28)
					
				Case thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Clase_Dato")="CH"	
				
		
					thisform.AddObject(cNombreControl,"tg_CheckBox")
					mVarAux="thisform."+cNombreControl
					&mVarAux..Caption=""
					
				Case thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Clase_Dato")="CB"
					thisform.AddObject(cNombreControl,"tg_ComboBox")
		
					cArch_cb=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Arch_cb"))
					cTag_cb=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Tag_cb"))
					
					thisform.AddObject("o"+cArch_cb,"tg_tabla",cArch_cb,cTag_cb)
					cAliasAux="thisform.o"+cArch_cb+".Alias"
					cAlias=&cAliasAux
					mVarAux="thisform."+cNombreControl
					&mVarAux..Width=Max(Len(Alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Picture")))*8,28)
					&mVarAux..RowSource=cAlias+"."+alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Campo_Cb"))
					&mVarAux..RowSourceType=6
					&mVarAux..BoundColumn=2
					&mVarAux..Style=2
					&mVarAux..ColumnWidths=str(&mVarAux..Width)+",0"
								
		
			EndCase
			
			
			&mVaraux..Top=nMargenSuperior+(mmpp-1)*nSeparacionRenglones
			&mVarAux..Left=nMargenIzquierdo+nMaxAnchoTexto+5			
			&mVarAux..Visible=.t.
			if mmpp=1
				cPrimerControl=mVaraux
			Endif	
			
			cArch_def=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Arch_def"))
			cTag_Def=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Tag_def"))
			cClave_Def=alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Clave_def"))
			cObjeto_Def="o"+alltrim(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Arch_def"))
			if !thisform.Vacio(cArch_def)
				If Type("thisform."+cObjeto_def)<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject(cObjeto_def,"tg_tabla",cArch_def,cTag_def)			
				Endif	
				mObjeto_aux="thisform."+cObjeto_def
				if !thisform.ModoConsulta
					&mObjeto_Aux..Buscar(Eval(cClave_def))
				endif
			Endif		
			if !Thisform.ModoConsulta
				&mVarAux..Value=Eval(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Valor_Def"))
			Else
				cCampo=Thisform.oTblGen_Cabecera.Leer(thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Campo_Graba"))
				if Upper(&mvaraux..BaseClass)="CHECKBOX"
					&mVarAux..Value=iif(cCampo="S",.t.,.f.)
				Else
					If Thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Numerico")
						&mVarAux..Value=Val(cCampo)
					Else
						&mVarAux..Value=cCampo
					Endif	
						
				Endif	
				If !lEditando
					&mVaraux..Enabled=.f.
					Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="\<Cerrar"
					Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar.Enabled=.f.
				Else
					&mVaraux..Enabled=.t.
					Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="\<Aceptar"
					Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar.Enabled=.t.			
				Endif
				
			Endif	
			nMaxAnchoDato=Max(nMaxAnchoDato,&mVarAux..Width)
			
			Dimension thisform.vDatos[mmpp,3]
			thisform.vDatos[mmpp,1]=thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Leer("Campo_Graba")	
			thisform.vDatos[mmpp,2]=&mVarAux..Value	
			thisform.vDatos[mmpp,3]=mVarAux
			
			mmpp=mmpp+1
			thisform.oComp_Leyendas.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo			
		thisform.Width=max(nMargenIzquierdo+nMaxAnchoTexto+5+nMaxAnchoDato+nMargenIzquierdo,nMargenIzquierdo+5+ThisForm.Tg_btncancelar.width+ThisForm.Tg_btnaceptar1.width+nMargenIzquierdo)
		thisform.Height=nMargenSuperior+(mmpp-1)*nSeparacionRenglones+nMargenInferior+10+thisform.tg_btnAceptar1.Height
		thisform.tg_btnAceptar1.Top=nMargenSuperior+(mmpp-1)*nSeparacionRenglones+nMargenInferior
		thisform.tg_btnAceptar1.left=thisform.Width-nMargenIzquierdo-thisform.tg_btnAceptar1.Width
		
		thisform.tg_btncancelar.Top=nMargenSuperior+(mmpp-1)*nSeparacionRenglones+nMargenInferior
		thisform.tg_btncancelar.left=thisform.Width-nMargenIzquierdo-thisform.tg_btnAceptar1.Width-10-thisform.tg_btncancelar.Width
		
		
		If !lHabilitaCancela
			
			thisform.tg_btncancelar.Enabled=.f.
		
		Endif
		
		thisform.Autocenter=.t.
		&&Keyboard '{TAB}'
		
		&cPrimerControl..SetFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validardatos
		Local mmpp,lRetorna
		lRetorna=.t.
		
		For mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vValidaciones,1)
			if !eval(thisform.vValidaciones[mmpp,1])
				=fMensAceptar(thisform.vValidaciones[mmpp,2])
				lRetorna=.f.
				Exit
			Endif
		EndFor		
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		Local mmpp,mVarAux,mVarAux1,cValor
		if thisform.ValidarDatos()
			For mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vDatos,1)
				mVarAux=thisform.vDatos[mmpp,3]
				Do Case
					Case Upper(&mVarAux..Class)="TG_COMBOBOX"
						thisform.vDatos[mmpp,2]=&MvarAux..List(&mVarAux..ListIndex)				
					Case Upper(&mVarAux..Class)="TG_CHECKBOX"
						Thisform.VDatos[mmpp,2]=iif(&mVarAux..Value,"S","N")	
					Case Upper(&mVarAux..Class)="TG_TEXTBOX"
						cValor=&mVarAux..Value
						If Type("cValor")=T_NUMERIC
							Thisform.vDatos[mmpp,2]=Str(cValor,15,2)
						Else
							Thisform.vDatos[mmpp,2]=cValor
						Endif	
				EndCase
						
			EndFor
			thisform.Confirmado=.t.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar.Click
		thisform.Confirmado=.f.
		thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_timerBase.Timer
		** si no pngo esto pincha y no se porque, es apartir que agregue el metodo setearedicion
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cambiarestadooperacion
		Local vGrabacion, cResp, cClave
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		thisform.lCerrar = .F.
		
		if !thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.EsEof()
			cClave = thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion") + STR(thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Numero"),10)
			
			thisform.oTblVnt_OperacionesDetalle.Buscar (cClave,.f.,"CLAVENUM")
		
			lAbierto = thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Abierto")
			if lAbierto
				cResp = fMensPregunto ("Confirma pasar la Operación : " +;
				thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion") + " - " +  alltrim(STR(thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Numero"),10)) + chr(13) +;
				" a Estado CERRADO. ", "S")
				if cResp = "S"
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Abierto", .f.)
					thisform.oTblVnt_OperacionesDetalle.Modificar (@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
				endif
				thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			else
				cResp = fMensPregunto ("Confirma pasar la Operación : " +;
				thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion") + " - " +  alltrim(STR(thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Numero"),10)) + chr(13) +;
				" a Estado ABIERTO. ", "S")
				if cResp = "S"
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Abierto", .t.)
					thisform.oTblVnt_OperacionesDetalle.Modificar (@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
				endif
				thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			endif
		else
			=FMensAceptar ("Debe tener seleccionada alguna Operación.")	
		endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE llenartabla
		Local vGrabacion, nTotalVentas
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732
		LOCAL noperacion , lagrego_operacion ,noperacionesclientes , loperacionesclientes
		loperacionesclientes = .f.
		oApp.DarParametroGeneral("SELEC_OPER_CLIENTE","L",@loperacionesclientes ) 
		** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732
		
		    
		
		** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732
		IF TYPE("thisform.id_cliente")  = "C"
			thisform.oViewOperaciones.IrPrimero()
			noperacion = thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("id_operacion")
			Thisform.oViewOperacionesClientes.Refrescar (noperacion , .t. , .t.,.f., .f. ,thisform.id_Cliente )
		endif	
		** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732
		
		
		thisform.oViewOperaciones.IrPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewOperaciones.EsEof()
		
		
		    ** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732
		    lagrego_operacion = .t. &&&& thisform.lModal = lModal
		    
		    IF thisform.lModal AND loperacionesclientes AND TYPE("thisform.id_cliente")<>"L" &&&& 1732 v2 20-03-2024
		         lagrego_operacion = .f. 
		         noperacion = thisform.oViewOperaciones.leer("numeroOperacion")
		         thisform.oViewOperacionesClientes.IrPrimero
		    	 If thisform.oViewOperacionesClientes.Localizar("Entidad="+"'"+thisform.id_cliente+"' and NumeroOperacion =" + STR(noperacion) + " and codigo ='" + thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("id_operacion")+ "'" ) &&&& 1732 v2 20-03-2024
			    	   lagrego_operacion = .t. 
		    	 Endif
		    ENDIF
		    
		    **** 1732 v2 20-03-2024 v3 23-03-2024
		    IF thisform.ochkTodas.Value
		       	   lagrego_operacion = .t. 
		    Endif
		   ** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732 1732 v3 23-03-2024
		
		   IF lagrego_operacion    &&&&       ** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732 
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Fecha"			, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Fecha"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Nombre"			, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Nombre"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Operacion"	, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Numero"			, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("NumeroOperacion"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Observaciones"	, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Observaciones"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Clasificacion"	, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Clasificacion"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Abierto"		, thisform.oViewOperaciones.Leer("Abierto"))
				thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
			endif	 &&&&       ** Diego 11-03-2024 #1732	
			
			
			thisform.oViewOperaciones.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante

		*!*		Else

		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		*!*	Else
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*		Else
		*!*			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		*!*	lParameters oLst
		
		if thisform.lModal
			Local vVector[2]
			vVector[1] = "Seleccionar Operación..."
			vVector[2] = "Consultar Detalle Operación..."
		
			ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
			Do case 
				Case Bar() = 1
						thisform.SeleccionarOperacion()
				Case Bar() = 2
						thisform.ConsultarOperacion()
			EndCase	
		else
			Local vVector[1]
			vVector[1] = "Consultar Detalle Operación..."
		
			ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
			Do case 
				Case Bar() = 1
					thisform.ConsultarOperacion()
			EndCase	
		endif	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostraroperacion
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion","TG_ConsultaOperacionesVenta", .t.)
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.ConsultarOperacion(thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion"),thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Numero"))
			thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.Show()
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.ConsultarOperacion(thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Operacion"),thisform.oTblAux_Operaciones.Leer("Numero"))
			thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC
