		***** Diego 18-11-2008
		
		
		ThisForm.oTbxImpuestos.Value = thisform.Iva1.Value + thisform.Iva2.Value + thisform.internos.Value + Thisform.Importe_PercIB +Thisform.Importe_PercIVA
		
		
		
		
		******************* CODIGO VIEJO 03-06-2005 TASAS DE IVA *******************************************************************
		
		*!*	Local lIvaDiscriminado,lTipoIvaLiqInt,lComprobanteLiqInt,lLiqIva,nPorcIva1,nPorcIva2,lLiq_Perc, vAuxiliar, nNetoGrabarMonedaPrincipal,nAuxBoniPerc1,nAuxBoniPerc2
		*!*	Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		*!*	thisform.Boni1.value=Round(thisform.NetoBase.Value*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		*!*	thisform.Boni2.value=Round((thisform.NetoBase.Value-thisform.Boni1.Value)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		*!*	thisform.NetoBonificado.Value=Round(thisform.NetoBase.Value-thisform.Boni1.Value-thisform.Boni2.Value,2)
		
		*!*	************* Saco la Bonificacion de neto para percepciones
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIb*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((Thisform.NetoPercIb-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		*!*	thisform.NetoPercIbBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIb-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIva*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((Thisform.NetoPercIva-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		*!*	thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIva-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(thisform.NetoPercGananc*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		*!*	nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((thisform.NetoPercGananc-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		*!*	thisform.NetoPercGanancBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercGananc-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		*!*	***************************************************
		
		
		*!*	thisform.Total.Value=Round(thisform.NetoBonificado.Value,2)
		
		
		*!*	* Si liquida internos
		*!*	thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.id_iva,.f.,"Clave")
		
		*!*	If thisform.Estado     = TG_ALTACOMPROBANTE
		*!*		lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")
		*!*		lTipoIvaLiqInt     = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*		lComprobanteLiqInt = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*		lLiq_Perc          = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Perc")
		*!*		lLiqIva            = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") 
		*!*		nPorcIva1          = thisform.Porc_Iva1 &&thisform.oIvas.Leer("Porc1")
		*!*		nPorcIva2          = thisform.Porc_Iva2 &&thisform.oIvas.Leer("Porc2")
		*!*	Else
		*!*		lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("IvaDiscriminado")
		*!*		lTipoIvaLiqInt     = (thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Imp_Int")<>0)
		*!*		lComprobanteLiqInt = (thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Imp_Int")<>0)
		*!*		lLiqIva            = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Liq_Iva")
		*!*		lLiq_Perc          = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Liq_Perc")
		*!*		nPorcIva1          = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva1")
		*!*		nPorcIva2          = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva2")
		*!*	Endif
		
		
		*!*	IF lTipoIvaLiqInt and lComprobanteLiqInt
		*!*		thisform.MontoInternos=thisform.CalcularInternos()
		*!*		IF lIvaDiscriminado
		*!*			thisform.internos.Value=thisform.MontoInternos
		*!*			thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Round(thisform.MontoInternos,2)
		*!*		ENDIF
		*!*	Else	
		*!*		&& Se hace esta salvedad ya que se si esta haciendo un comprobante automático que no liquide internos, se borren los datos anteriores
		*!*		thisform.MontoInternos=0
		*!*		thisform.internos.Value=0
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		*!*	thisform.NetoAGravar=thisform.CalcularNetoAGravar()
		
		
		*!*	* Si liquida iva
		
		*!*	IF lLiqIva
		
		*!*		** Giro
		*!*		thisform.MontoIVa1=Round(thisform.NetoAGravar*nPorcIva1/100,2)
		
		*!*		IF lIvaDiscriminado
		*!*			thisform.MontoIVa2=Round(thisform.NetoAGravar*nPorcIva2/100,2)
		*!*		
		*!*			thisform.Iva1.Value=thisform.MontoIVa1
		*!*			thisform.Iva2.Value=thisform.MontoIVa2
		*!*			thisform.Total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Round(thisform.Iva1.Value,2)+Round(thisform.Iva2.Value,2)
		*!*		Else
		*!*			IF lLiq_Perc
		*!*				thisform.MontoIVa2=Round(thisform.Total.Value*nPorcIva2/100,2)
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.Total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+thisform.montoIVa2
		*!*		ENDIF
		*!*		
		*!*		** Giro
		*!*		
		*!*	Else	
		*!*		&& Se hace esta salvedad ya que se si esta haciendo un comprobante automático que no liquide iva, se borren los datos anteriores
		*!*		thisform.MontoIVa1=0
		*!*		thisform.MontoIVa2=0
		*!*		thisform.Iva1.Value=0
		*!*		thisform.Iva2.Value=0
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		
		*!*	* Si liquida Percepciones
		
		*!*	Thisform.Importe_PercIB		= 0
		*!*	Thisform.Importe_PercIVA	= 0
		
		*!*	If lLiq_Perc 
		*!*		
		*!*		**** Liquida Percepciones Ing. Brutos
		*!*		****Cambiar lo de las percepciones
		*!*	*!*		=Acopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		*!*	*!*		nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal = thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir (thisform.NetoAGravar, thisform.oParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),, thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar)
		*!*	*!*		If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercIB,.f.,"Clave")
		*!*	*!*			If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Leer("Minimo")
		*!*	*!*				Thisform.Importe_PercIB = Round(thisform.NetoAGravar*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
		*!*	*!*				thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercIB
		*!*	*!*			Endif
		*!*	*!*		Endif
		
		*!*	*!*		**** Liquida Percepciones IVA
		*!*	*!*		If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercIVA,.f.,"Clave")
		*!*	*!*			If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Minimo")
		*!*	*!*				Thisform.Importe_PercIVA = Round(thisform.NetoAGravar*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
		*!*	*!*				thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercIVA
		*!*	*!*			Endif
		*!*	*!*		Endif
		
		*!*		=Acopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		*!*		nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal = thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir (thisform.NetoPercIbBonificado, thisform.oParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),, thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar)
		*!*		If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercIB,.f.,"Clave")
		*!*			If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Leer("Minimo")
		*!*				Thisform.Importe_PercIB = Round(thisform.NetoPercIbBonificado*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIB.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
		*!*				thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercIB
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		Endif
		
		*!*		**** Liquida Percepciones IVA
		*!*		nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal = thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir (thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado, thisform.oParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),, thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar)
		*!*		If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercIVA,.f.,"Clave")
		*!*			If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Minimo")
		*!*				Thisform.Importe_PercIVA = Round(thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
		*!*				thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercIVA
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		Endif
		
		*!*	****Faltaria agregar las percepciones de ganancias	
		
		*!*	Endif
		
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxImpuestos.Value = thisform.Iva1.Value + thisform.Iva2.Value + thisform.internos.Value + Thisform.Importe_PercIB +Thisform.Importe_PercIVA
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotalcantidad
		thisform.TotalCantidad.Value=thisform.oDetalle.Sumar("Cantidad",".t.")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotales
		LOCAL nTotal,nTotalIVA,nTotalBI,nTotalIB
		
		nTotal = 0
		nTotalIva = 0
		nTotalBI = 0
		nTotalIB = 0
		
		thisForm.oViewClimasiva.IrPrimero()
		DO WHILE !thisForm.oViewClimasiva.EsEof()
		
			nTotal = nTotal + thisForm.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Total")
			nTotalIva = nTotalIVA + thisForm.oViewClimasiva.Leer("IVA")
			nTotalBI = nTotalBI + thisForm.oViewClimasiva.Leer("BaseImponible")
			nTotalIB = nTotalIB + thisForm.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Importe_PercIB")	
		
			thisForm.oViewClimasiva.IrSiguiente()
		ENDDO 
		
		thisForm.txtTotal.Value 			 = nTotal
		thisForm.txtTotalBaseImponible.Value = nTotalBI
		thisForm.txtTotalIIBB.Value 		 = nTotalIB
		thisForm.txtTotalIva.Value 			 = nTotalIVA
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotalmasiva
		LPARAMETERS cId_Comproba
		Local lIvaDiscriminado,lTipoIvaLiqInt,lComprobanteLiqInt,lLiqIva,nPorcIva1,nPorcIva2,lLiq_Perc, vAuxiliar, nNetoGrabarMonedaPrincipal,nAuxBoniPerc1,nAuxBoniPerc2
		Local lnuevo_regimen, cMensaje 
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.id_iva,.f.,"Clave")
		thisform.ovnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		
		lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")
		lTipoIvaLiqInt     = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int") and thisform.ConfirmaLiqInt && LUCHO M. 18/03/2011
		lComprobanteLiqInt = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int") and thisform.ConfirmaLiqInt && LUCHO M. 18/03/2011
		lLiq_Perc          = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Perc")
		lLiqIva            = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") and !thisform.oIvas.Leer("Exento")
		
		
		
		thisform.CalcularIva()
		
		thisform.Boni1.Value=Round(thisform.NetoBase.Value*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		thisform.Boni2.Value=Round((thisform.NetoBase.Value-thisform.Boni1.Value)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		
		
		If  lIvaDiscriminado
			&&thisform.NetoBonificado.Value=thisform.CalcularNetoAGravar()
			if !empty(thisform.vIvas)
				For i=1 to alen(thisform.vIvas,1)
				   	thisform.NetoBonificado.Value=thisform.NetoBonificado.Value+thisform.vIvas [i,2]
				ENDFOR
			Endif
		
		Else
			thisform.NetoBonificado.Value=Round(thisform.NetoBase.Value-thisform.Boni1.Value-thisform.Boni2.Value,2)	
		Endif
		
		
		nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIb*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((Thisform.NetoPercIb-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		thisform.NetoPercIbBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIb-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIva*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((Thisform.NetoPercIva-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercIva-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(Thisform.NetoPercTEM*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((Thisform.NetoPercTEM-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		thisform.NetoPercTEMBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercTEM-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		nAuxBoniPerc1=Round(thisform.NetoPercGananc*thisform.PorcBoni1.Value/100,2)
		nAuxBoniPerc2=Round((thisform.NetoPercGananc-nAuxBoniPerc1)*thisform.PorcBoni2.Value/100,2)
		thisform.NetoPercGanancBonificado=Round(Thisform.NetoPercGananc-nAuxBoniPerc1-nAuxBoniPerc2,2)
		
		
		
		
		
		thisform.Total.Value=Round(thisform.NetoBonificado.Value,2)
		
		if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Valorizado") or thisform.ConfComAut
			thisform.porc_iva1=thisform.CalcularTasaEquivalente()
		endif	
		
		
		IF lTipoIvaLiqInt and lComprobanteLiqInt
			thisform.MontoInternos=thisform.CalcularInternos()
			IF lIvaDiscriminado
				thisform.internos.Value=thisform.MontoInternos
				thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Round(thisform.MontoInternos,2)
			ENDIF
		Else	
			&& Se hace esta salvedad ya que se si esta haciendo un comprobante automático que no liquide internos, se borren los datos anteriores
			thisform.MontoInternos=0
			thisform.internos.Value=0
		ENDIF
		
		
		** ALONSO
		IF lLiqIva
			thisform.MontoIva1=thisform.CalcularMontoIVa()
			IF lIvaDiscriminado
				thisform.Iva1.Value=thisform.MontoIVa1
				thisform.Total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Round(thisform.Iva1.Value,2)
			Else
		*!*			IF lLiq_Perc
		*!*				thisform.MontoIVa2=Round(thisform.Total.Value*nPorcIva2/100,2)
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.Total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+thisform.montoIVa2	
			ENDIF
		Else	
			thisform.MontoIVa1=0
			thisform.MontoIVa2=0
			thisform.Iva1.Value=0
			thisform.Iva2.Value=0
		ENDIF
		** ALONSO  ***************************
		
		
		
		thisform.NetoAGravar=thisform.CalcularNetoAGravar()
		
		
		* Si liquida Percepciones
		
		Thisform.Importe_PercIB		= 0
		Thisform.Importe_PercIVA	= 0
		Thisform.AlicuotaPercIB 	= 0.00
		ThisForm.Importe_PercPyP	= 0 && LUCHO M. 19/01/11 - Percepciones PyP
		Thisform.Importe_PercTEM    = 0 && LUCAS 27/07/2011
		
		Thisform.oClientes.Buscar(ThisForm.Cliente, .F., "CLAVE")
		** Chiara 18/03/19
		Thisform.Id_PercTEM = thisForm.oClientes.Leer("Id_PercTEM")
		** Chiara 18/03/19
		
		If lLiq_Perc 
			** Chiara 18/03/19
			Thisform.CalcularPercepcionIB(lLiq_Perc,cId_Comproba,thisForm.Cliente,thisForm.oViewClimasiva.Leer("BaseImponible"),thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Id_MonedaImpresion"))
			** Chiara 18/03/19
			** EL CODIGO VIEJO DE EST IF ESTA COPIADO ACA DEBAJO CON EL NOMBRE "PERCEPCIONES IIBB 12-01-2010"
		Endif
		
		
		**** Liquida Percepciones TEM
		Thisform.Id_PercPyP = ""
		
		
		If lLiq_Perc 
			nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal = thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir (thisform.NetoPercTEMBonificado, thisform.oParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),, thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar)
			If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEM.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercTEM,.f.,"Clave")
				
				If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEM.Leer("Minimo")
					Thisform.Importe_PercTEM = Round(thisform.NetoPercTEMBonificado*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEM.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
					thisform.total.Value	 = thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercTEM
				Endif
		
				Thisform.Id_PercPyP = Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEM.Leer("Id_percautomatica")		
		
				If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEMAUT.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercPyP,.f.,"Clave") And thisform.Importe_PercTEM > 0
					ThisForm.Importe_PercPyP = Round(thisform.Importe_PercTEM*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesTEMAUT.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
					thisform.total.Value  	 = thisform.Total.Value + ThisForm.Importe_PercPyP
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		**** Liquida Percepciones TEM
			
		
		
		If lLiq_Perc 
			nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal = thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir (thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado, thisform.oParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),, thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar)
			If Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Buscar(Thisform.Id_PercIVA,.f.,"Clave")
				If nNetoAGrabarMonedaPrincipal >= Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Minimo")
					Thisform.Importe_PercIVA = Round(thisform.NetoPercIvaBonificado*Thisform.oTblPercepcionesIVA.Leer("Porcentaje")/100,2)
					thisform.total.Value=thisform.Total.Value+Thisform.Importe_PercIVA
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
		
		ThisForm.oTbxImpuestos.Value = thisform.Iva1.Value + thisform.Iva2.Value + thisform.internos.Value + Thisform.Importe_PercIB +Thisform.Importe_PercIVA + ThisForm.Importe_PercPyP + Thisform.Importe_PercTEM && LUCHO M. 19/01/11 - Percepciones PyP
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularvencimientosanticipo
		Local vGrabacion,nTotalDeuda,nAcumuladorCuota,nAcumuladorPorcentaje,mmpp, vAuxiliar 
		Local NPrimerporcentaje , nCantidadCuotas
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		= aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		**************
		***Diego 11-02-08
		***************
		nAcumuladorPorcentaje=0
		nAcumuladorCuota=0
		nTotalDeuda=Round(thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Convertir(thisform.Total.Value,Thisform.oPrecioDeuda.Moneda,,thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar),2)
		NPrimerporcentaje = round((thisform.anticipo / nTotalDeuda * 100),2)
		NCantidadCuotas = alen(thisform.vVencimientos,1) 
		
		for mmpp = 1 to NCantidadCuotas
		    do case 
		      case mmpp = 1
		       thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2]= NPrimerporcentaje
		      case mmpp = alen(thisform.vVencimientos,1) &&& Ultima cuota ajusta al 100%
		        thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2]=  100 - nAcumuladorPorcentaje
		      otherwise  
		        thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2] = round ((((nTotalDeuda-thisform.anticipo)/ (NCantidadCuotas-1)) / nTotalDeuda ) * 100 , 2)
		      endcase  
		      nAcumuladorPorcentaje= nAcumuladorPorcentaje + thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2]
		EndFor
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculolistabase
		LParameters nPrecio,cLista,ClistaBase,Carticulo
		Local nPreciobase
		****** 18-12-2008
		******thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase")
		***** Diego 
		nPreciobase = 0
		if thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cArticulo+cListabase,.f.,"Clave")		
		    nPreciobase  = thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
			if thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Buscar(cLista+ClistaBase)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion3")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo3")/100,2)
			Endif
		Endif
		Retu nPreciobase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcomprobante		&& Carga un comprobante para consulta

			.oMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_mon_Visualizacion"))
			.ToTalVisualizado.ToolTipText="Importe total en "+alltrim(thisform.oMonedas.Leer("nombre"))+" (moneda de visualización)"

			.RazonSocial.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre")

			.Referencia.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			.Id_Sucursal=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			.Id_Sistema=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema")	
			Thisform.Id_PercIB	=	.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_PercIB")
			Thisform.Id_PercIVA	=	.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_PercIVA")
			.CondicionPago.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Condicion")
			.Comprobante.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			.PorcBoni1.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Boni1")
			.PorcBoni2.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Boni2")
			
			if .oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cta_Corriente")
				.FormaDePago.Value="Cuenta Corriente"
			Else
				.FormaDePago.Value="Contado"
			Endif	
			.Remunerativo=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Remunerativo")
			.CuentaCorriente=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cta_Corriente")
			.Id_Iva=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Iva")
			.Porc_Iva1=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva1")
			.Porc_Iva2=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva2")
			.tg_label10.Caption=substr(.tg_label10.Caption,1,6)+space(1)+alltrim(str(.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva1"),5,2))+space(1)+"%"
			.tg_label11.Caption=substr(.tg_label11.Caption,1,6)+space(1)+alltrim(str(.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva2"),5,2))+space(1)+"%"
			.NetoBase.Value=.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Subtotal")

	PROCEDURE cargarcomprobantebase
		Local vGrabacion,nPercioSinBonificar,mmpp,nRegAnt
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oVnt_cabeceraBase.Buscar(thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase+thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase+thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase+str(Thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase,10))
		
		
		
		ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Nombre")
		thisform.id_Provincia=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("id_provincia")
		thisform.Cuit=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Cuit")
		
		** SE AGREGAN NUEVOS CAMPOS - TELECTRONICA
		thisform.Contacto1	=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Contacto1")
		thisform.Fax		=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Fax")
		thisform.FaxST		=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("FaxST")
		thisform.Telefono1	=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Telefono1")
		thisform.ContactoST	=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("ContactoST")
		thisform.TelefonoST	=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("TelefonoST")
		******************************************
		
		
		thisform.Id_Zona=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Zona")
		
		Thisform.Id_Camion = thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Camion")
		
		thisform.Id_Expreso=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Expreso")
		thisform.id_Vendedor=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Vendedor")
		thisform.id_Cobrador=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Cobrador")
		thisform.Comision=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Comision")
		thisform.Direccion=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Direccion")
		thisform.Localidad=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Localidad")
		thisform.CodPos=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("CodPos")
		thisform.Vencimiento=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Vencimiento")
		thisform.PorcBoni1.Value=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Porc_Boni1")
		thisform.PorcBoni2.Value=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Porc_Boni2")
		
		
		
		
		** VERSION NO TASAS
		*thisform.CondicionPago.Value=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Condicion")
		*thisform.CodSucursal=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("CodSucursal")
		*thisform.Id_ListaPrecios=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Lista")
		
		&& Gustavo Aca
		If Empty(Thisform.Id_Condicion)
			thisform.CondicionPago.Value=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Condicion")
		Endif	
		thisform.CodSucursal=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("CodSucursal")
		
		
		If Thisform.HeredaId_Lista
			thisform.Id_ListaPrecios=thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Lista")
			thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios)
			thisform.oPrecioListaPrecios.Setup(thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_moneda"))
		Endif
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* damedco
		if Thisform.oParametros.Leer("GrillaDescuento")
		   thisform.Id_TipoDescuento = thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Grilla")
		endif
		* damedco
		
		** SE CARGA LA OPERACION DEL COMPROBANTE BASE
		if !empty(thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Operacion"))
			thisform.Id_Operacion = thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Operacion")
			thisform.NumeroOperacion = thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("NumeroOperacion")
		endif	
		
		&& Tasas Aca Definir local mmpp 
		nRegAnt=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Recno()
		thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"clave")
		Thisform.CargaCotizaciones=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("CargaCotizaciones") 
		If nRegAnt>0
			thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrRegistro(nRegAnt)
		Endif	
		
		mmpp=1
		If Thisform.CargaCotizaciones 
		
			
			Thisform.oTblCotizacomprobantes.Buscar(thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase+thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase+thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase+str(Thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase,10))
			Do While !Thisform.oTblCotizacomprobantes.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblCotizacomprobantes.EsClaveIgual()
			    
				Dimension thisform.vCotizaciones[mmpp,2]

	PROCEDURE cargarenvases
		Local vEnvases, nRegistro, i, vGrabacion, lCancela
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		lCancela = .f.
		
		if thisform.cargaenvases
		   Dimension vEnvases[1,5]
		   i = 1
		   nRegistro = Thisform.oDetalle.Recno() 
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		   do while Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Id_Articulo")<>space(15)
		      Thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		      Dimension vEnvases[i,5]
		      vEnvases[i,1] = Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Id_Articulo")
		      vEnvases[i,2] = Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Nombre")
		      vEnvases[i,3] = Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Cantidad")
		      vEnvases[i,4] = Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Envase")
		      vEnvases[i,5] = Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Cant_Envases")
		      i = i + 1
		      Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente() 
		   enddo
		   
		   If type ("thisform.oFrmEnvases")<>T_OBJECT
		   	  thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmEnvases","Tg_FormEnvases")
		   Endif
		   thisform.oFrmEnvases.SetearConsulta(@vEnvases)
		   thisform.oFrmEnvases.Show
		   
		   Thisform.oFrmEnvases.DarVector(@vEnvases)
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		   
		   for i = 1 to Alen(vEnvases,1)
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Envase", vEnvases[i,4])        
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cant_Envases"  , vEnvases[i,5])
		       Thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		       Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()        
		   next 
		   
		   lCancela = Thisform.oFrmEnvases.Cancelado
		   			
		   thisform.oFrmEnvases=""
		   
		endif
		
		return !lCancela
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaritemsfueradescarga
		Local vGrabacion[1,2],i
		
		If !Empty(Thisform.DetalleManual[1,1])
			For i = 1 to Alen(Thisform.DetalleManual,1)
		
				If Thisform.ValidarTasasdeIva(Thisform.DetalleManual[i,1])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"	, 	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,1])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,2])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,3])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,4])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,5])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Internos"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,6])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,7])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Bonificacion" ,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,8])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Numero"		,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,9])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioLista"  ,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,10])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Renglon"      ,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,11])
		
					if thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.DetalleManual[i,1])
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercIb", 		thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIb"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercIva", 		thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIva"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercGananc", 	thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercGananc"))
					endif
					
					Thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.DetalleManual[i,1])
		
					If Not Empty(Thisform.DetalleManual[i,9]) and (!thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Lotea") or  !thisform.Lotea)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"TalleColor",.t.)
					Endif
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Lotea"			 ,thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Lotea"))
					
					** Lucas
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Reposicion"		 ,thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Reposicion"))
					** Lucas
								
					* edgardo agrego alicutoas ivas
					
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Porc_Iva"       ,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,15])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_AlicuotaIva" ,	Thisform.DetalleManual[i,16])
					
					thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				
					** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGAN LOS NUEVOS PARAMETROS
					thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,1]=thisform.CalcularPrecioAImprimir(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Total"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Internos"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Costo"), thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"), thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Porc_Iva"))
					*********************************************************
					thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,2]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
					thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,3]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Internos")
					** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGAN LOS NUEVOS PARAMETROS
					thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,4]=thisform.CalcularPrecioSinImpuesto(thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,1],0,thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Costo"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"), thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Porc_Iva"))
					*********************************************************
					
					thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,5]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Costo")
					
					if !thisform.oDetalle.Leer("ExentoPercIB")
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,6]=thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,4]
					else
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,6]=round(0,2)
					endif
					if !thisform.oDetalle.Leer("ExentoPercIva")
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,7]=thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,4]
					else
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,7]=round(0,2)
					endif
					if !thisform.oDetalle.Leer("ExentoPercGananc")
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,8]=thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,4]
					else
						thisform.vTotales[thisform.Fila,8]=round(0,2)				
					endif
					
					** ALONSO, NUEVOS ELEMENTOS AL VECTOR vTOTALES
					thisform.vTotales[Thisform.Fila,9]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("porc_iva")
					thisform.vTotales[Thisform.Fila,10]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("id_alicuotaIva")
					**********************************************
					
					thisform.CalcularComprobante
					thisform.Fila=thisform.Fila+1
					thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()	
				******* Martin
				Else
					=fMensAceptar("No se puede incluir en el comprobante el siguiente articulo:" + Alltrim(Thisform.DetalleManual[i,3]) )
				endif	
				****** Martin	
			Next	
			
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarnumeracion
		Local nNroReferencia,vGrabacion,lPidioNumerosIniciales, oCstImprime, nProximoNumero
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		
		
		thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Buscar(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Prenumera"))
		lPidioNumerosIniciales=.f.
		if thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.EsEof()
		*!*		oPideNumerosIniciales=CreateObject("tg_PideNumerosIniciales",Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Prenumera"),Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre"))
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales","tg_PideNumerosIniciales",Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Prenumera"),Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre"))
		
			thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.show()
			thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Agregar
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Nro_Referencia)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Impresion"	,thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Nro_Impresion)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Sucursal"		,thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Nro_Sucursal)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cai"				,thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Cai)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cai_Vto"			,thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Cai_Vto)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Prenumera"		,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Prenumera"))	
			thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oFrmPideNumerosIniciales.Release()
			lPidioNumerosIniciales=.t.
		Endif		
		
		
		thisform.Referencia.Value=thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("nro_Referencia")
		if thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Prenumera")>0 and !thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Autonumera") 
			thisform.Numero.Value=replicate("0",5-len(alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Sucursal")))))+alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Sucursal")))+"-"+replicate("0",8-len(alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Impresion")))))+alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Impresion")))	
		Else
		    thisform.Nro_SucImpresion=replicate("0",5-len(alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Sucursal")))))+alltrim(str(thisform.oVnt_Numeracion.Leer("Nro_Sucursal")))
			thisform.Numero.Value=""
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarpromociones
		LParameters vResPromo
		
		Local i,vGrabacion[1,2]
		Local vAuxiliar
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		*!*	vResultado[1 ,	1]	= Id_Articulo
		*!*	vResultado[1 ,	2]	=	Cantidad
		*!*	vResultado[1 ,	3]	= Precio
		*!*	vResultado[1 ,	4]	= Porc_Precio
		*!* vResultado[1 , 	5] 	= Id_Promocion
		
		Thisform.ActualizarDetalleMultipleBase()
		
		For i = 1 to Alen(vResPromo,1)
			
					thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(vResPromo[i,1],.f.,"Clave")
					
					thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")		
					
					nPrecioSinBonificar = vResPromo[i,3]
					
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"	,	vResPromo[i,1]										)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"		,	vResPromo[i,2]										)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"		,	thisform.oArticulos.Leer("nombre"))
					
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercIb", 		thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIb"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercIva", 		thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIva"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercGananc", 	thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercGananc"))
							
					
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioLista"	,	vResPromo[i,3]										)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Renglon"		,	Thisform.oCstAdmRenglon.darNumero())
					= aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"		,	thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nPrecioSinBonificar,thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda"),0,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_monedaVisualizacion"),0,thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"		,	vResPromo[i,2] * nPrecioSinBonificar)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Internos"		,	thisform.oArticulos.leer("imp_int"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"		,	thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.oArticulos.leer("Costo"),thisform.oArticulos.leer("Id_MonedaCosto"),0,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_monedaImpresion"),0,thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Bonificacion"	,	vResPromo[i,4]										)		
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Promocion"	,	vResPromo[i,5]										)		
					
					thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
					thisform.CalcularComprobante
					thisform.Fila=thisform.Fila+1
					thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()	
			
		Next
		
			
		thisform.Fila=Min(thisform.Fila,thisform.Renglones)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarpromocionesgrilla
		LParameters vResPromo
		
		Local i,vGrabacion[1,2]
		Local vAuxiliar
		Local cId_Articulo, nCantidad, cId_ArticuloAcredita, nCantAcredita, nBonif, nCantBoni, nCantGrabar, nPrecioSinBonificar
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo") <> space(15)
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		For i = 1 to Alen(vResPromo,1)
			
			        nPrecioSinBonificar = vResPromo[i,3]
			         
					thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(vResPromo[i,1],.f.,"Clave")
					
					thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")		
					
					cId_Articulo = vResPromo[i,1]
					nCantidad    = vResPromo[i,2]
					
					*accedo a la grilla del cliente a ver si promociona articulo
					if Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Buscar(Thisform.Id_TipoDescuento+cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
					
					   if Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("CantBoni")<>0 and Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("CantAcredita")<>0
					   
					      cId_ArticuloAcredita = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("Id_ArticuloAcredita")
					      nCantAcredita        = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("CantAcredita")
					      nCantBoni            = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("CantBoni")
					   
					      nCantGrabar = int ( nCantidad / nCantBoni) * nCantAcredita
					   
					      if ncantGrabar <> 0  
					      
					         if cId_Articulo <> cId_ArticuloAcredita
					      
					            nBonif = 0
					            
					            thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloAcredita,.f.,"Clave")
					         
					            if Thisform.Id_ListaPrecioFijo <> ""
					               if Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cID_ArticuloAcredita + Thisform.Id_ListaPrecioFijo,.f.,"Clave")
					                  nPrecioSinBonificar = Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
					          	      thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecioFijo,.f.,"Clave")		
					                  if nPrecioSinBonificar = 0
					                     Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cID_ArticuloAcredita + Thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")
					                     nPrecioSinBonificar = Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
					                     thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")		
					                     * como no es preciofijo busco descuento en grilla
					                     if Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Buscar(Thisform.Id_TipoDescuento+cId_ArticuloAcredita,.f.,"Clave")
					                        nBonif = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("Descuento")
					                     endif
					                  endif
					               else
					                  Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cID_ArticuloAcredita + Thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")
					                  nPrecioSinBonificar = Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
					                  thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")					               
					                  * como no es preciofijo busco descuento en grilla
					                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Buscar(Thisform.Id_TipoDescuento+cId_ArticuloAcredita,.f.,"Clave")
					                     nBonif = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("Descuento")
					                  endif
					               endif   
					            else
					               Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cID_ArticuloAcredita + Thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")
					               nPrecioSinBonificar = Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
					               thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,.f.,"Clave")					            
			                       * como no es preciofijo busco descuento en grilla
					               if Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Buscar(Thisform.Id_TipoDescuento+cId_ArticuloAcredita,.f.,"Clave")
					                  nBonif = Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.Leer("Descuento")
					               endif
					            endif
					         else   
					            nPrecioSinBonificar = vResPromo[i,3]
					            nBonif = vResPromo[i,7]
					         endif   
					
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"	,	thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo") )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"		,	nCantGrabar )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"		,	thisform.oArticulos.Leer("nombre"))
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioLista"	,	nPrecioSinBonificar )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Renglon"		,	Thisform.oCstAdmRenglon.darNumero())
		  			         = aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"		,	thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nPrecioSinBonificar,thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda"),0,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_monedaVisualizacion"),0,thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar))
		  			         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"		,	nCantAcredita * nPrecioSinBonificar)
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Internos"		,	thisform.oArticulos.leer("imp_int"))
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"		,	thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.oArticulos.leer("Costo"),thisform.oArticulos.leer("Id_MonedaCosto"),0,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_monedaImpresion"),0,thisform.Fecha.Value, @vAuxiliar))
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Bonificacion"	,	nBonif )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Grilla"	,	Thisform.Id_TipoDescuento )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_ArticuloGrilla"	,	cId_Articulo )
					         
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercib"	 ,	thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIb") )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercIva"	 ,	thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIva") )
					         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ExentoPercGananc" ,	thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercGananc") )
							         			         
		 					 nPorcIvaArticulo = thisform.oCstVentas.CalcularTasaIvaArticulo(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		 					 cId_AlicuotaIva  = ""
							 if thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar (nPorcIvaArticulo, .f., "PORCENTAJE")  
								cId_AlicuotaIva = thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_AlicuotaIva" ,	cId_AlicuotaIva )
							 endif
							 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Porc_iva" ,	nPorcIvaArticulo )					 
				
					         thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
					         thisform.CalcularComprobante
					         thisform.Fila=thisform.Fila+1
					         thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()	
					      
					      endif
					      
			           endif
			           
			        endif
		Next
		
		thisform.Fila=Min(thisform.Fila,thisform.Renglones)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarvectorasignaciones
		LParameters vArticulos
		
		Local nReg
		
		*** Martin
		If Thisform.oDetalle.EsFinal()
			nReg = 0
		Else
			nReg = thisform.oDetalle.Recno()
		Endif
		*** Martin
		
		thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
			
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Nombre"))
				If Type("vArticulos") = "L"
					Dimension vArticulos[1,8]
				Else
					Dimension vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) +1 , 8]
				Endif	
				
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 1] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 2] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 3] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Precio")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 4] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Total")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 5] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Internos")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 6] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Costo")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 7] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Bonificacion")
				vArticulos[ALen(vArticulos,1) , 8] = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Renglon")
					
			Endif
			
			thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		If nReg <> 0
			thisform.oDetalle.IrRegistro(nReg)
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarvencimientos
		Local mmpp ,nDiasCorridosCash
		
		thisform.oClientes.Buscar(thisform.Cliente,.f.,"clave")
		
		Dimension thisform.vVencimientos[1,3]
		thisform.vVencimientos[1,1]=0 && Dias
		thisform.vVencimientos[1,2]=0 && Porcentajes
		thisform.vVencimientos[1,3]=0 && Dias Cash
		
		
		**** Luciano
		mmpp=1
		thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Buscar(thisform.CondicionPago.Value+space(3),.t.)
		If thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("ID_Condicion")=thisform.CondicionPago.Value
			mmpp=1
			Do while thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("ID_Condicion")=thisform.CondicionPago.Value.and.!thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.EsEof()
				Dimension thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,3]
				if thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Fecha") = ctod("  /  /  ")	
				   thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,1]=thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Dias")	
		           thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,3]=thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Dias")+thisform.oClientes.Leer("DiasVencCash")			   
				else
				   thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,1]=Thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Fecha")-Thisform.Fecha.Value
				   thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,3]=(Thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Fecha")-Thisform.Fecha.Value)+thisform.oClientes.Leer("DiasVencCash")			   
				endif   
				thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2]=thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.Leer("Porcentaje")	
		
				
				thisform.oPlan_Vencimientos.IrSiguiente
				mmpp=mmpp+1
			Enddo
		Else	
			thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,1]=0	
			thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,2]=100	
			thisform.vVencimientos[mmpp,3]=0	
			
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cobrarcontado
		Local lCobranzaCorrecta, vAuxiliar
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		lCobranzaCorrecta=.t.
		thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.Comprobante.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
		= aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		
		If thisform.Remunerativo.And.!thisform.CuentaCorriente and thisform.Total.Value<>0
		*!*	If thisform.Remunerativo.And.!thisform.CuentaCorriente.and.thisform.Suma
			If !Empty(oApp.ConsultarCajaUsuario())
				If type ("thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado","tg_AltaCobContado")
					thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.Setear(thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Moneda,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Porc_Cob_Error"),oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"),ThisForm.Comprobante.Value,ThisForm.Cliente,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Banco"),thisform.Fecha.Value,@vAuxiliar)
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.SetearTotalACobrar(thisform.Total.Value)
				thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.Show
				lCobranzaCorrecta=thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.CobranzaFinalizada							
			Else
				=fMensAceptar(" No tiene ninguna caja asignada para hacer la cobranza ")
				lCobranzaCorrecta=.f.
			Endif	
		Endif
		Return lCobranzaCorrecta
	ENDPROC

		endif

	ENDPROC

		*!*	Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE confirmarsihaydescarga
		LParameters nRenglones
		
		local lhay
		**** Martin
		
		nRenglones=0
		
		lHay=.f.
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		Do While Not Thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
			If Not Empty(this.oDetalle.Leer("Id_SistemaBase"))
				lHay = .t.
			Else
				If  Not Empty(this.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")) or ;
					Not Empty(this.oDetalle.Leer("Detalle"))	
					
					nRenglones=nRenglones + 1			
					
				Endif	
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrRegistro(Thisform.Fila)
		
		Return lHay
		***** Martin
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultargrillavacia
		local lGrillaVacia
		
		lGrillaVacia=.t.
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		Do While Not Thisform.oDetalle.EsEof() and lGrillaVacia
			If Not Empty(this.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
				lGrillaVacia = .f.
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrRegistro(Thisform.Fila)
		
		Return lGrillaVacia
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlararticulo
		lParameters cId_Articulo,nCantidad
		
		Local lContinua
		
		lContinua = .t.
		
		If Thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
			If Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("CantMayoraCero") And nCantidad <= 0
				=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar una cantidad!")
				lContinua = .f.
			Endif
		Endif
		
		Return lContinua
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarprecioarticulo
		lParameters cId_Articulo,nPrecio
		
		Local lContinua
		
		lContinua = .t.
		*********** Diego 02-12-2008
		If Thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
			If Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("PrecioMayoraCero") And nPrecio <= 0
				=fMensAceptar("El precio debe ser mayor a Cero!")
				lContinua = .f.
			Endif
			
		Endif
		
		Return lContinua
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE copiararchivodetalle
		Local vCampos(1,2),mmpp
		
		
		thisform.oDetalle.FijarTag("ArtTalCol")
		thisform.oDetalleDesAgrupado.FijarTag("ArtTalCol")
		=Afields(vCampos,thisform.oDetalle.Alias)
		
		thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Do while !thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
		
			For mmpp = 1 to alen(vCampos,1)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,vCampos(mmpp,1),thisform.oDetalle.Leer(vCampos(mmpp,1)))
			EndFor
			thisform.oDetalleDesAgrupado.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()
			
		Enddo	
		
		thisform.oDetalle.FijarTag("")
		thisform.oDetalleDesAgrupado.FijarTag("")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE corregirrepeticionartcomaut
		lBorroRenglon=.f.
		
		Dimension vNumeroDetalle[1]
		
		If thisform.ConfComAut and Thisform.oParametros.Leer("CheckComAut") 
		
			nReg=thisform.oDetalle.Recno()
		
			thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()	
			mmpp=1
			Do While !thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
			
				If !empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero"))
				
					Dimension vNumeroDetalle[mmpp]
		
					If ascan(vNumeroDetalle,thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero"))=0	
						vNumeroDetalle[mmpp]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero")
					Else
						thisform.oDetalle.Borrar()
						lBorroRenglon=.t.	
					Endif	
				Endif
			    mmpp=mmpp+1
				thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()	
			Enddo
		
			thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()	
			Do While !thisform.oDetalle.EsEof() and nReg<>thisform.oDetalle.Recno()	
				thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()	
			Enddo
		
			
			If lBorroRenglon
		*		thisform.CalcularComprobante
			Endif	
			
		Endif
	ENDPROC

										 .f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.t.,.t.,.F.,.F., lAutoSavePDF)		
		*ENDIF
		**Chiara 07/01/18
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darcantidadderenglones
		local nRenglones, nRegistro
		
		if !thisform.Estado=TG_CONSULTACOMPROBANTE
		   nRegistro = Thisform.oDetalle.Recno()
		   nRenglones = 0
		
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		
		   Do while !Thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
		      if Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")<>space(15)
		         nRenglones = nRenglones + 1
		      endif
		      Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()   
		   Enddo
		
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		   Thisform.CantidadDeRenglones = nRenglones
		
		   Thisform.Tg_CantidadItems.caption = alltrim(str(Thisform.CantidadDeRenglones))
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE definirarticulo
		LParameters cInputMask,lNoModificarCampoNumero
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCantidad,cNumero,vVector,vVectorOrigen,lAlta
		
		If   !Thisform.CodArtTalleColor
			cNumero=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero")
		
			Thisform.oCstAdmTalleColor.DarDistribucion(cNumero,@vVectorOrigen)
		
			If Type("vVectorOrigen")="L"
				lAlta=.t.
			Else
				lAlta=.f.
			Endif		
		
		
		
			If type ("thisform.oFrmTalleColor")<>T_OBJECT
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmTalleColor","tg_AltaArticulosTalleColor",cInputMask)
			Endif
				
			thisform.DefineTalleColor=.t.
		
			thisform.oFrmTalleColor.Setear(thisform.odetalle.leer("id_articulo"),thisform.ValorAnterior,@vVectorOrigen,.t.,thisform.id_grupoTalle,thisform.id_grupocolor,thisform.Id_ListaPrecios,ThisForm.Cliente )
		
			thisform.oFrmTalleColor.Show
				
			thisform.DefineTalleColor=.f.
		
				
		
		
			If  !thisform.oFrmTalleColor.Cancelado
				nCantidad=thisform.oFrmTalleColor.DarCantidad()
				thisform.oFrmTalleColor.DarVectorArticulos(@vVector)	
		
				Thisform.oCstAdmTalleColor.RegistrarElemento(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"),@vVector,cNumero,lAlta )
					
				If !lNoModificarCampoNumero
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Numero", cNumero )
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cantidad", nCantidad )
					thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
				Endif	
					
			
			Endif
		
		
			thisform.DefineTalleColor=.f.
		
		Endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE definircentroscostos
		LParameters vCentrosCostos
		
		Local lContinua,lMostrarPantalla,vAux
		
		lContinua = .f.
		
		If ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Contabilidad")
			lContinua = .t.
			ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVentas.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
		 
			If lMostrarPantalla
				If type ("thisform.oFrmCentroCostos")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCentroCostos","Tg_FormCentroCostos")
				Endif
				thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.SetearConsulta(@vCentrosCostos)
				thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.Show			
				
				thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.DarVector(@vAux)
			
				dimension vCentrosCostos[Alen(vAux,1),9]
				=Acopy(vAux,vCentrosCostos)
		
			Endif
			
			If Type("vCentrosCostos") = "L"
				lContinua = .f.
			Endif
				
		Endif
		
		Return lContinua 
	ENDPROC

		LParameters cInputMask,cId_deposito,nPermiteFraccionarCantidadLote,lPermiteStockPorDepositoNegativoLote,lAf_Saldo_Original

					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cantidad", thisform.oFrmLotesArticulo.oTbxCantidad.Value )
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"cant_lotes_desc", thisform.oFrmLotesArticulo.oTbxCantidad.Value )
				Endif	
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cantidad_Lotes", thisform.oFrmLotesArticulo.CantidadLotes )

	PROCEDURE enviarmail
		**Chiara 07/01/18
		lParameters lEnvioPorMail
		Local espera,cmail,cPathPdfAdjunto, cCliente, lContinuo
		
		lContinuo = .T.
		cmail = ""
		cmailcliente = ""
		
		*If Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(oApp.Usuario,.f.,"Clave") And !Empty(Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("Mail"))
		
			If lEnvioPorMail
		
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oEMailItem") <> "L"
		
		*!*				If ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("AdjuntaPDFAutomatico") = 1
		*!*					espera = thisform.oParametros.Leer("esperagenerarpdf")
		*!*					Wait Window "Adjuntando PDF..." NoCLear Timeout espera
		*!*					Wait Clear	
		*!*					
		*!*					cCliente = strtran(ThisForm.Cliente," ","#")
		*!*						
		*!*					thisForm.oEmailItem.Adjuntar(AllTrim(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("PathPdf_Automatico")) + cCliente + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sucursal) + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sistema) + alltrim(thisform.Comprobante.Value) + alltrim(str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10)) + ".pdf")
		*!*				EndIf
		*!*				
		*!*				Thisform.oEMailItem.Enviar(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("AbreOutlook"))
		*!*				Thisform.oEmailItem=.f.
		
		*!*				Thisform.oDatosCliente.oFrmEnvioMail = .F.
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail=.F.	
		
		*!*			Else
					
					Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Buscar(thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Id_cliente")+"V", .F., "CLAVECLI")
					Do while !thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsClaveIgual()
		
						** SOLO LE ENVIO LE ENVIO EL COMPROBANTE AL CONTACO FE
						If Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("FE") And 	Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "V"
							cmailcliente = alltrim(Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Email")) + "; "
							cmail = cmail + cmailcliente
						Endif
					
						Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.IrSiguiente
					Enddo
		
					Thisform.oClientes.Buscar(thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Id_cliente"), .F., "Clave")			
					cmail = cmail + alltrim(thisform.oclientes.leer("internet"))
		
		*!*				If Empty(cmail) &&Thisform.MuestroVentanaMails && (Empty(cmail) or Thisform.MuestroVentanaMails)
		*!*						
		*!*					If ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("AdjuntaPDFAutomatico") = 1
		*!*						espera = thisform.oParametros.Leer("esperagenerarpdf")
		*!*						Wait Window "Adjuntando PDF..." NoCLear Timeout espera
		*!*						Wait Clear	
		*!*						
		*!*						cCliente = strtran(thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Id_cliente")," ","#")
		*!*						cPathPdfAdjunto =  AllTrim(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("PathPdf_Automatico")) + cCliente + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sucursal) + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sistema) + alltrim(thisform.Comprobante.Value) + alltrim(str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10)) + ".pdf"
		
		*!*						If Type("thisform.ofrmenviomail") <> T_OBJECT
		*!*							ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmEnvioMail","TG_FormMailAdjunto",cPathPdfAdjunto,ThisForm.cliente,.T.,cmail+";","V")
		*!*						Endif
		*!*						
		*!*						Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail.Show()					
		
		*!*					EndIf
		*!*					
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmEnvioMail=.F.	
		*!*				Else
						If Empty(cmail)
							If Type("thisform.oFrmMailFaltante") <> "O"
								ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmMailFaltante","TG_FormMailFaltante")
							Endif
							
							Thisform.oFrmMailFaltante.Setup()
							Thisform.oFrmMailFaltante.Show()	
							
							If !Thisform.oFrmMailFaltante.Cancelado
		
								cMail = Thisform.oFrmMailFaltante.oTbxMails.Value
								If fMensPregunto("¿Desea guardar por defecto el mail del cliente ingresado?","S")="S"
									thisform.oClientes.Buscar(thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Id_cliente"),.f.,"clave")
									=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Internet"	,cMail)
									thisform.oClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
								Endif						
								
							Else
								lContinuo = .F.
							Endif
						Endif
						
						If lContinuo
		
						    ThisForm.oEmailItem = CreateObject("Tg_Mail") 
		
							if Thisform.oTblVnt_enviomail.Buscar(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema")+Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba"), .F., "CLAVE")
								cMensaje = thisform.oEmailItem.generarasunto(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sucursal"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"))
								cCuerpo  = thisform.oEmailItem.generarcuerpo(Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sucursal"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_sistema"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("id_comproba"),Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"))
								ThisForm.oEmailItem.Generar(cmail," "," ",cCuerpo  , cMensaje,"","","","",thisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
							Else
								cMensaje = Iif(Empty(alltrim(Thisform.oClientes.Leer("Asunto_Mail"))), "Comprobante Nro.:" ,alltrim(Thisform.oClientes.Leer("Asunto_Mail")))
								cCuerpo  = "Estimado Cliente, se adjunta el comprobante Nro.: " + Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_externo")
								ThisForm.oEmailItem.Generar(cmail," "," ",cCuerpo, cMensaje+space(1)+ Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_externo")+ "-"+space(1)+ Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre")+"("+ Thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")+")","","","","",thisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisForm.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
							Endif
						
							*If ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("AdjuntaPDFAutomatico") = 1
								espera = thisform.oParametros.Leer("Esperagenerarpdf")
								Wait Window "Adjuntando PDF..." NoCLear Timeout espera
								Wait Clear	
								
								**** Matias L. 06/03/2023 #1582.
								
								IF This.oParametros.Leer("CambiarNombrePDF")
									cPathPdfAdjunto = AllTrim(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("PathPdf_Automatico")) + ALLTRIM(UPPER(strtran(this.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")," ","_"))) + "_" + ALLTRIM(this.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo")) + "_" + strtran(this.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")," ","#")+ ".pdf"
								ELSE
									cCliente = strtran(thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Id_cliente")," ","#")
									cPathPdfAdjunto =  AllTrim(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("PathPdf_Automatico")) + cCliente + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sucursal) + alltrim(thisform.Id_Sistema) + alltrim(thisform.Comprobante.Value) + alltrim(str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10)) + ".pdf"
								ENDIF
								**** Matias L. 06/03/2023 #1582
								
								thisForm.oEmailItem.Adjuntar(cPathPdfAdjunto)					
							*EndIf
								
								
							Thisform.oEMailItem.Enviar(ThisForm.oVnt_Docu.Leer("AbreOutlook"))
							Thisform.oEmailItem=.f.
		
		*!*						=fMensAceptar("El email fue enviado correctamente.")
		*!*					Else
		*!*						=fMensAceptar("El email no fue enviado, ya que la operacion fue cancelada")
						Endif
					*Endif
				*Endif
			Endif
		*!*	Else
		*!*		If lEnvioPorMail
		*!*			=fMensAceptar("El email no fue enviado, debe configurar la cuenta de correo. El archivo fue grabado en la carpeta correspondiente.")
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	ENDIF
		**Chiara 07/01/18
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE facturaelectronica
		Local vGrabacion, cmostrargeneracion, lPrestaServicios, lNoMostrarCartelesDeGeneracion
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		thisform.incoterms = "  "
		
		if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("fe_ws")
		
		   if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("fex_ws") &&& Exportacion
		   		
		   	   lPrestaServicios = .F.
		   	   
			   If thisform.oVnt_DocuBis.Buscar(thisform.Comprobante.Value,.f.,"Clave") And thisform.oVnt_DocuBis.Leer("presta_serv")
					lPrestaServicios = .T.
			   Endif
				
			   IF !lPrestaServicios
				   if Type("thisform.oFrmIncoterms")<>T_OBJECT
						 thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmIncoterms","tg_formafip_incoterms")
				   Endif	 
				   
				   Thisform.oFrmIncoterms.Tg_afip_incoterms1.Value = "  "
				   Thisform.oFrmIncoterms.Show()
				   
				   Thisform.Incoterms = alltrim(Thisform.oFrmIncoterms.Tg_afip_incoterms1.Value)
		
		
				   thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
				   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_incoterms"	, Thisform.Incoterms )
				   thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		       ENDIF
		       
		    Endif
		  &&& Exportacion
		   thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
			cmostrargeneracion = alltrim(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre"))+space(1)+str(thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Total"),8,2)
			
			&& COMENTADO PARA QUE NO LO SOLICITE SIEMPRE QUE GENERO UN COMPROBANTE
			*If fMensPregunto("Desea Generar Cae para "+ cmostrargeneracion  +" ?","S")="S"
				if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("fe_ws")
				
					WAIT WINDOW thisForm.Cliente + " FE" NOWAIT 
					If Type("thisform.oCstFacturaElectronica")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.AddObject("oCstFacturaElectronica","tg_facturaelectronica_cst")
					Endif	
					
					lNoMostrarCartelesDeGeneracion = .T.
					
					if !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("fex_ws")
					 	thisform.oCstFacturaElectronica.GeneroCae(thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,thisform.Comprobante.Value,thisform.Referencia.Value,lNoMostrarCartelesDeGeneracion)
					else
						thisform.oCstFacturaElectronica.GeneroCae_fex(thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,thisform.Comprobante.Value,thisform.Referencia.Value)		
					endif		
				endif
			*Endif		
		Endif
		***** Diego Factura Electronica
		****Factura Electronica
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabar
		LParameters vVectorDescargaIndividual
		
		Local cControl,lCancelaGrabacion,lGrabarComprobante,cOldError, lClaveRepetida
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cID_comproba,nReferencia,nCopias,vCentroCostos, nExternoDefinitivo
		Local vGrabar,nColumnaGrilla,nColumnaOrden
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		*damedco
		Local cId_Suc_Com_grilla, cId_Sis_Com_Grilla, cId_Com_Com_grilla, nNro_referencia_Com_Grilla
		
		Dimension vGrabar [1,2]
		
		
		lCancelaGrabacion=.f.
		lValidaFechas    =.f.
		*THISFORM.nVecesDetalleEditable = 1
		If  thisform.tg_grid1.ActiveColumn>0 
		    *wait wind "entre"
			
		
			nColumnaOrden=thisform.tg_grid1.ActiveColumn
			
		*	wait wind "Orden de la columna "+alltrim(str(nColumnaOrden))
			For nColumnaGrilla=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
				If thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).ColumnOrder=nColumnaOrden
		*			wait wind "numero de la columna "+alltrim(str(nColumnaGrilla))
				
					Exit
				Endif
			Endfor
			cControl=thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).CurrentControl
		*	wait wind "Control de  columna "+cControl
		
			
		*	wait wind "comparo "+alltrim(str(thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..value))
			
		*	wait wind +" con esto "+alltrim(str(Eval(thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..ControlSource)))
			
			thisform.ValorAnterior=thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..Value
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..Valid
			
			If thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..value<>Eval(thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnaGrilla).&cControl..ControlSource)
		*		wait wind "son diferentes"
				=fMensAceptar("Se ha modificado el valor de la celda sin confirmarlo")
				lCancelaGrabacion=.t.
			Endif
			
			*thisform.CalcularComprobante
		
		
		*!*		cControl=thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(thisform.tg_grid1.ActiveColumn-nRestaColumna).CurrentControl
		
		*!*		If thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(thisform.tg_grid1.ActiveColumn-nRestaColumna).&cControl..value<>Eval(thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(thisform.tg_grid1.ActiveColumn-nRestaColumna).&cControl..ControlSource)
		*!*			=fMensAceptar("Se ha modificado el valor de la celda sin confirmarlo")
		*!*			lCancelaGrabacion=.t.
		*!*		Endif
		Endif	
		
		*!*	If !lCancelaGrabacion And Thisform.controlarnroexterno
		*!*		*** valida que no se repitan numeros externos dependiendo de los parametros
		*!*		If thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(ThisForm.Comprobante.Value+ThisForm.Numero.Value,.f.,"Externo")	
		*!*			=fMensAceptar("El numero externo esta repetido, ingrese un numero valido!")
		*!*			lCancelaGrabacion=.t.
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	Endif
		
		
		*************  Diego 11-02-2008
		thisform.oVnt_docu.Buscar(thisform.Comprobante.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
		************ Permite anticipo - Cuenta Correintes y existe mas de una cuota
		if thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("permiteanticipo") and thisform.CuentaCorriente  and alen(thisform.vVencimientos,1)>1
		        
		      if Type("thisform.oFrmAnticipo")<>T_OBJECT
				 thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAnticipo","Tg_FormAnticipo")
			  Endif	 
		
			  Thisform.oFrmAnticipo.oTbxAnticipo.Value = 0

	PROCEDURE grabarbanco
		Local mmpp,lHayDepositos,vGrabacion[1,2],nTotalComprobante,cId_Banco,cId_moneda
		
		*!*	Grabacion de cabecera de comprobantes
		thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(ThisForm.Comprobante.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		If thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Banco") and thisform.Remunerativo.And.!thisform.CuentaCorriente.and.thisform.Suma and type("ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado")="O"
			lHayDepositos=.f.
			mmpp=1
			cId_Banco=""
			nTotalComprobante=0
			for mmpp=1 to alen(ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores,1)
				
				if ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,1]<>0 and ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,4]="DB"
							
					lHayDepositos=.t.
						 	
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,ThisForm.Comprobante.Value)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,thisform.Id_Sistema)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,thisform.Referencia.Value)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,thisform.Id_Sucursal)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Valor"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,3])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Moneda"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,2])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Monto"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,1])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Est_Hasta"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,19])		
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Ingreso"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,22])		
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Est_Desde"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,18])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Orden"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,13])
			
						
					thisform.oBan_Detalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					cId_Banco=thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,5]		
					cId_Moneda=thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,2]
					nTotalComprobante=nTotalComprobante+thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,1]
				Endif	
				
			
			EndFor
		
			If lHayDepositos
			
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,ThisForm.Comprobante.Value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,thisform.Id_Sistema)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,thisform.Referencia.Value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Externo"		,thisform.Numero.Value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,thisform.Id_Sucursal)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"			,thisform.Fecha.Value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Usuario"		,oApp.Usuario)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			,oApp.Maquina)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				,Time())
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		,Date())
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma"				,.t.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Mon_impresion"	,cId_Moneda)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_CtaBanco"		,cId_Banco)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"			,nTotalComprobante)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			,"Cliente "+Alltrim(thisform.RazonSocial.Value)+space(1)+"("+alltrim(ThisForm.Cliente)+")")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_concepto"		,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Concepto"))
			
				thisform.oBan_Cabecera.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			
				thisform.oCstSistemaBanco.GrabarSaldo(cId_Banco,.t.,nTotalComprobante)				
			
				thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Af_Banco"			,.t.)
				thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			
			Endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarcaja
		Local mmpp,nBonificacionEquivalente,lGrabarCabecera,vGrabacion
		lGrabarCabecera=.f.
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		*!*	If thisform.Remunerativo.And.!thisform.CuentaCorriente.and.thisform.Suma
		If thisform.Remunerativo.And.!thisform.CuentaCorriente and Type("ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado")="O"
			thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(ThisForm.comprobante.Value,.f.,"Clave")		
			lGrabarCabecera=.t.
			
			ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.RegistrarNumeracionValores
			ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.GrabarValores(thisform.Referencia.Value,thisform.Numero.Value,thisform.Fecha.Value,"Venta Contado")	
		
			*!*	Grabacion de cabecera de comprobantes
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,ThisForm.comprobante.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,thisform.Id_Sistema)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,thisform.Referencia.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Externo"		,thisform.Numero.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,thisform.Id_Sucursal)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"			,thisform.Fecha.Value)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Usuario"		,oApp.Usuario)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			,oApp.Maquina)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				,Time())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		,Date())
			**** Martin
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma"				,Thisform.Suma)
			**** Martin
		*!*		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Af_Caja"				,1)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Mon_impresion"	,thisform.oPrecioImpresion.Moneda)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_caja"			,oApp.ConsultarCajaUsuario())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.Total)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			,"Venta Contado")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_concepto"		,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Concepto"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente"		,ThisForm.Cliente)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			,thisform.RazonSocial.Value)
		
			thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		
		
			*!*	Grabacion de detalle de comprobante
		
		
			*!*	Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
			mmpp=1
			for mmpp=1 to alen(ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores,1)
				
				if ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,1]<>0
					
					 	
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,ThisForm.Comprobante.Value)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,thisform.Id_Sistema)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,thisform.Referencia.Value)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,thisform.Id_Sucursal)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Valor"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,3])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Moneda"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,2])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Monto"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,1])
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Est_Hasta"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,19])						
					***** Martin
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Ingreso"			,thisform.Suma)						
					***** Martin
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Est_Desde"		,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,18])						
					
					if ThisForm.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,4]<>"EF"
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Orden"			,thisform.oFrmCobVentaContado.tg_EntSalValores1.vValores[mmpp,13])
					Endif	
		
		
					thisform.oCaj_Detalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				
				
				Endif	
			
		
			EndFor
			
		Endif	
		
		If lGrabarCabecera
			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Af_Caja"			,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Caja"))
			thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		Endif	
		
			
		Return lGrabarCabecera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarcomprobantes

		thisForm.lblProcesando.Caption = ""

		*** Chiara 18/03/19
		
		if lconfirma

			Do while .not. thisform.oViewClimasiva.Eseof()
				
			   if thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Imprime")
			   		*** Chiara 18/03/19

					thisform.MontoIva1 		 = thisform.oViewClimasiva.Leer("Iva")

	PROCEDURE grabarestadocomprobante
		Local cEstadoHasta, cNombreEstado, cClave
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		cClave = oApp.CodSucursal() + oApp.CodSistema("Ventas") + thisform.Comprobante.Value + str(ThisForm.Referencia.Value,10)
		** EN CASO DE QUE EL COMPROBANTE SE HAYA PRODUCIDO POR UNA DESCARGA, PREGUNTO SINO TOMA EL ESTADO DEL COMPROBANTE BASE
		if thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar (thisform.Comprobante.Value, .f., "CLAVE")
			if thisform.oVnt_Docu.leer("DescargaEstado") and thisform.oTblVnt_Descarga.Buscar(cClave, .f., "CLAVE")
				if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar (cClave)
					if thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Buscar(thisform.oTblVnt_Descarga.Leer("Id_SucursalDesc") +;
														 thisform.oTblVnt_Descarga.Leer("Id_SistemaDesc")  +;
														 thisform.oTblVnt_Descarga.Leer("Id_ComprobaDesc") +; 
														 str(thisform.oTblVnt_Descarga.Leer("Nro_ReferenciaDesc"),10), .f., "CLAVE")
							
						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_EstadoComproba", thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Id_EstadoComproba"))
						thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Modificar (@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
					endif
				endif	
			else
				**Se graba el estado del comprobante
				thisform.oCstDefinCondicionEstado.AsignarEstadoComproba(oApp.CodSucursal(), oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"), thisform.Comprobante.Value, ThisForm.Referencia.Value, space(3))
				**
		
		
				if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar (cClave)
					cEstadoHasta = thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_EstadoComproba")
					if thisform.oTblEstadosComproba.Buscar (cEstadoHasta)
						cNombreEstado = thisform.oTblEstadosComproba.Leer("Nombre")
						if thisform.oTblEstadosComproba.Leer("MuestraEstado")
							=fMensAceptar ("El Comprobante ha pasado al Estado : " + alltrim(cNombreEstado))
						endif
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarimportacion
		Local vGrabacion,mmpp,lGrabarCabecera,vDespachosActualizados,mmpp,nTotal
		Local nCantlotes,nCantdespachos,nCantidadPendiente,lNoExistelote
		 
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		Dimension vDespachosActualizados[1,3]
		Dimension vRelacionDespachos[1,3]
		Dimension vectordespachosporlotes[1,2]
		
		
		
		********* Diego
		
		lGrabarCabecera=.f.
		If Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Importacion")<>0
		
		
			*!*	Grabacion de detalle del comprobante de Importacion
		
			thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
			nTotal=0
			Do while !thisform.oVnt_Detalle.EsEof().and.Thisform.oVnt_detalle.EsClaveIgual()
						
				if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")).and.thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad")<>0
				              
				              ************* Blanquear vector !!!!!!!!!!!!!
				              Dimension vectordespachosporlotes[1]
				              Dimension aux_vectordespachosporlotes[1]
				              
				              vectordespachosporlotes[1] = .f.
				              aux_vectordespachosporlotes[1] = .f.
		                      
		                       thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10)+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Numero")) 		              
		                      **********	
		                       
		  	                   Do while !thisform.oTblMovartlotes.EsEof().and.(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10)+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Numero"))=(thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+ str(thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) +thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("Numero"))
		                             
		                             
		                             *************** Hay que recorrer relacionlotedespacho    !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!*************** 
		                             thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Buscar(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("id_lote")) 		                     
		                             
		                             
		                             *********** Recorro Relacion Lote Despacho
		                             Do while !Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.EsEof().and.(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")++thisform.oTblMovartlotes.Leer("id_lote"))=(Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("Id_Articulo")+Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("id_lote"))                             
		                              
				                     thisform.oImp_Stock.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("id_despacho")+thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("id_origen"))      
				                     **************id_sucursal+id_articulo+id_despacho+id_origen
		
				                         
				                     if (thisform.oImp_Stock.Leer("saldo")>0) or  Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Importacion")<0
		                                    if TYPE("vectordespachosporlotes") = "L"
		                                                Dimension vectordespachosporlotes(1,3) 
		                                                i = 1
				                            else
				                                	   Dimension vectordespachosporlotes(alen(vectordespachosporlotes,1)+1,3) 
			  	        	                            i = alen(vectordespachosporlotes,1) 
		                                    endif   
		                                    thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Buscar (Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10))          
											vectordespachosporlotes[i,1]=thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("id_despacho")
											vectordespachosporlotes[i,2]=thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.Leer("id_origen")
											vectordespachosporlotes[i,3]=dtos(thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))
		
				                          ****** Grabo vector !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!************
		
				                     endif    
		                             *****************
				                      thisform.oTblRelacionloteDespacho.IrSiguiente 
				                     
				                     Enddo
				                        
				               		thisform.oTblMovartlotes.IrSiguiente 
				              Enddo
		
		                    if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Importacion") > 0 and  Type("vectordespachosporlotes") <> "L"
				                    =Asort(vectordespachosporlotes,3,-1,3)    
				            endif        
		
		
				            lNoExistelote = .f.
		
				              If Type("vectordespachosporlotes") = "L"
		                       	     nCantLotes=1   && definir como local la variable nCantLotes
		                       	     lNoExistelote = .t.
						  	  Else
			    		 			  nCantLotes=alen(vectordespachosporlotes,1)
							   Endif
		
							nCantDespachos=1
							
							nCantidadPendiente=thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad")
							
							Do While (nCantDespachos<=nCantLotes) and nCantidadPendiente>0
							
		
					        
					            if lNoExistelote 
				                   If Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Importacion")<0
						   				thisform.oImportacion.DescargarDespachos(@vDespachosActualizados,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_articulo"),thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"),thisform.Id_Sucursal)
				    				Else
									   thisform.oImportacion.CargarDespachos(@vDespachosActualizados,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_articulo"),thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"),thisform.Id_Sucursal)			
									Endif	
									**************
									
									
		                        else
		                           If Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Af_Importacion")<0
								      thisform.oImportacion.DescargarDespachos(@vDespachosActualizados,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_articulo"),nCantidadPendiente,thisform.Id_Sucursal,vectordespachosporlotes(ncantdespachos,1),vectordespachosporlotes(ncantdespachos,2))
									Else
									   thisform.oImportacion.CargarDespachos(@vDespachosActualizados,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_articulo"),nCantidadPendiente,thisform.Id_Sucursal,vectordespachosporlotes(ncantdespachos,1),vectordespachosporlotes(ncantdespachos,2))			
							        Endif	
					            
		  	   					Endif  
		 
				
				
				                  
								If Type("vDespachosActualizados[1,3]")<>T_LOGICAL
									lGrabarCabecera=.t.
								For mmpp=1 to alen(vDespachosActualizados,1)
