	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_articulos2.Valid
		Local lValidacion,vGrabacion,nPrecio,nBonif, vAuxiliar,nRegAnteriorVnt_detalle,nRegAnteriorVnt_Cabecera
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		Local nDescGrilla1,nDescGrilla2,nDescGrilla3,nDescGrilla4,nDescGrilla5
		*****
		
		Local lLimpiarDescarga, lDetalleEditableAmpliado, cNombreDetalleEditableAmpliado, vGrabacionDetalle
		local nPrecioListaAux
		
		** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGA COMO LOCAL LA VARIABLE nPorcIvaArticulo y cId_AlicuotaIva *********
		local nPorcIvaArticulo, cId_AlicuotaIva
		
		Local cid_listabuscar
		
		nPorcIvaArticulo = 0
		cId_AlicuotaIva = ""
		*************************************************************************************
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		*damedco
		Local lExistePrecioFijo
		lExistePrecioFijo = .f.
		*damedco tema refresco de datos muevo puntero primer objeto que darbonificacion grilla tambien mueve
		Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.IrUltimo()
		Thisform.oTblVnt_DetalleGrillasDescuento.IrPrimero()
		****
		
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		Dimension vGrabacionDetalle [1,2]
		Dimension vAuxiliar [1]
		
		nPrecioListaAux = 0
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* damedco
		
		thisform.LineaValidada=.f.
		if ((!thisform.GrillaTieneFoco and !thisform.ConfComAut) or thisform.BorrandoRenglon) and thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(this.Value,.f.,"Clave")&&& or (thisform.CodArtTalleColor and empty(this.Value) and empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("id_articulo")))
			Return .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.ArticuloValidado		= .t.
		lDetalleEditableAmpliado 		= .f.
		cNombreDetalleEditableAmpliado 	= ""
		
		If thisform.CodArtTalleColor and empty(this.Value)
			this.Value=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("id_articulo")
		endif
		
		
		&& Es importante aclarar que se asume que cuando estamos en modo consulta
		&& estamos parado en el archivo vnt_cabecera en el registro correspondiente
		&& al comprobante consultado
		
		
		
		if !thisform.TerminoRenglon or thisform.ConfComAut
			lVAlidacion=tg_textClave::valid()  and thisform.ValidarTasasDeIva(this.Value) 
			
		 	thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(this.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
			if lValidacion and !empty(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_subrubro")) and Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_subrubro")<>thisform.oArticulos.leer("Id_SubRubro")
				lValidacion=.f.
				
				thisform.oSubRubros.Buscar(Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_subrubro"))
		
				=fMensAceptar("El articulo debe ser del subrubro "+alltrim(thisform.oSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")))	
			Endif
			
			
			
			
			If lValidacion and thisform.CodArtTalleColor
				If  !Empty(thisform.oArticulos.leer("Id_GrupoTalle")) or !Empty(thisform.oArticulos.leer("Id_GrupoColor"))
					If empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("id_codarttallecolor")) 
						lValidacion=.f.
						=fMensAceptar("El articulo debe ser completado en la columna Art Tal/Col")
									
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
			
			
			if thisform.ValidaArticuloRepetido(this.value)		
			   =fMensAceptar("El Articulo ya ha sido ingresado !!!")
			   return .f.
			endif
			
		*!*		If lValidacion
		*!*			If !thisform.ValidarTasasDeIva(this.Value)
		*!*				lValidacion=.f.
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		Endif
			if lValidacion
			
			 	thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(this.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		        
		        *edgardo pase version tasas ivas	 	
				*damedco
				*Busco al articulo en Lista de Precios Fijos
		        if thisform.id_listapreciofijo <> ""
		           If Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(This.Value+Thisform.Id_listaPrecioFijo,.f.,"Clave")
		              if thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")<>0
		                 lExistePrecioFijo = .t.
		              endif				 		
		           endif
		        endif	
			 	
			 	If !Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("inactivo")
					If !thisform.ConfComAut
					
						vGrabacion[1,1]="Det_editable"
					   	vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Det_Editable")
				 		thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
		*!*					If thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")=0 or !Empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero")) And this.Value<>thisform.ValorAnterior
			 		
						If thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")=0  or this.Value<>thisform.ValorAnterior
						    vGrabacion[1,1]="Cantidad"
						   	vGrabacion[1,2]=0
					   	  	thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
					   	  	
		   	  			    vGrabacion[1,1]="Total"
						   	vGrabacion[1,2]=0
					   	  	thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)				   	
					   	  	
						Endif
						  	
		*!*					If Empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer(Nombre)) and lastkey()=chr(13)
		*!*						vGrabacion[1,1]="Nombre"
		*!*						vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("Nombre")
		*!*						thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
		*!*					Endif
						If this.Value<>thisform.ValorAnterior	
							lLimpiarDescarga = .t.
							If thisform.oArticulos.leer("Nombre") = thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Nombre") 
								lLimpiarDescarga = .f.
							Endif
							
							* modificaciones vick
							vGrabacion[1,1]="Ubicacion1"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("Ubicacion1")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
							**************************
		
							vGrabacion[1,1]="Nombre"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("Nombre")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
							vGrabacion[1,1]="ExentoPercIb"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIb")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
							vGrabacion[1,1]="ExentoPercIva"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercIva")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
		  					vGrabacion[1,1]="ExentoPercGananc"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("ExentoPercGananc")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
		
				  		  	vGrabacion[1,1]="coef_uni_med2"
							vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oArticulos.leer("coef_uni_med2")
							thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
				  			
				  			** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGA EL CAMPO "PORC_IVA", Y SE GRABA EN TABLA BUFFER "DETALLE" ****************
							nPorcIvaArticulo = thisform.oCstVentas.CalcularTasaIvaArticulo(this.Value)
							if thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar (nPorcIvaArticulo, .f., "PORCENTAJE")  
								cId_AlicuotaIva = thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva")
					  		  	vGrabacion[1,1]	= "Id_AlicuotaIva"
								vGrabacion[1,2]	= cId_AlicuotaIva
								thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
							endif
				  		  	vGrabacion[1,1]="Porc_Iva"

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column11.Text1.GotFocus
		Local nProximaFila
		
		If !empty(this.value) or !empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		
			if thisform.TerminoRenglon and !thisform.oDetalle.EsFinal()
		
				nProximaFila=thisform.Fila + 1  &&thisform.nRenglonesdDetalleAmpliado
				thisform.oDetalle.IrRegistro(nProximaFila)
				thisform.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(nProximaFila,1)
		
			endif
		Else
			thisform.TerminoRenglon=.f.
		Endif		
		
		*Thisform.darcantidadderenglones()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column11.Text1.Valid
		&& Sport Trends Gustavo Agregar variable locales  ,cId_Talle,cId_color y cid_articulotallecolor,lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
		Local cId_Talle,cId_color,cId_ArticuloTalleColor,lValidacionCodArtTalleColor,vGrabacion,mmpp
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		
		if (!thisform.GrillaTieneFoco and !thisform.ConfComAut) or thisform.BorrandoRenglon or empty(this.value)
		    
			Return .t.
		Endif
		
		If  thisform.ReleaseType=1.or.thisform.WindowsTate=1.or.Type("_screen.ActiveForm")<>"O".Or._screen.ActiveForm.Caption<>thisform.Caption
			If Type("_screen.ActiveForm")<>"O".Or.(thisform.ReleaseType<>1.and.thisform.WindowsTate<>1.and._screen.ActiveForm.WindowType=0)	
				thisform.RegistrarControlAValidar(this)
			Endif	
		    Return .t.
		Endif
		
		
		
		&& Sport Trends Gustavo  ini
		lValidacionCodArtTalleColor=.f.
		cId_talle=""
		cId_Color=""
		cId_ArticuloTalleColor=""	
		
		
			
		If Thisform.CodArtTalleColor and  !thisform.ConfComAut
		
			cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara=alltrim(this.Value)
			If thisform.oParametros.ExisteCampo("Gandara") and  thisform.oParametros.Leer("Gandara") and len(cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara)>15
				cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara=substr(cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara,1,len(cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara)-8)
			Endif	
			mmpp=0	
			Do while !lValidacionCodArtTalleColor and mmpp<=2
				cId_ArticuloTalleColor=cId_ArticuloTalleColorGandara+space(mmpp)
		
		
		
				
		*!*			If thisform.oParametros.ExisteCampo("Gandara") and  thisform.oParametros.Leer("Gandara") and len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)>15
		*!*				Wait wind "Entre a sacarle los ocho caracteres finales "
		*!*				cId_ArticuloTalleColor=substr(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,1,len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)-8)
		*!*				Wait wind "Resultado de  sacarle los ocho caracteres finales: "+cId_ArticuloTalleColor
		*!*			Endif	
					
		
				cId_talle=right(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,3)
		
				
				If len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)>3
					cId_ArticuloTalleColor=SubStr(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,1,len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)-3)
				Endif	
				If len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)>3
					cId_color=right(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,3)
				Else	
					cId_color=""
				Endif
				
				If len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)>3	
					cId_ArticuloTalleColor=SubStr(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,1,len(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)-3)
				Else	
					cId_ArticuloTalleColor=""
				Endif
				
		
				
				lValidacionCodArtTalleColor=thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloTalleColor,.f.,"Clave")
				
				
				If lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
					
					If  !thisform.oTblRelacionTalle.Buscar(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoTalle")+cId_talle) or !thisform.oTblRelacionColor.Buscar(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoColor")+cId_Color)
		
						lValidacionCodArtTalleColor=.f.
						
					Endif	
					
				Endif	
				mmpp=mmpp+1
			Enddo	
			
			If lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
					
				vGrabacion[1,1]="CodArtTalle"
			   	vGrabacion[1,2]=cId_Talle
				thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
				
				vGrabacion[1,1]="CodArtColor"
			   	vGrabacion[1,2]=cId_Color
				thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
				
				vGrabacion[1,1]="id_articulo"
			   	vGrabacion[1,2]=alltrim(cId_ArticuloTalleColor)
				thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
				
		
				
			Endif	
			
		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.terminorenglon=!lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
		
		If !lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
			=fmensaceptar("Codigo incorrecto, verifique articulo talle o color para el articulo indicado")
		Else
			
			If this.Value<>thisform.ValorAnterior
			
				thisform.tg_grid1.column1.tg_articulos2.when
		*  	    thisform.ValorAnterior="XXXXXXXXX"
				thisform.tg_grid1.column1.tg_articulos2.Valid	
			Endif	
			
		Endif
		
		
		Return lValidacionCodArtTalleColor
		&& Sport Trends Gustavo  Fin
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column11.Text1.When
		thisform.ValorAnterior=this.value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.When
		local lRetorna
		lRetorna=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Det_Editable") and !thisform.Vacio(thisform.odetalle.leer("id_articulo"))
		
		*this.ForeColor=thisform.ColorDinamico(lRetorna)
		return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.oTbxDescarga.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nkeycode,nshiftaltctrl
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		If nKeyCode = 13 And This.Value =0 and Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Lotea")
		
			If Empty(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Numero"))		
			    vGrabacion[1,1]="Numero"
				vGrabacion[1,2]=thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Renglon")
			    thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
			Endif
		
			Thisform.DefinirLotesArticulo(This.inputMask,Thisform.Id_deposito,Thisform.PermiteFraccionarCantidadLote,Thisform.PermiteStockPorDepositoNegativoLote,Thisform.af_saldo_orig_lote)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.oTbxDescarga.LostFocus
		If thisform.ValorAnterior<>this.value
			this.value=	thisform.ValorAnterior
		Endif
		
		If Thisform.Lotea && and  Thisform.oDetalle.leer("Lotea")
			this.Parent.Enabled=.t.
			this.Parent.ReadOnly=.t.
			
		Else
			this.Parent.Enabled=.f.
			this.Parent.ReadOnly=.t.
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.oTbxDescarga.RightClick
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)

		**en caso de tener CLAVE REPETIDA DIRECTAMENTE REINICIO
		*if thisform.ClaveRepetida
		*	thisform.Reiniciar
		*endif
		*******************************************************
				
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		go top in ArticulosRepetidos
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource="ArticulosRepetidos"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Fecha"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Nro_Externo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Id_articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Cantidad"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource="ArticulosRepetidos.Cant_Pendiente"
		    
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		LParameters vArticulosRepetidos
		
		Local vCursor, i
		Thisform.ContinuarProceso = .f.
		
		Dimension vCursor[8,4]
		
		vCursor[1,1]="Fecha"
		vCursor[1,2]="D"
		vCursor[1,3]=10
		vCursor[1,4]=0
		vCursor[2,1]="Id_Comproba"
		vCursor[2,2]="C"
		vCursor[2,3]=3
		vCursor[2,4]=0
		vCursor[3,1]="Nro_Referencia"
		vCursor[3,2]="N"
		vCursor[3,3]=10
		vCursor[3,4]=0
		vCursor[4,1]="Nro_Externo"
		vCursor[4,2]="C"
		vCursor[4,3]=13
		vCursor[4,4]=0
		vCursor[5,1]="Id_articulo"
		vCursor[5,2]="C"
		vCursor[5,3]=15
		vCursor[5,4]=0
		vCursor[6,1]="Nombre"
		vCursor[6,2]="C"
		vCursor[6,3]=50
		vCursor[6,4]=0
		vCursor[7,1]="Cantidad"
		vCursor[7,2]="N"
		vCursor[7,3]=15
		vCursor[7,4]=2
		vCursor[8,1]="Cant_Pendiente"
		vCursor[8,2]="N"
		vCursor[8,3]=15
		vCursor[8,4]=2
		
		create cursor ArticulosRepetidos from array vcursor
		
		delete all in ArticulosRepetidos
		
		For i = 1 to Alen(vArticulosRepetidos,1)
		    append blank in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Fecha		 	with vArticulosRepetidos[i,1] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Id_Comproba		with vArticulosRepetidos[i,2] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Nro_Referencia	with vArticulosRepetidos[i,3] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Nro_Externo		with vArticulosRepetidos[i,4] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Id_articulo		with vArticulosRepetidos[i,5] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Nombre			with vArticulosRepetidos[i,6] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Cantidad		with vArticulosRepetidos[i,7] in ArticulosRepetidos
		    Replace Cant_Pendiente	with vArticulosRepetidos[i,8] in ArticulosRepetidos
		NEXT
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarregistro
		local nCont
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nCont = 1
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEof()
			nCont = nCont+ 1
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_domicilio", padl(nCont, 3, "0"))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cliente"	, thisForm.id_cliente)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "numero"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "complejo"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "piso"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "departamento", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "barrio"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cod_postal"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "localidad"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "provincia"	, "") 
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, .F.)
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
		
		If !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.EsTablaVacia()
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.borrar()
			thisForm.tg_Grid1.refresh()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardardirecciones
		if thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.buscar(thisForm.Id_cliente, .F., "cliente")
			do while !thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.esEof() AND thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.esClaveIgual()
				thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.borrar()
				thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.irSiguiente()
			endDo
		endIf	
		
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEoF()
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_domicilio", thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_domicilio"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cliente"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_cliente"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "calle"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("calle"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "numero"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("numero"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "complejo"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("complejo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "piso"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("piso"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "departamento", thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("departamento"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "barrio"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("barrio"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cod_postal"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("cod_postal"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "localidad"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("localidad"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "provincia"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("provincia")) 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("defecto"))
			thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		&&thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		lParameters lConsulta, lAbm
		
		for i = 1 TO thisForm.tg_grid1.columnCount
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Columns(i).readOnly = lConsulta
		endFor		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column5.tg_cmbProvincias1.Enabled = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdAgregar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdBorrar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdGuardar.Visible = !lConsulta
		if lConsulta AND !lAbm
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .T.
		else	
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .F.
		ENDIF
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
		&&thisForm.oCmdSalir.Visible = lAbm
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		doDefault()
		
		
		thisForm.addObject("oTblClientes", "tg_tabla", "clientes", "Clave")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblDomicilios_clientes", "tg_tabla", "domicilios_clientes", "Cliente")
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewDomiciliosClientes", "tg_viewDomiciliosClientes")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column1.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".calle"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column2.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".numero"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".barrio"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column4.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".localidad"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column5.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".provincia"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column6.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".piso"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column7.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".complejo"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column8.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".departamento"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column9.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".cod_postal"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column10.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".defecto"
		
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarycerrar
		thisForm.id_domicilio = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_domicilio")
		thisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
		lParameters cId_cliente, lConsulta, lAbm
		
		thisForm.id_cliente = cId_cliente
		
		if thisForm.oTblClientes.buscar(cId_cliente, .F., "Clave")
			thisForm.oTxtCliente.value = thisForm.oTblClientes.leer("Razon_social")	
		ENDIF
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.refrescar(cId_cliente)
		
		thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisForm.habilitarControles(lConsulta, lAbm)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAgregar.Click
		thisForm.agregarRegistro()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdBorrar.Click
		thisForm.borrarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGuardar.Click
		If fMensPregunto("¿Desea guardar los cambios realizados?","S") = "S"
			thisForm.guardarDirecciones()
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
		Thisform.id_domicilio = ""
		thisForm.Hide()
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		thisForm.seleccionarYCerrar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column10.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		local nRegistro, lValor
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		nRegistro = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.recno()
		lValor = thisForm.tg_grid1.column10.tg_checkbox1.value
		
		if lValor
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
			do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEoF()
				if thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.recno() <> nRegistro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto", !lValor)
					thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				endIf
		
				thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
			endDo	
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irRegistro(nRegistro)
		endIf
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE agregarregistro
		local nCont
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nCont = 1
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEof()
			nCont = nCont+ 1
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_domicilio", padl(nCont, 3, "0"))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cliente"	, thisForm.id_cliente)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "numero"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "complejo"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "piso"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "departamento", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "barrio"		, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cod_postal"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "localidad"	, "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "provincia"	, "") 
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, .F.)
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
		
		If !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.EsTablaVacia()
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.borrar()
			thisForm.tg_Grid1.refresh()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardardirecciones
		if thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.buscar(thisForm.Id_cliente, .F., "cliente")
			do while !thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.esEof() AND thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.esClaveIgual()
				thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.borrar()
				thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.irSiguiente()
			endDo
		endIf	
		
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEoF()
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_domicilio", thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_domicilio"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cliente"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_cliente"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "calle"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("calle"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "numero"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("numero"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "complejo"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("complejo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "piso"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("piso"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "departamento", thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("departamento"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "barrio"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("barrio"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cod_postal"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("cod_postal"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "localidad"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("localidad"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "provincia"	, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("provincia")) 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("defecto"))
			thisForm.oTblDomicilios_clientes.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		&&thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		lParameters lConsulta, lAbm
		
		for i = 1 TO thisForm.tg_grid1.columnCount
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Columns(i).readOnly = lConsulta
		endFor		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column5.tg_cmbProvincias1.Enabled = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdAgregar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdBorrar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdGuardar.Visible = !lConsulta
		if lConsulta AND !lAbm
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .T.
		else	
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .F.
		endIf
		thisForm.oCmdSalir.Visible = lAbm
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		doDefault()
		
		
		thisForm.addObject("oTblClientes", "tg_tabla", "clientes", "Clave")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblDomicilios_clientes", "tg_tabla", "domicilios_clientes", "Cliente")
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewDomiciliosClientes", "tg_viewDomiciliosClientes")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column1.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".calle"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column2.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".numero"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".barrio"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column4.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".localidad"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column5.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".provincia"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column6.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".piso"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column7.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".complejo"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column8.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".departamento"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column9.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".cod_postal"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column10.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.alias+".defecto"
		
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarycerrar
		thisForm.id_domicilio = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.leer("id_domicilio")
		thisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
		lParameters cId_cliente, lConsulta, lAbm
		
		thisForm.id_cliente = cId_cliente
		
		if thisForm.oTblClientes.buscar(cId_cliente, .F., "Clave")
			thisForm.oTxtCliente.value = thisForm.oTblClientes.leer("Razon_social")	
		ENDIF
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.refrescar(cId_cliente)
		
		thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisForm.habilitarControles(lConsulta, lAbm)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAgregar.Click
		thisForm.agregarRegistro()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdBorrar.Click
		thisForm.borrarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGuardar.Click
		If fMensPregunto("¿Desea guardar los cambios realizados?","S") = "S"
			thisForm.guardarDirecciones()
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		thisForm.seleccionarYCerrar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column10.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		local nRegistro, lValor
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		nRegistro = thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.recno()
		lValor = thisForm.tg_grid1.column10.tg_checkbox1.value
		
		if lValor
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irPrimero()
			do while !thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.esEoF()
				if thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.recno() <> nRegistro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto", !lValor)
					thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				endIf
		
				thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irSiguiente()
			endDo	
			thisForm.oViewDomiciliosClientes.irRegistro(nRegistro)
		endIf
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE calcularbaseimponible
		LOCAL nImpuestoIva, cId_alicuotaiva, nBaseImponible
		
		
		** CUENTA QUE CALCULA LA BASE IMPONIBLE
		nBaseImponible = ThisForm.otbxImpuestoIva.Value / ThisForm.TasaIva * 100
		
		**ROUND PARA DEJARLO EN 'N' CANTIDAD DE DECIMALES
		ThisForm.otbxBaseImponible.value = ROUND(nBaseImponible, 2)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartasaiva
		LOCAL cId_articulo, cId_alicuotaiva, nTasaIva
		
		
		cId_articulo = ThisForm.id_articulo
		
		
		** BUSCO EL ARTICULO Y EN BASE A ESO LUEGO BUSCA LA ALICUOTA DEL MISMO
		
		IF Thisform.oTblArticulos.buscar(cId_articulo, .F., "CLAVE")
		 		
		 	cId_alicuotaIva = ThisForm.oTblArticulos.leer("id_alicuotaiva")
			
			** BUSCO Y LEO EL CAMPO QUE NECESITO
			IF Thisform.oTblvnt_alicuotasivas.buscar(cId_alicuotaiva, .F., "CLAVE")
				nTasaIva = Thisform.oTblvnt_alicuotasivas.leer("Porcentaje")
			ENDIF
		
		ENDIF
		
		ThisForm.tasaIva = nTasaIva
		
		ThisForm.otbxTasaIva.value = ThisForm.tasaiva
		
		ThisForm.manejarCamposHabilitados()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotalexento
		LOCAL nMontoBruto, nNetoGravado, nTotalExento
		
		nMontoBruto = ThisForm.otbxMontoBruto.value
		nNetoGravado = ThisForm.otbxNetoGravado.value
		
		nTotalExento = nMontoBruto - nNetoGravado
		
		ThisForm.otbxTotalExento.value = ROUND(nTotalExento, 2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		** PABLO 14/12/16
		
		**LLAMO A LAS TABLAS QUE VOY A NECESITAR
		thisform.addobject("oTblArticulos", "tg_tabla", "articulos", "CLAVE")
		thisform.addobject("oTblvnt_alicuotasivas", "tg_tabla", "vnt_alicuotasivas", "CLAVE")
		
		
		
		Closable = .F.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE manejarcamposhabilitados
		
		IF ThisForm.tasaIva = 0
			ThisForm.otbxImpuestoIva.enabled= .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxMontoBruto.Enabled = .T.
		Else
			ThisForm.otbxImpuestoIva.enabled= .T.
			ThisForm.oTbxMontoBruto.Enabled = .F.
		ENDIF
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearformulario
		LPARAMETERS cId_articulo, nNetoGravado
		
		ThisForm.id_articulo = cId_articulo
		ThisForm.oTbxTasaIva.enabled = .F.
		ThisForm.oTbxBaseImponible.enabled = .F.
		ThisForm.otbxImpuestoIva.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxMontoBruto.value = 0
		ThisForm.otbxNetoGravado.value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxBaseImponible.value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxTotalExento.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxTasaIva.Value = 0
		ThisForm.otbxNetoGravado.value = nNetoGravado
		ThisForm.oTbxMontoBruto.Enabled = .F.
		ThisForm.oTbxNetoGravado.Enabled = .F.
		ThisForm.oTbxTotalExento.Enabled = .F.
		
		ThisForm.calcularTasaIva()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxImpuestoIva.InteractiveChange
		DODEFAULT()
		
		ThisForm.calcularBaseImponible()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxMontoBruto.InteractiveChange
		DODEFAULT()
		
		ThisForm.calcularTotalExento()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		
		IF ThisForm.tasaIva = 0
			Thisform.Importe = ThisForm.oTbxTotalExento.value
		Else
			Thisform.Importe = ThisForm.oTbxBaseImponible.value
		ENDIF
		
		ThisForm.cancelado = .F.
		
		ThisForm.hide()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		ThisForm.cancelado = .T.
		ThisForm.hide()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE calculolistabase
		LParameters nPrecio,cLista,ClistaBase,Carticulo,nCoef_Mult_Facturacion
		Local nPreciobase
		
		
		If Type("nCoef_Mult_Facturacion") <> "N"
			nCoef_Mult_Facturacion = 1
		Endif
		
		
		****** 18-12-2008
		******thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase")
		***** Diego 
		nPreciobase = 0
		if thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cArticulo+cListabase,.f.,"Clave")		
		    nPreciobase  = thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio") * nCoef_Mult_Facturacion
			if thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Buscar(cLista+ClistaBase)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion3")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo3")/100,2)
			Endif
		Endif
		Retu nPreciobase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Articulo, cId_Lista, cObservaciones, nDecimalesPrecio, nDecimalesCantidad,cId_cliente
		
		DoDefault()
		
		Local lIva_Incluido, lInt_Incluido, nImp_Int, nPorc_Iva, nPrecioNeto, nPrecioFinal, nStock,cId_ListaOriginal,nPrecioLista,nCoeficienteListas,nPrecioOriginal,nPrecioDestino
		
		cId_ListaOriginal=cId_Lista
		nPrecioDestino = 0
		
		thisform.AddObject("oArticulos"	        ,"Tg_tabla", "Articulos"         , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oListaPrecios"	    ,"Tg_tabla", "ListaPrecios"      , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Precios"	    ,"Tg_tabla", "Vnt_Precios"       , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oStk_Stock"  	    ,"Tg_tabla", "Stk_Stock"         , "Id_Articul")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_AlicuotasIvas"	,"Tg_tabla", "Vnt_AlicuotasIvas" , "Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_RelacionListasVick"	,"Tg_tabla", "Vnt_RelacionListasVick" , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_ArtCli"	,"Tg_tabla", "Vnt_ArtCli" , "Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos"		,"Tg_tabla","ListaPrecios_bonifrecargos","Clave") && LUCHO M. 11/08/2011
		
		If thisform.oVnt_RelacionListasVick.Buscar(cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
			cId_Lista=thisform.oVnt_RelacionListasVick.Leer("id_ListaDestino")
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.oArticulos.buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		
		Thisform.Tg_Label1.caption = "["+alltrim(cId_Articulo)+"] "+alltrim(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = cObservaciones
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Packing2")
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Packing1")
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value = cId_Lista
		
		Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo+cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
		       
		lInt_Incluido = Thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Int_Incluido")
		lIva_Incluido = Thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Iva_Incluido")
		nImp_Int      = thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Imp_Int")
		nPorc_Iva     = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
		nPrecioLista=Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
		
		** LUCHO M. 11/08/2011
		If !empty(thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"))
			nPrecioLista = Thisform.calculolistabase(,cId_lista,thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"),cId_Articulo)
		Endif
		** LUCHO M. 11/08/2011
		
		If Thisform.oVnt_ArtCli.Buscar(cId_cliente+cId_Articulo) and Thisform.oVnt_ArtCli.Leer("Precio")<>0
			If Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo+cId_ListaOriginal,.f.,"Clave")
			   nPrecioOriginal=Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
			Endif
			
			** LUCHO M. 26/08/2011
			If Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(cId_ListaOriginal,.f.,"Clave") and !empty(thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"))
				nPrecioOriginal = Thisform.calculolistabase(,cId_ListaOriginal,thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"),cId_Articulo)
			Endif
			** LUCHO M. 26/08/2011	
			
			If Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo+cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
			   nPrecioDestino=Thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
			Endif
			
			** LUCHO M. 26/08/2011
			If Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave") and !empty(thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"))
				nPrecioDestino = Thisform.calculolistabase(,cId_Lista,thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("id_listabase"),cId_Articulo)
			Endif
			** LUCHO M. 26/08/2011	
			
			If nPrecioDestino<>0
				nCoeficienteListas=nPrecioOriginal/nPrecioDestino
		
				nPrecioLista=Thisform.oVnt_ArtCli.Leer("Precio")/nCoeficienteListas
			Endif	
		Endif
		
		if lIva_Incluido and lInt_Incluido
		   nPrecioFinal =  Round(nPrecioLista,nDecimalesPrecio)
		   nPrecioNeto  =  Round(nPrecioLista / ( 1 + ((nPorc_Iva + nImp_Int) / 100) ) , nDecimalesPrecio)
		endif
		
		if lIva_Incluido and !lInt_Incluido
		   nPrecioNeto  =  Round(nPrecioLista / ( 1 + ((nPorc_Iva) / 100) ) , nDecimalesPrecio)
		   nPrecioFinal =  Round(nPrecioNeto * ( 1 + ((nImp_Int + nPorc_Iva) / 100)) , nDecimalesPrecio )
		endif
		
		if !lIva_Incluido and lInt_Incluido
		   nPrecioNeto  =  Round(nPrecioLista / ( 1 + ((nImp_Int) / 100) ) , nDecimalesPrecio)
		   nPrecioFinal =  Round(nPrecioNeto * ( 1 + ((nImp_Int + nPorc_Iva) / 100)) , nDecimalesPrecio )
		endif
		
		if !lIva_Incluido and !lInt_Incluido
		   nPrecioNeto  =  Round(nPrecioLista , nDecimalesPrecio)
		   nPrecioFinal =  Round(nPrecioNeto * ( 1 + ((nImp_Int + nPorc_Iva) / 100)) , nDecimalesPrecio )   
		endif
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Value = nPrecioNeto
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value = nPrecioFinal
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Value = Round(thisform.oArticulos.Leer("Pendientes"), nDecimalesCantidad)
		
		nStock = 0
		Thisform.oStk_Stock.Buscar( cId_Articulo , .f., "Id_Articul")
		Do while !Thisform.oStk_Stock.EsEof() and Thisform.oStk_Stock.Leer("Id_Articulo")=cId_Articulo
		   nStock = nStock + Thisform.oStk_Stock.Leer("Saldo")
		   Thisform.oStk_Stock.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = Round(nStock,nDecimalesCantidad)
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = cObservaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		Thisform.hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAceptar.Click
		
		
		Thisform.Salir()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Cliente, lSuma ,vTotalOs,nTotal ,  vTotalOsNc &&& 07-11-2020
		Dodefault()
		
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"Tg_tabla","Parametros")	
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"Tg_tabla","Clientes"	, "CLAVE")	
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewImputacionClientes","Tg_ViewImputacionClientes")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstGrabarProrrateo" , "tg_prorrateoobrassociales")
		
		
		*********** 07-11-2020
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblProveedores"			,"Tg_tabla","Proveedores"	, "nombre")	
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblaux_artprove"			,"Tg_Tabla"	,"aux_artprove")
		thisForm.oTblaux_artprove.SetearProp ("BOT")
		*********** 07-11-2020
		
		
		Thisform.Id_Cliente = cId_Cliente
		thisform.tg_clientes1.value = cId_Cliente
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
					ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value  = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")	
		Endif 
		
		
		Thisform.Suma		= lSuma
		Thisform.total = NTotal
		ThisForm.oCmdSalir.enabled = .f.
		ThisForm.text1.Value = nTotal
		ThisForm.text2.Value = nTotal

		ThisForm.text4.Value = nTotal
		ThisForm.text3.Value = nTotal

	PROCEDURE modificarproveedoresacero
		*** Matias L. 24/04/2025 #1862
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
			
		IF thisform.tg_chkGenerarCmpCompras.Value
			thisform.oTblaux_artprove.irPrimero()
			DO WHILE !thisform.oTblaux_artprove.eseof()
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"precio",0)
				thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
				
				thisform.oTblaux_artprove.irSiguiente()
			enddo
		ENDIF
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid2.Refresh()
		ThisForm.tg_grid2.ReadOnly = !thisform.tg_chkGenerarCmpCompras.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		If !Empty(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>"O"				 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta

		****Thisform.BuscarErrorEnLiquidaciones() 
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Desfiltrar()
		local nSiguienteElemento
		local nSiguienteElementoCompras
		
		nSiguienteElemento=1
		nSiguienteElementoCompras = 1
		
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.DesFiltrar()
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.seleccionar
		
		
		
		Do While Not Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof() 
		
		
		
				IF Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")>0 AND !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo") 
				 
			   		Dimension vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]  
				
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,1]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,2]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,3]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,4]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("id_sistema")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,5]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,6]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,7]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Suc_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,8]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sis_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,9]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_cmp_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_ref_liqma")
					
					nSiguienteelemento=nSiguienteElemento+1
				Endif	
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()	
		EndDo
		
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		
		******** 07-11-2020
		Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.IrPrimero()
		Do While Not Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.EsEof() 
				IF Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Precio") > 0
				 	Dimension vTotalOsNc[nSiguienteElementoCompras,2]  
				 	vTotalOsNc[nSiguienteElementoCompras,1]=Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
					vTotalOsNC[nSiguienteElementoCompras,2]=Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Precio")
					nSiguienteElementoCompras= nSiguienteElementoCompras + 1
				Endif	
				Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.IrSiguiente()	
		EndDo
		**** 07-11-2020
		
		
		Thisform.Hide
		
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
		    thisform.cancelado = .f.
		    thisform.generarcmpcompras = thisform.tg_chkGenerarCmpCompras.Value 
			Thisform.Hide
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFiltro.InteractiveChange
		LOCAL cFiltro
		
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.DesFiltrar()
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Seleccionar()
		
		cFiltro = ""
		
		IF !EMPTY(This.Value)
			
			cFiltro = "like('*" + UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.Value))  + "*'," + UPPER('Razon_social') + ")"
		
			thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.FILTRAR(UPPER(cFiltro))
			thisform.refrescargrilla()
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

		LPARAMETERS nColIndex

		if ThisForm.Text2.Value = 0 AND ThisForm.Text3.Value = 0 &&& 07-11-2020
		   ThisForm.oCmdSalir.enabled = .t.
		else   
		  ThisForm.oCmdSalir.enabled = .f. 
		endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1.GotFocus
		**** 22-09-2020
		IF Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo')
		   ***this.Enabled = .f.
		   this.readonly = .t.
		   this.Value = 0
		   retu
		else   
		   this.Enabled = .t.
		   this.readonly = .f.
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1.Valid
		**** 22-09-2020
		LOCAL lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		IF Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo')
		   ***this.Enabled = .f.
		   this.readonly = .t.
		   this.Value = 0
		   lvalido = .t.
		   
		else   
		   this.Enabled = .t.
		   this.readonly = .f.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF this.Value > Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Pendiente') AND !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo')
			
				=fMensAceptar("El importe no puede ser mayor al Pendiente de la Liquidacion" )
				lvalido = .f.
		ENDIF
		
		RETURN lvalido
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE inicializarcontroles
		Local mmpp
		*** 07-11-2020
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		*** 07-11-2020
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ReadOnly=.F.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ReadOnly=.F.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly=.T.
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo'), rgb(255,193,164), rgb(255,255,255))"
				
				***255,193,164
				*** rgb(113,198,249)
		NEXT
		
		
		**** 07-11-2020

				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif

		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Desfiltrar()
		local nSiguienteElemento
		local nSiguienteElementoCompras
		
		nSiguienteElemento=1
		nSiguienteElementoCompras = 1
		
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.DesFiltrar()
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.seleccionar
		
		
		
		Do While Not Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof() 
		
		
		
				IF Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")>0 AND !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo") 
				 
			   		Dimension vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]  
				
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,1]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,2]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,3]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,4]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("id_sistema")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,5]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,6]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,7]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Suc_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,8]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sis_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,9]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_cmp_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_ref_liqma")
					
					nSiguienteelemento=nSiguienteElemento+1
				Endif	
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()	
		EndDo
		
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		
		******** 07-11-2020
		Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.IrPrimero()
		Do While Not Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.EsEof() 
				IF Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Precio") > 0
				 	Dimension vTotalOsNc[nSiguienteElementoCompras,2]  
				 	vTotalOsNc[nSiguienteElementoCompras,1]=Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
					vTotalOsNC[nSiguienteElementoCompras,2]=Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.Leer("Precio")
					nSiguienteElementoCompras= nSiguienteElementoCompras + 1
				Endif	
				Thisform.oTblaux_artprove.IrSiguiente()	
		EndDo
		**** 07-11-2020
		
		
		Thisform.Hide
		
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
		    thisform.cancelado = .f.
			Thisform.Hide
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFiltro.InteractiveChange
		LOCAL cFiltro
		
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.DesFiltrar()
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Seleccionar()
		
		cFiltro = ""
		
		IF !EMPTY(This.Value)
			
			cFiltro = "like('*" + UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.Value))  + "*'," + UPPER('Razon_social') + ")"
		
			thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.FILTRAR(UPPER(cFiltro))
			thisform.refrescargrilla()
		ENDIF 
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

		LOCAL lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Cliente, lSuma ,vTotalOs,nTotal
		Dodefault()
		
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"Tg_tabla","Parametros")	
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"Tg_tabla","Clientes"	, "CLAVE")	
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewImputacionClientes","Tg_ViewImputacionClientes")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstGrabarProrrateo" , "tg_prorrateoobrassociales")
		
		Thisform.Id_Cliente = cId_Cliente
		thisform.tg_clientes1.value = cId_Cliente
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
					ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value  = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")	
		Endif 
		
		
		Thisform.Suma		= lSuma
		Thisform.total = NTotal
		ThisForm.oCmdSalir.enabled = .f.
		ThisForm.text1.Value = nTotal
		ThisForm.text2.Value = nTotal
		ThisForm.InicializarControles()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		If !Empty(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>"O"				 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Refrescar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, Thisform.Suma)
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias
		
		****Thisform.BuscarErrorEnLiquidaciones() 
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero
		thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.seleccionar()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".TotalCmp"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Diferencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".Cerrar"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Alias+".rangofechas"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.width = 125
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.width = 265
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Desfiltrar()
		local nSiguienteElemento
		nSiguienteElemento=1
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.seleccionar
		
		
		
		Do While Not Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof() 
		
		
		
				IF Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")>0 AND !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo") 
				 
			   		Dimension vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]  
				
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,1]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,2]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Diferencia")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,3]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,4]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("id_sistema")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,5]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,6]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,7]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Suc_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,8]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sis_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,9]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_cmp_liqma")
					vTotalOs[nSiguienteElemento,10]=Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("nro_ref_liqma")
					
					nSiguienteelemento=nSiguienteElemento+1
				Endif	
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()	
		EndDo
		
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		
		Thisform.Hide
		
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
		    thisform.cancelado = .f.
			Thisform.Hide
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click

		   ThisForm.oCmdSalir.enabled = .t.

		endif   
		
	ENDPROC

		   this.readonly = .t.
		   this.Value = 0
		   lvalido = .t.
		   
		else   
		   this.Enabled = .t.
		   this.readonly = .f.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF this.Value > Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Pendiente') AND !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo')
			
				=fMensAceptar("El importe no puede ser mayor al Pendiente de la Liquidacion" )
				lvalido = .f.
		ENDIF
		
		RETURN lvalido
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
		local nCont
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nCont = 1
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEof()
			nCont = nCont+ 1
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_camion", padl(nCont, 3, "0"))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_expreso"	, thisForm.id_expreso)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_vehiculo", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_acoplado", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, .F.)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cuit"		, "  -        - ")
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
		
		If !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.EsTablaVacia()
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.borrar()
			thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardarvehiculo
		if thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.buscar(thisForm.id_expreso, .F., "expreso")
			do while !thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.esEof() AND thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.esClaveIgual()
				thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.borrar()
				thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.irSiguiente()
			endDo
		endIf	
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEoF()
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_camion"		, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_camion"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_expreso"		, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_expreso"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_vehiculo", thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("patente_vehiculo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_acoplado", thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("patente_acoplado"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"			, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("defecto"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Alias"			, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("Alias"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cuit"			, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("Cuit"))	
			thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		&&thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		lParameters lConsulta, lAbm
		
		for i = 1 TO thisForm.tg_grid1.columnCount
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Columns(i).readOnly = lConsulta
		endFor		
		thisForm.oCmdAgregar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdBorrar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdGuardar.Visible = !lConsulta
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
		*!*	if lConsulta AND !lAbm
		*!*		thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .T.
		*!*	else	
		*!*		thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .F.
		*!*	endIf
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
		thisForm.oCmdSalir.Visible = lAbm
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewVehiculosGuardados", "tg_viewVehiculosGuardadosCOT")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblExpresos", "tg_tabla", "expresos", "Clave")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblvehiculos_expreso", "tg_tabla", "vehiculos_expreso", "Expreso")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column1.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".patente_vehiculo"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column2.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".patente_acoplado"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".defecto"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column4.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".alias"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column5.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".cuit"
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarycerrar
		thisForm.id_camion = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_camion")
		thisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
		lParameters cId_expreso, lConsulta, lAbm
		
		thisForm.id_expreso = cId_expreso
		if thisForm.oTblExpresos.buscar(cId_expreso, .F., "Clave")
			thisForm.oTxtExpreso.Value = thisForm.oTblExpresos.leer("razon_social")
		endIf	
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.refrescar(cId_expreso)
		
		thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisForm.habilitarControles(lConsulta, lAbm)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAgregar.Click
		thisForm.agregarRenglon()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdBorrar.Click
		thisForm.borrarRenglon()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGuardar.Click
		
		If fMensPregunto("¿Desea guardar los cambios realizados?","S") = "S"
			thisForm.guardarVehiculo()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
		thisForm.hide()
		*** Chiara 27/08/18
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		thisForm.seleccionarYCerrar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		local nRegistro, lValor
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nRegistro = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.recno()
		lValor = thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.tg_checkbox1.value
		
		if lValor
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
			do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEoF()
				if thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.recno() <> nRegistro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto", !lValor)
					thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				endIf
		
				thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
			endDo	
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irRegistro(nRegistro)
		endIf
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Alignment = 0, ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Left = 36, ;
		Name = "Tg_checkbox1", ;
		Top = 24
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="checkbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label1' AS tg_label WITH ;
		Caption = "Expreso", ;
		Height = 12, ;
		Left = 5, ;
		Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		Top = 9, ;
		Width = 48
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE agregarrenglon
		local nCont
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nCont = 1
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEof()
			nCont = nCont+ 1
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_camion", padl(nCont, 3, "0"))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_expreso"	, thisForm.id_expreso)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_vehiculo", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_acoplado", "")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"		, .F.)
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrarrenglon
		
		If !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.EsTablaVacia()
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.borrar()
			thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh()
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardarvehiculo
		if thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.buscar(thisForm.id_expreso, .F., "expreso")
			do while !thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.esEof() AND thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.esClaveIgual()
				thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.borrar()
				thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.irSiguiente()
			endDo
		endIf	
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEoF()
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_camion"		, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_camion"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_expreso"		, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_expreso"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_vehiculo", thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("patente_vehiculo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "patente_acoplado", thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("patente_acoplado"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto"			, thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("defecto"))
		
			thisForm.oTblvehiculos_expreso.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
		endDo	
		
		&&thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		lParameters lConsulta, lAbm
		
		for i = 1 TO thisForm.tg_grid1.columnCount
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Columns(i).readOnly = lConsulta
		endFor		
		thisForm.oCmdAgregar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdBorrar.Visible = !lConsulta
		thisForm.oCmdGuardar.Visible = !lConsulta
		if lConsulta AND !lAbm
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .T.
		else	
			thisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Visible = .F.
		endIf
		thisForm.oCmdSalir.Visible = lAbm
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewVehiculosGuardados", "tg_viewVehiculosGuardadosCOT")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblExpresos", "tg_tabla", "expresos", "Clave")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblvehiculos_expreso", "tg_tabla", "vehiculos_expreso", "Expreso")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column1.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".patente_vehiculo"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column2.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".patente_acoplado"
		thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.ControlSource = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.alias+".defecto"
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarycerrar
		thisForm.id_camion = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.leer("id_camion")
		thisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
		lParameters cId_expreso, lConsulta, lAbm
		
		thisForm.id_expreso = cId_expreso
		if thisForm.oTblExpresos.buscar(cId_expreso, .F., "Clave")
			thisForm.oTxtExpreso.Value = thisForm.oTblExpresos.leer("razon_social")
		endIf	
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		
		thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.refrescar(cId_expreso)
		
		thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
		
		thisForm.habilitarControles(lConsulta, lAbm)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAgregar.Click
		thisForm.agregarRenglon()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdBorrar.Click
		thisForm.borrarRenglon()
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGuardar.Click
		
		If fMensPregunto("¿Desea guardar los cambios realizados?","S") = "S"
			thisForm.guardarVehiculo()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSalir.Click
		thisForm.Release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click
		thisForm.seleccionarYCerrar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		local nRegistro, lValor
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nRegistro = thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.recno()
		lValor = thisForm.tg_grid1.column3.tg_checkbox1.value
		
		if lValor
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irPrimero()
			do while !thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.esEoF()
				if thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.recno() <> nRegistro
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "defecto", !lValor)
					thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				endIf
		
				thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irSiguiente()
			endDo	
			thisForm.oViewVehiculosGuardados.irRegistro(nRegistro)
		endIf
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE inicializarchecks
		Local nRomaneoLotes
		
		thisform.oTblVnt_docuBis.Buscar(thisform.id_comproba)
		nRomaneoLotes = thisform.oTblVnt_docuBis.leer("romaneoLotes")
		thisform.TotalesPorArticulo=.f.
		
		DO CASE
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 0
				thisform.release()
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 1
				thisform.oChkCabecera.value = .F.
				thisform.oChkArticulos.value = .F.
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 2
				thisform.oChkCabecera.value = .T.
				thisform.oChkArticulos.value = .F.		
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 3
				thisform.oChkCabecera.value = .F.
				thisform.oChkArticulos.value = .T.
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 4
				thisform.oChkCabecera.value = .T.
				thisform.oChkArticulos.value = .T.
			CASE nRomaneoLotes = 5
				thisform.oChkCabecera.value = .f.
				thisform.oChkArticulos.value = .t.
				thisform.TotalesPorArticulo=.t.		
		ENDCASE
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_sucursal, cId_sistema, cId_comproba, nNro_referencia
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_docuBis",	"tg_tabla",	"vnt_docuBis",	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal",		"tg_tabla",	"terminal", 	"CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oImpresoras",		"tg_tabla",	"Impresoras")

		thisform.id_sistema = cId_sistema
		thisform.id_comproba = cId_comproba
		thisform.nro_referencia = nNro_referencia
		
		thisform.inicializarChecks()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		Local cNombreImpresora, nCopias, cImpresora, i
		
		cImpresora="id_impresora="+"'001'"+" and "+"Maquina="+"'"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'"
		thisform.oImpresoras.Localizar(cImpresora)
		
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora=CreateObject("Tg_seleccionarimpresora", 1, thisform.oImpresoras.Leer("Nombre"))
		oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Show()
		
		If !oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Cancela
			nCopias=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.Copias
			cNombreImpresora=oFrmSeleccionarImpresora.oCmbImpresoras.Value
		
			for i = 1 to nCopias
				olistado=createobject("tg_desgloseLotes")
				
				If Type("oListado") = "O"
					olistado.olis=createobject("tg_listador")
					olistado.olis.titulo=""
					olistado.olis.salida=2
					olistado.olis.ImprimeDatosYFiltros=".f."
					olistado.olis.ImprimeFechaYHora=".f."
					olistado.olis.HojaInicial="0"
					olistado.olis.Fax=.f.
					oListado.olis.NombreImpresora=cNombreImpresora	
					olistado.listar(thisform.id_sucursal, thisform.id_sistema, thisform.id_comproba, thisform.nro_referencia, thisform.oChkCabecera.value, thisform.oChkArticulos.value,thisform.TotalesPorArticulo)
				Endif
				
				olistado=""	
			EndFor
		Endif	
		
		thisform.release()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		thisform.release()
	ENDPROC
